title: Technical Product Manager - AI Investing
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
About Searchable

Searchable is an analytics and agentic platform for AI Search. As ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews reshape how people discover information, brands need new ways to measure and optimise their visibility across both traditional and generative search.

We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates fixes.

We’re backed by top angels and VCs, and building the team that will define the category.

We’re office-based five days a week near London Bridge. For a small team building fast, in-person iteration is a real advantage — and if that’s how you like to work, you’ll feel it.

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape how customers understand and act on a new class of AI-search data. You’ll be our senior design voice, working with founders, product, engineering and customers to turn complex systems into products that feel clear, useful and inevitable.

This role starts with UX. You’ll get close to customers, model their workflows, find the real problem beneath the request and make strong calls about what we should build. You’ll also carry that thinking all the way to a polished interface. We care equally about whether a product makes sense and whether every interaction earns its place.

This is a hands-on staff role, not a layer of design management. You’ll lead through the quality of your thinking and execution, raise the standard across the product and help define the design practice as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own product design end to end, from an ambiguous problem and customer insight to a shipped experience

  • Build a deep understanding of SEO, AEO and GEO workflows, then turn that complexity into simple mental models and clear product decisions

  • Work directly with customers and go-to-market teams to identify unmet needs, test assumptions and separate signal from feature requests

  • Partner closely with product and engineering from the first sketch through implementation, shaping scope, resolving trade-offs and staying accountable after launch

  • Design information-rich workflows, dashboards and agentic interactions that help customers move confidently from insight to action

  • Produce high-quality interaction and visual design, with strong hierarchy, states, responsive behaviour and attention to the details that make a product feel trustworthy

  • Prototype quickly at the right level of fidelity, using the work to answer questions rather than decorate decisions

  • Evolve a pragmatic design system that speeds up delivery without flattening the product into generic components

  • Use data, customer evidence and product judgement to improve shipped work — not treat launch as the finish line

  • Raise the design bar across the company through clear critique, strong rationale and close collaboration

How we think about design

This is product design, not a hand-off function. The best answer may be a new workflow, a smaller feature, clearer language or deciding not to build something at all. You’ll be expected to understand the system, challenge the brief and make the product simpler.

We value strong opinions, loosely held. You should be able to explain why an experience works, argue your corner and change your mind when customer evidence or real usage points elsewhere.

Craft matters here. The interface is where our customers decide whether to trust the product and act on what it tells them.

About You

  • You have significant experience designing complex B2B software and a portfolio that shows both the thinking behind the work and the quality of the shipped result

  • Your strongest skill is UX: you can frame ambiguous problems, understand real user behaviour, map complex systems and turn evidence into a coherent product direction

  • You are also a strong UI designer with excellent command of hierarchy, typography, interaction states, data visualisation and the details that make dense products feel calm and intuitive

  • You have led major product areas or zero-to-one initiatives as a senior individual contributor

  • You influence company-level decisions without relying on formal authority

  • You are comfortable talking directly with customers and adapting your research method to the speed and certainty a decision requires

  • You think in systems but resist unnecessary complexity

  • You collaborate deeply with engineers and understand technical constraints well enough to find better answers together

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and turn vague problems into shipped products

  • You care about outcomes more than ownership boundaries

  • You want to define a category, not just refine an established pattern

Nice to have

  • Experience designing analytics, data-heavy, AI-native, agentic, marketing or developer products

  • Familiarity with SEO, search marketing, martech or agency workflows

  • Experience building or evolving a design system in a fast-moving product team

  • Experience using AI to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, content design or production workflows

  • Early-stage startup experience where you helped establish the design practice as well as ship the product

What success looks like

  • In your first 30 days, you understand the product, customers and core workflows, and are contributing to live product decisions

  • In your first 90 days, you own a meaningful product area from problem framing through delivery

  • In your first year, customers find Searchable materially easier to understand and act on, the quality bar is visible across the product, and design is shaping strategy earlier and with better evidence

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: £110,000–£150,000, depending on experience

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • Leading parental and childcare policies

  • Daily Uber Eats or Deliveroo meal allowance

  • Late-night Uber home when work runs late

  • Monthly fitness and wellbeing reimbursement

  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule — we care about the quality of the work

  • Office-based five days a week near London/Tower Bridge

title: Hydraulic Hose Technician
description:
Company :

Hastings Deering (Australia) Ltd

Kickstart your career or take the next step with Hastings Deering – where our people build something BIGGER.

We sell, rent, and offer support and parts distribution services for Cat® products across a range of industries, including resources, general construction, civil transport and commercial construction, power systems, government, primary industries and marine.

We have more than 3,500 employees across 23 business service centres throughout Queensland, Northern Territory, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and New Caledonia, with our headquarters based in Brisbane, Australia.

When you join our team at Hastings Deering, you'll benefit from:

  • Big Pay, Bigger Growth – Competitive hourly rates with competency-based pay rises PLUS regular scheduled increases under our current Enterprise Agreement.

  • Body, Mind & Wallet Support – Free health checks, Employee Assistance Program, income protection insurance, and discounts at major retailers and private health providers.

  • World-Class Training – We're one of only eight Caterpillar Centres of Excellence globally. Learn from the best in CAT and boost your skills.

  • Career Paths That Work for You – Grow into leadership, technical specialist, or support service roles. At Hastings Deering, we align with YOUR goals.

  • Security You Can Count On – Enjoy the stability of a long-term career with Hastings Deering, backed by global strength.

  • Rewarding Recognition Programs – Access employee rewards, discounts and bonus opportunities, including potential quarterly bonus payments of up to $750.

What you'll need

A successful teammate will have experience in:

  • Relevant technical experience – trade qualifications in a mechanical or technical field with hydraulic hose assembly experience highly desirable.

  • Licence ready – current MR Driver's Licence is essential.

  • Customer focused mindset – demonstrated commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building strong customer relationships.

  • Hydraulic knowledge – ability to read and interpret hydraulic schematics is desirable.

  • Industry experience – proven experience working in a similar hydraulic, mechanical, workshop, or field service environment.

  • Systems and process awareness – experience using CAT WebSIS 2.0, Microsoft Dynamics AX, or similar business systems is desirable.

  • Safety and reliability focused – physically fit, highly conscientious, and committed to safe work practices and quality outcomes.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Ricerchiamo per un gruppo industriale internazionale, tra le principali realtà mondiali nei settori dell'Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza, un DevSecOps Engineer.

La risorsa selezionata verrà inserita all'interno della divisione Area Cyber & Security Solutions e opererà presso la sede di Roma (zona Laurentina).

Il Ruolo

Sarai responsabile della progettazione, implementazione e gestione di pipeline CI/CD sicure e automatizzate su un portfolio di oltre 20 prodotti. Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con CTO, Product Manager e team di sviluppo per coprire l’intero ciclo di vita del software, garantendo l'integrazione continua della sicurezza e il monitoraggio delle vulnerabilità

Di cosa ti occuperai:

  • Automazione CI/CD: Progettare e mantenere pipeline (pipeline-as-code) garantendo automazione e tracciabilità dalla build alla produzione.
  • Governance e Versioning: Definire strategie di branching (GitFlow, trunk-based) e tracciare le versioni di librerie, sotto-moduli e dipendenze.
  • Security & Vulnerability Management: Integrare controlli automatizzati (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) ed eseguire vulnerability assessment continui coordinando le remediation (CVSS).
  • Toolchain & Infrastructure: Presidiare la piattaforma DevSecOps (GitLab CI, SonarQube, Nexus, Trivy) e gestirne l'infrastruttura on-premise in logica Infrastructure as Code (Ansible/AWX, Terraform).
  • Gestione SBOM e Secret: Automatizzare la generazione di Software Bill of Materials (compliance CRA EU) e implementare la gestione sicura delle credenziali tramite Vault/OpenBao.
  • Enablement: Supportare i team di sviluppo nell’adozione strutturata delle pratiche DevSecOps (Shift-Left Security), fornendo linee guida e template.

Requisiti

  • Background accademico: Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o titolo equivalente.
  • Seniority: 3–5 anni di esperienza in ambito DevSecOps, Software Engineering o Platform/Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Competenze Tecniche Core:
  • Ottima padronanza di tool CI/CD (es. GitLab) e artifact repository (Nexus, Artifactory).
  • Conoscenza profonda dei tool di analisi statica/dinamica e vulnerability scanning (SonarQube, Trivy, Dependency-Track).
  • Esperienza con tecnologie Container (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Competenza in Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform) e scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy).

At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on.

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.

We’re a tight-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.

About the Position

We're looking for a user-focused backend engineer to join our Lending Products team in San Francisco to help build the platforms and infrastructure that power the suite of Parafin's lending products. The Lending Products team builds the core systems, frameworks, and tooling that product engineers across Parafin rely on to build and iterate on financial products. You'll partner with engineering teams across the company, including those that own offer generation, servicing, and repayment, to build and improve the platform capabilities they need to ship new product verticals quickly and reliably.

  • Own the development of key components of our lending platform infrastructure, including the systems and frameworks that product engineers use to build and ship lending products.

  • Partner with engineers on teams that own specific lending verticals to understand their needs and build platform capabilities that enable them to move quickly.

  • Identify, own, and implement improvements to our infrastructure to support product development and improve system reliability.

  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture through thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and knowledge sharing.

  • Mentor other engineers, drive improvements to team processes and code quality, and foster a culture of craft and ownership.

  • You are comfortable owning and driving the development of new platform capabilities from the ground up.

  • You have a solid understanding of engineering fundamentals and a desire to continue learning.

  • Experience building internal platforms or frameworks that other engineering teams build on top of.

title: Principal Product Mgr
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Principal Product Manager, ASPM

Qualys is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead ASPM (Application Security Posture Management), within the Enterprise TruRisk Management platform. ASPM provides unified visibility, risk-based prioritization, and integrated remediation to help organizations manage application security risk continuously and autonomously. As the PM, you will define the roadmap and execution strategy for how customers discover, consume, prioritize, and remediate application security risk, while driving ideas to increase product adoption and grow the ASPM business.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of Application Security, vulnerability management, and Agentic AI. You will work closely with Engineering and Design to turn ideas into scalable, customer-facing capabilities; validate them with customers; partner with Marketing on go-to-market execution; and work with Sales to drive adoption and business growth.

What You’ll Own

  • Define the roadmap, execution plan and success metrics for ASPM.
  • Build capabilities that help customers discover, prioritize, and remediate application security risk based on discovery, exploitability, application criticality, and business impact.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design and Threat teams to build the intelligence foundation for ASPM, including data ingestion, normalization, correlation, enrichment, scoring, and AI-assisted experiences.
  • Engage AppSec leaders, vulnerability managers, DevOps practitioners to uncover customer problems, validate solutions, and shape the ASPM roadmap.
  • Shape how ASPM intelligence powers ETM, TruRisk, risk operations, and Agentic AI-driven decision-making.
  • Partner with GTM teams on launches, enablement, positioning, and competitive differentiation.

What Success Looks Like

  • ASPM becomes the application risk intelligence layer for ETM customers.
  • Customers cut through application security noise and focus on the exposures that matter most.
  • Qualys research and threat intelligence are transformed into scalable, actionable application security insights.
  • ASPM drives adoption, expansion, and differentiation for ETM.
  • AI and automation accelerate analyst productivity and decision-making without introducing black-box risk.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 8 years of product management experience, including 5+ years in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
  • Experienced in one or more of the following domains: ASPM, API security, Web App Security (SAST, DAST, and SCA), Vulnerability Management
  • Ability to work deeply with engineering, threat research, design, and security teams.
  • Strong product judgment, customer discovery skills, and ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear customer value.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for executive, customer, analyst, and internal audiences.
  • Ability to learn quickly and keep up with fast changing AppSec domain
  • Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK, and related security frameworks.

Preferred Experience

  • Some knowledge of Agentic AI and AI security would be highly preferred
  • Prior hands-on experience as Application Security Analyst or Pen-tester is a big plus

Why This Role Matters

ASPM is a critical part of Qualys’ vision for Enterprise TruRisk Management. It brings together application findings, vulnerability management, Qualys research, asset context, and business risk to help customers move from reactive application security to proactive, risk-based Application Security Posture Management.

This role will help shape how Application Security, Vulnerability Management, AI, and automation come together to power the next generation of Application Security Posture Management.

title: ML Infra Engineer, Modeling
description:
Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

In this role you will help scale and optimize our training systems and core model code. You’ll own critical infrastructure for large-scale training, from managing GPU/TPU compute and job orchestration to building reusable and efficient JAX training pipelines. You’ll work closely with researchers and model engineers to translate ideas into experiments—and those experiments into production training runs.

This is a hands-on, high-leverage role at the intersection of ML, software engineering, and scalable infrastructure.

The Team

The ML Infrastructure team supports and accelerates PI’s core modeling efforts by building the systems that make large-scale training reliable, reproducible, and fast. The team works closely with research, data, and platform engineers to ensure models can scale from prototype to production-grade training runs.

In This Role You Will

  • Own training/inference infrastructure: Design, implement, and maintain systems for large-scale model training, including scheduling, job management, checkpointing, and metrics/logging.

  • Scale distributed training: Work with researchers to scale JAX-based training across TPU and GPU clusters with minimal friction.

  • Optimize performance: Profile and improve memory usage, device utilization, throughput, and distributed synchronization.

  • Enable rapid iteration: Build abstractions for launching, monitoring, debugging, and reproducing experiments.

  • Partner with researchers: Translate research needs into infra capabilities and guide best practices for training at scale.

  • Contribute to core training code: Evolve JAX model and training code to support new architectures, modalities, and evaluation metrics.

What We Hope You’ll Bring

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building ML training infrastructure or internal platforms.

  • Hands-on large-scale training experience in JAX (preferred), PyTorch.

  • Familiarity with distributed training, multi-host setups, data loaders, and evaluation pipelines.

  • Experience managing training workloads on cloud platforms (e.g., SLURM, Kubernetes, GCP TPU/GKE, AWS).

  • Ability to debug and optimize performance bottlenecks across the training stack.

  • Strong cross-functional communication and ownership mindset.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Deep ML systems background (e.g., training compilers, runtime optimization, custom kernels).

  • Experience operating close to hardware (GPU/TPU performance tuning).

  • Background in robotics, multimodal models, or large-scale foundation models.

  • Experience designing abstractions that balance researcher flexibility with system reliability.

You'll provide expertise in all aspects of security with a focus on security policy and strategy, delivering security awareness training and advice across Scottish Water and its partners, investigating significant security incidents, and representing Scottish Water at meetings with Police Scotland and other external agencies.

You'll be responsible for the preparation and update a variety of security policy, procedures and plans (including SW Security Manual, CCTV, security incident management and alarm response) for internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you will create and deliver a wide range of training material to support these and plan, deliver and evaluate appropriate exercising.

You'll manage the security incident reporting system; analysing trends, investigating security incidents; and providing regular business-wide updates; producing reports and recommendations to the business for improvements to security systems and procedures.

As a lead subject matter expert, you'll provide strategic guidance, lead our response to emerging national security risks, and play a key role in protecting Scottish Water's people, assets and critical infrastructure.

You will also support the wider team with advice and support on a range of topics, ensuring compliance with SEMD requirements and Scottish Government directions.

You'll support, coach and advise our team of Protective Security Specialists in all aspects of their role.

You'll make sure that SW is aware of appropriate security-related legislation issued by UK and Scottish Governments; identify what is relevant to Scottish Water, assess the impact and develop a response on behalf of SW, including briefing senior management.

What you’ll need

You will have previous experience that has built knowledge of legislation and guidance relevant to the Scottish water sector, including data protection, information security, personnel security and insider threat, and government security requirements.

With strong analytical and investigative skills, you will be able to assess incidents, identify vulnerabilities and develop clear, practical and cost-effective recommendations.

Excellent stakeholder management skills are essential, with the ability to build credible relationships at all levels and collaborate effectively to achieve successful outcomes.

You'll need knowledge of protective security standards, such as British & European standards, and the UK Government's security guidelines, understanding Crime Prevention through Environmental Design and experience assessing risks related to crime and terrorism is important.

Specialist security training through organisations such as the National Protective Security Authority or UK police services would be advantageous.

To support the wider team, knowledge of intruder detection systems (IDS), perimeter intrusion detection, CCTV and access control systems (ACS), together with a strong understanding of relevant British and European standards, codes of practice and regulatory requirements would be an advantage but the ability to learn is just as important.

Candidates must hold, or be able to obtain and maintain, UK Government Security Check (SC) clearance

You should be proficient in Microsoft 365 and associated IT systems.

Finally, you will be required to travel around Scotland, so a UK (DVLA-issued) driving licence is essential.

Looking out for you

While the work we do is important, we know it’s not the only thing that matters. That’s why we make sure you have everything you need to find a good work-life balance.

You’ll get plenty of time to recharge with 38 days of holiday every year (including public holidays). And you can even buy five more if you need a little extra time. You can also take time off to volunteer in your community.

When it comes to major life events we have family-friendly policies around adoption, maternity, and parental leave. And for the everyday? We embrace flexible working.

For your future, there’s our pension (the ‘know-what-you’ll-get-when-you-retire’ kind), and life assurance.

As for some nice extras? You will participate in a company bonus scheme. Not to mention access to SW Splash – handy rewards that can save you money on holidays, bills, and shopping.

The not-so-small print

This role will be a Grade 7. If you’re new to Scottish Water, you’ll join us on a starting salary of £45,699. Performance-driven pay progression would then allow you to move through the range to a maximum of £56,669.

If you’re interested in this role – or know someone else who might be - we’ll be accepting applications until midnight on 15th September

We operate Balanced Hybrid working at Scottish Water and we encourage people to work half their time in a Scottish Water location.

Job offers at Scottish Water are conditional, and will be confirmed on completion of our pre-employment screening, e.g. referencing, criminal record checks, license checks, etc. Screening is conducted on our behalf by a third party, and must be completed before your start date. Don’t worry - we’ll only start these checks once you’ve accepted an offer

A few final things worth knowing…

Research shows that some people avoid applying for jobs unless they can meet every single criteria. If you’re interested in this job, but don’t tick all the boxes, apply anyway! We hardly ever hire people who can do every part of a job from Day One. Everyone has a learning curve. So don’t rule yourself out!

Let us know if there are any changes we can make to our recruitment process to help you perform at your best. Lots of our people have disabilities or neurodiverse conditions (including some of our recruiters!). We're also aware that some people might be experiencing temporary challenges because of life events, like menopause. We’re very used to making adjustments, so please don’t be afraid to ask.

As part of our commitment to developing a flourishing Scotland, it’s important that all our employees are Scottish taxpayers. If you join us, your home address will need to be in Scotland. If you don’t already live here, you'll need to commit to moving here within your first three months.


Candidates should be aware that a valid UK driving licence is required for driving on Scottish Water business and claiming business mileage expenses.


Please note, Scottish Water takes the safety, health and wellbeing of our employees, colleagues and customers very seriously and as such you may be subject to Drug & Alcohol testing in line with our policy.


Finally (finally!), candidates who haven’t submitted an application in the last 12 months will have their records removed from our recruitment database. You won’t need to do anything. Your data will be automatically deleted.


We’re here to help. Ask us anything at SWRecruitment@ScottishWater.co.uk

title: Cyber Threat Defense Sr AI/ML Engineer
description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

Bank of America's Global Information Security (GIS) team is seeking a Cyber Threat Defense Sr AI/ML Engineer to build and integrate advanced AI and machine learning capabilities into our cyber defense ecosystem. This person will drive innovation across preventative, detective, and responsive security controls by engineering the full spectrum of intelligent automation: deterministic and scripted automation, custom machine learning models, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI systems. This is a senior individual contributor role balancing hands-on engineering with technical leadership, working closely with leadership and engineering teams to drive AI integration into cyber defense.

This engineer will focus on applying AI to defend against modern threats, including threat actors who are themselves leveraging AI, and will partner with security subject matter experts across GIS on defending the bank's own use of AI. The ideal candidate is an experienced AI/ML engineer with deep fundamentals in machine learning theory and practice, strong production engineering discipline, and a working understanding of cybersecurity, who knows that the right solution is sometimes a script, sometimes a model, and sometimes an agent.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered capabilities for threat hunting, anomaly detection, and automated incident response over large-scale security telemetry.
  • Develop and operationalize custom machine learning models and LLM-based workflows tailored to cybersecurity use cases, owning the lifecycle from data preparation and feature engineering through training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Match the technique to the problem: apply deterministic automation, classical machine learning, or generative AI (or a combination) based on the problem structure, the available data, and the operational risk profile.
  • Build LLM-based tooling that multiplies analyst effectiveness, such as investigation support, detection engineering assistance, and knowledge retrieval.
  • Partner with GIS operational and technical teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven enhancements to security controls and architecture.
  • Prototype and evaluate emerging AI technologies for applicability in cyber threat detection and response.
  • Collaborate with offensive security teams to develop AI-enhanced red teaming and adversarial emulation capabilities.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that support scalable, well-governed AI integration across GIS security controls.
  • Promote responsible and ethical use of AI in security operations, partnering with model governance stakeholders on bias mitigation and explainability.
  • Act as a technical expert on AI-driven cybersecurity initiatives, advising senior leadership and mentoring engineers and analysts.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying custom models in production.
  • Strong command of machine learning fundamentals, including model training and evaluation (model weights, loss functions, precision, recall, F1, calibration), feature engineering, embeddings, and real-world data issues such as class imbalance, label noise, and model drift. Candidates whose AI experience consists primarily of using generative AI tools, agents, or APIs will not meet this bar; candidates should expect to discuss models they have personally trained and evaluated.
  • Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn, including model evaluation harnesses and experiment tracking.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications and agentic AI systems (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, tool use, orchestration), grounded in the ML fundamentals above.
  • Experience delivering production systems at scale involving data pipelines, model deployment, MLOps, and automation.
  • Experience with enterprise cloud AI development platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI) or equivalent open-source or self-hosted model infrastructure.
  • Working understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals (the attack lifecycle, common attacker techniques, and defensive controls) and of how AI can enhance defensive operations.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and model risk management concepts, such as model validation, explainability, and responsible AI.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, a related quantitative field, or equivalent applied experience; advanced degree (MS/PhD) preferred.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML or AI to cybersecurity problems such as detection engineering, threat hunting, malware analysis, or security automation.
  • Experience working with security telemetry at scale (e.g., EDR, SIEM, network, or identity data).
  • Understanding of offensive security tactics and threat actor behaviors, and of how AI can enhance red teaming, attack path mapping, and threat modeling.
  • Hands-on offensive security experience (e.g., CTF competitions, red team tooling development, or published security research).
  • Experience with the open-source LLM ecosystem (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain), LLM guardrails, and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with adversarial machine learning and AI security risks.
  • Experience with AI-enhanced SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) platforms.
  • Prior work in regulated industries, including model risk and compliance considerations in financial services.

Skills:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Critical Thinking
  • Threat Analysis
  • Cyber Security
  • Data Privacy and Protection
  • Data and Trend Analysis
  • Stakeholder Management

title: FE, Brownfield Project Manager
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

Chevron is accepting online applications for the position through 09/14, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. (GMT - 3).

The Facilities Engineer, Brownfield Project Manager will report to the FE Green Field Projects Manager in Argentina and will be responsible for leading engineering coordination and project execution for the Unconventional Production Development program of El Trapial Field. The position will be oriented mostly to modifications, additions, throughput augmentation, debottlenecking opportunities of facilities in operation.

Will be responsible as Project Manager for the coordination of the Engineering Contractor for technical review of basic and detailed engineering deliverables from vendors and construction contractor, interface with corporate Shale & Tight Standard Design for endorsement of the facilities design. Key interfaces include Green Field Development, Brownfield Plant Improvements, Systems Completion, QAQC and Operations Compression.

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as Company representative in the role of Project Manager with design contractor and construction contractor for the scope of the assigned projects.

  • Coordinate the Engineering Contractor for technical review of basic and detailed engineering deliverables and interface with corporate Shale & Tight Standard Design for endorsement of the facilities design.

  • Oversee project execution scope including construction contract definition and lead the contracting process with support of Supply Chain (SCM).

  • Provide leadership in solving difficult technical problems and demonstrate a high level of competence/proficiency in disciplines within area of responsibility.

  • Coordinate and track the scopes for contracting/purchasing equipment that are provided by the company, and lead for their supply on time according to the construction plan.

  • Contribute significantly to planning and completion of annual programs including the creation of new opportunities during all project phases.

  • Manage project execution and interface with the field construction team.

  • Coordinate the Contractor for conduction of HAZOPS and interface with Process Safety Reliability and Integrity (PSRI) Coordinator and Safety Design Engineers for assurance of a safe design.

  • Identify and resolve engineering deviations; contribute to Management of Change (MOC) processes.

  • Coordinate vendors and technical training for covering the facilities and equipment involved in the facilities scope during the execution phase.

Required Qualifications

We are seeking a highly skilled professional with the following qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.

  • Experience: 5 years in upstream Oil & Gas projects, with background in project management, execution schedules, budgeting, and resource planning.

  • Communication: Fluent in English (written and oral), with strong communication and negotiation skills to align engineering contractors, vendors, and operations teams.

  • Leadership: Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams and coordinating vendors, engineering, and construction contractors.

  • Project Management:

    • Ability to identify project risks early and implement effective mitigation strategies.

    • Skilled in managing scope changes, technical deviations, and maintaining documentation traceability.

    • Proficiency in planning tools for tracking milestones and critical paths.

  • Technical Expertise:

    • Ability to interpret P&IDs, datasheets, and vendor packages for compression systems.

    • Familiarity with industry standards (API, ASME, IEC) and local environmental and safety regulations.

  • Safety & Commissioning:

    • Experience coordinating HAZOPs, PSSRs, and ensuring safe commissioning and startup procedures.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management or Engineering Management certifications.

  • Track record of successful coordination of engineering and construction contractors for Oil & Gas Projects.

  • Experience in Lean Construction practices and integration of digital twin platforms in design and commissioning.

  • Exposition in project execution for Facilities in the O&G upstream industry.

Special Considerations:

  • Based in Buenos Aires at Chevron’s CEL (Centro Empresarial Libertador) office.

  • Frequent travel to El Trapial Field is required for construction inspections, commissioning, startup support, and integration with operating teams.

Relocation Options:

Relocation is not offered for this role. Only local candidates will be considered.

International Considerations:

Expatriate assignments will not be considered.

Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position

title: Product Specialist
description:
About Us

Ediphi offers the most comprehensive cloud-based estimating and preconstruction solution on the market. Our goal is to reduce the time spent in preconstruction, enabling projects to break ground more quickly and estimators to feel more confident in their work.


We started when Michael Navarro, an estimating pro at Suffolk, knew there was a better way than relying on spreadsheet nightmares. He began creating a solution built by estimators, for estimators. He teamed up with Dustin DeVan, founder of BuildingConnected (acquired by Autodesk for $275 million), to launch Ediphi in 2023. With a $12M Series A round led by Norwest Venture Partners and with ongoing participation from Suffolk Technologies, Ediphi continues to grow as a SaaS offering for General Contractors around the country.

About This Role

We're looking for an experienced construction professional who's passionate about pre-construction and enjoys working directly with customers. As a Product Specialist, you'll lead customer implementations from kickoff through adoption, helping customers successfully transition to Ediphi and transform the way they estimate.

Our Sales team shows customers what's possible, our Product Specialists make it a reality. You'll learn how each customer works today, translate their workflows into Ediphi, and serve as a trusted advisor throughout their implementation and adoption journey. If you enjoy solving problems, building relationships, and helping customers succeed, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of construction.

What You'll Do:

  • Learn the Ediphi platform to confidently guide and support customers.

  • Lead customer implementations from kickoff through successful adoption.

  • Build trusted customer relationships and understand each customer's estimating process to help them successfully adopt Ediphi.

  • Deliver engaging training and guide customers through change with confidence.

  • Manage implementation timelines, milestones, and customer expectations.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success Managers to drive adoption and long-term customer success.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Data and Support to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

  • Track customer progress, capture feedback, and advocate for product improvements.

  • Partner with the Makers team to test new features and provide product feedback.

  • Travel to customer sites for implementations, training, and industry events (approximately 30%).

What You'll Need:

  • 3+ years of experience in construction estimating, preconstruction, or a related industry role.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain new concepts to a variety of audiences.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing customer needs.

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Passion for learning new technology and helping customers adopt new ways of working.

  • Experience training, implementing new software, or working directly with customers is a plus.

Why take on this role?

  • Opportunity for real impact. Help shape the culture, direction, and success of a fast-moving startup.

  • Supportive leadership team. Work with experienced leaders who prioritize your growth and well-being.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and growth potential. Be part of something big, where your contributions have an outsized impact, both professionally and financially.

  • Change an industry while improving how people work. Don’t take our word for it, check out what our customers say about Ediphi.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Unlimited PTO (and we actually encourage you to use it)

  • Health, dental, vision, and life insurance

  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave

  • A phenomenal, remote-first team that deeply cares about creating great products

Join us!

At Ediphi, our values are passion, integrity, curiosity, humility, and openness. If this sounds like a team you'd like to be part of, please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience for this position. We're excited to hear from you!

Building a fantastic product requires building an amazing, diverse team. Diversity in life and perspective is the driver of creativity and innovation! Check back in the future, though, as we grow!

title: Associate Director - CAS AI Analytics Platform Engineering & AI Solutions
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Corporate Audit Services Organization Overview

Corporate Audit Services (CAS) is an independent, objective audit and consulting function driven by a commitment to add value and enhance the operations of Eli Lilly and Company. CAS's mission is to support the company in achieving its objectives by employing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes.

Position Description

This position builds and delivers best-in-class, end-to-end analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric, the foundation of the CAS data platform. Working across the full lifecycle, from data engineering, warehousing, and ELT through semantic models, Power BI, and Fabric apps, the individual creates and evolves a portfolio of Fabric solutions that turn CAS data into trusted, self-service intelligence.

A core focus is building AI Ready Semantic Models, the governed, contextual data layer that grounds Claude and AI agents in trusted CAS data. Partnering directly with CAS audit teams and stakeholders, the individual translates business needs into working solutions, drives efforts to completion, and grows adoption across the function, delivering high-quality, well-governed solutions within the CAS data architecture and data engine standards.

The individual also helps innovate how CAS builds and automates, leveraging Claude Code and beginning to apply agentic frameworks to accelerate development and automate CAS audit and Data Analytics operations. Above all, this is a hands-on builder who thrives on a team of doers, collaborates openly, sets and evolves standards alongside peers, and partners across Finance and the broader Lilly organization to deliver where it creates the most value.

Success in this role is as much about how the work gets done as what gets built. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on team of builders who share openly, support one another, and put the team's success first. The individual brings an ownership mindset and a high personal bar, communicates with clarity and empathy, stays humble and curious, and builds trust across CAS and its partners, contributing to a positive culture where people do their best work.

Primary Position Responsibilities

Fabric Data Engineering & ELT

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, spanning lakehouses, warehouses, and a medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers).

  • Engineer the full ELT lifecycle, building ingestion, transformation, and refresh pipelines with Fabric notebooks and configuration-driven frameworks that are scalable, reusable, and maintainable.

  • Build and maintain data orchestration across solutions, coordinating pipelines, dependencies, scheduling, and refresh.

  • Refactor and migrate existing solutions onto the Fabric platform, following established governance and deployment standards.

  • Apply CI/CD, Git version control, and automated testing that bring engineering rigor and repeatability to solution development.

  • Uphold and extend the CAS data architecture and governance frameworks, keeping solutions secure, well-structured, and maintainable at enterprise scale.

Semantic Models, Power BI & Fabric Apps

  • Build data engines and semantic models on Fabric to the CAS data engine standards, primarily using Direct Lake, with strong attention to DAX and model performance for governed, high-performance consumption by Power BI, Fabric apps, and Claude.

  • Develop AI Ready Semantic Models, establishing the holistic contextual layer within the semantic model (definitions, relationships, and business meaning) that makes it consumable by large language models and grounds Claude in trusted CAS data.

  • Leverage Claude, MCP, and Claude Code to build and enrich AI Ready Semantic Models and to innovate how CAS delivers AI-grounded analytics.

  • Own Power BI solution delivery, building dashboards, executive visualizations, and reporting that make data accessible and actionable for stakeholders.

  • Innovate new Fabric app solutions, designing and building Fabric-native applications that extend how CAS delivers and consumes data.

  • Architect self-service analytics that enable stakeholders to explore data without ongoing developer support.

  • Establish enterprise deployment patterns, including shared datasets, deployment pipelines, and version control that bring engineering rigor to analytics delivery.

Solution Delivery & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with CAS audit leadership to understand their priorities, workflows, and process pain points, translating them into analytics and automation solutions that measurably improve how audits are executed.

  • Act as a trusted advisor, proactively identifying opportunities to streamline audit processes and bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for requirements.

  • Maintain and evolve a portfolio of Fabric solutions, continuously improving performance, usability, and reliability.

  • Deliver organizational reporting and analytics dashboards for business partners, leaders, and stakeholders.

  • Orchestrate work delivery through Smartsheet, managing intake, prioritization, tracking, and delivery metrics.

  • Operate in an Agile delivery model, driving continuous improvement, adoption, and business value.

Automation & Agentic Innovation

  • Automate CAS audit processes, building automation solutions for auditors that reduce manual effort and improve consistency across audit execution.

  • Automate Data Analytics operations, streamlining intake, delivery, and platform tasks to increase team efficiency and quality.

  • Leverage Claude Code and AI-assisted development to accelerate the build and maintenance of Fabric and automation solutions.

  • Pilot autonomous solutioning, applying agentic frameworks to automate build, testing, and operational tasks as this emerging capability matures.

  • Contribute to the CAS Claude Skill strategy, helping create and maintain reusable skills that encode Fabric, solution, and automation capabilities.

  • Pioneer and help define how agentic approaches evolve into AI-native CAS solutions over time, establishing early patterns the team will build on.

Technical Leadership & Innovation

  • Set, follow, and evolve technical standards alongside the team, contributing best practices, design patterns, and reusable templates to the shared Confluence repository referenced across Data Analytics and CAS.

  • Lead solution design for complex analytics and data challenges, shaping the approach and bringing peers along collaboratively.

  • Own delivery end to end, driving efforts to completion and taking accountability for quality, performance, and outcomes.

  • Contribute to solution and code reviews, exchanging feedback with peers to keep quality, consistency, and governance high across the team.

  • Advance how CAS builds, evaluating and piloting emerging Fabric, analytics, and agentic capabilities and sharing what works so the whole team benefits.

  • Share knowledge and enablement, helping build collective capability on Fabric, semantic modeling, Power BI, and AI tools.

Basic Qualifications / Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in data engineering, analytics, or data solution development within a global, matrixed organization.

  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Skills / Preferences

  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end data solution delivery and setting technical standards that others follow, including through solution and design reviews.

  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (preferred) or a similar cloud data platform, including Lakehouse and warehouse design, medallion architecture, notebooks, and the full ELT lifecycle.

  • Strong semantic modeling proficiency, including advanced DAX, model design, and performance optimization.

  • Power BI and Fabric app delivery as a presentation layer, including dashboards, executive visualizations, and Fabric-native applications.

  • Data engineering languages and tools (Python, PySpark, SQL) and configuration-driven, automated data pipelines across diverse source systems.

  • Power BI and Fabric app delivery as a presentation layer, including dashboards, executive visualizations, and Fabric-native applications.

  • End-to-end solution delivery from requirements through deployment, adoption, and iteration.

  • Stakeholder partnership, translating business or audit needs into working solutions and driving adoption.

  • Process automation experience, building automations that reduce manual effort for business or operations teams.

  • CI/CD, Git, version control, testing, and DataOps for analytics and data engineering.

  • Pipeline monitoring and operational support patterns, including alerting and reliability practices.

  • Exposure to Claude Code, or strong interest in adopting AI-assisted development to accelerate solution building.

  • Interest in agentic AI frameworks and autonomous solutioning, with a desire to help build this emerging capability for CAS.

  • Structured data formats (JSON, YAML) and data-grounding patterns for AI.

  • Data access and security controls to govern data and AI access.

  • Data privacy and AI governance awareness, including responsible AI practices.

  • Regulated enterprise experience with attention to data governance and auditability.

  • Agile delivery methodologies and work-management tooling such as Smartsheet.

title: RNA Automation Specialist (Analytical Focus)
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


RNA Automation Specialist (Analytical Focus)

Location: Shanghai
Job Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated RNA Analytical Automation specialist to design, optimize, and operate cutting-edge automation platforms to enable novel high-throughput RNA therapeutics research workflows. The individual hired into this role will be a mission-critical bridge between wet-lab biology and automation engineering— developing scalable, accurate, and efficient systems covering RNA purification, sample processing, comprehensive QC analysis, and NGS sequencing workflows

The ideal candidate will bring at least 7 years of hands-on RNA analysis experience paired with solid expertise in laboratory automation workflow development and deployment. If you are passionate about transforming biological research through automation, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement validated automation roadmaps for end-to-end RNA analytical workflows, including RNA extraction, RT-qPCR quantification, core QC analysis such as LC-MS detection and characterization.
  • Re-engineer and optimize manual RNA analytical protocols for full automation, reducing manual workload, minimizing human-induced errors, and significantly improving experimental consistency, reproducibility and throughput.
  • Partner closely with RNA analytical chemistry specialists, assay development teams, and process engineers to translate scientific and analytical requirements into robust, stable, and production-ready automated lab solutions.
  • Develop standardized SOPs for automated analytical workflows, and provide professional technical training to lab personnel to ensure compliant, safe, and efficient instrument operation.
  • Integrate, calibrate and operate robotic platforms and automated liquid handling systems to streamline full-process RNA analytical workflows.
  • Collaborate with automation, informatics, and data science teams to build and sustain closed-loop automated experimentation for RNA analytical testing projects.
  • Own end-to-end data quality, experimental reproducibility, and standardized technical documentation; lead continuous workflow iteration and process optimization for automated analytical systems.
  • Establish robust data management strategies and support LIMS system integration to enable full data traceability, standardization and digitalization of automated RNA analysis.
  • Evaluate, benchmark, and deploy emerging automation and analytical technologies to continuously upgrade internal RNA analytical testing capabilities.
  • Ensure all automated workflows and instrument operations fully comply with global lab safety specifications and internal R&D regulatory requirements.
  • Align and collaborate with global LAL teams to establish unified cross-site workflow standards, analytical specifications and quality metrics for automated RNA testing.
  • Maintain regular technical synchronization with global LAL teams; support occasional domestic and international business travel as required.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Molecular Biology, RNA Biology, Biochemistry, or a related life science discipline.
  • 7+ years of hands-on wet-lab experience in RNA analytical research, including RNA extraction, RT-qPCR quantification, siRNA/miRNA characterization and LC-MS-based analytical testing, with proven experience in automation system operation and workflow deployment.
  • Solid understanding of core RNA biology principles, including RNA structural characteristics, stability properties, and key technical pitfalls in RNA sample processing, storage and analytical testing.
  • Proficient in mainstream genomic and transcriptomic analytical tools and platforms, including RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, qPCR, Northern blot, Western blot, and LC-MS, with strong capability in raw data processing and result interpretation.
  • Hands-on experience with mainstream automated liquid handling platforms (Tecan, Hamilton, Labcyte Echo preferred) and independent automation workflow design, configuration and debugging is a strong plus.
  • Excellent protocol design, analytical troubleshooting and optimization capabilities for automated RNA analysis.
  • Practical experience operating and integrating automated analytical instruments, including qPCR systems and LC/MS testing systems.
  • Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis for systematic assay and workflow optimization.
  • Prior working experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D environment is preferred.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication, global collaboration and teamwork skills to support cross-team and cross-site project delivery.

title: Director, Partner Content Strategy
description:

Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make

As Director, Partner Content Strategy, you will lead and evolve Risepoint’s partner content strategy function from the ground up, lead a team of roughly 10 across the Partner Content and Brand teams, and define how partner content strategy connects with every channel team it depends on and serves — SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing — across an 80+ university partner portfolio.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Lead and evolve Risepoint’s partner content strategy function, aligning the operating model, org structure, and workflows for the Partner Content and Brand teams with broader strategy, and partnering with channel teams to align partner content strategy across the portfolio.
  • Integrate evolving SEO, AEO/GEO, and AI search practices into all partner content plans, briefs, and templates. Partner with SEO leadership to co-lead AI search imperatives, testing, and future partner content strategies, ensuring partner content is built to be discovered and cited by both traditional search engines and AI agents.

  • Help evolve new partner content operating models (intake processes, briefing systems, editorial calendars, and prioritization frameworks) that let a lean team scale high-quality, AI-assisted partner content production across an 80+ partner portfolio. Own governance for partner content refresh, archiving, and quality standards.
  • Lead, grow, and develop the Partner Content and Brand teams (~10 people, including two people-manager direct reports).
  • Own adoption of AI-enabled partner content tools, increasing output and speed without sacrificing quality or brand voice.
  • Evolve and own the recurring forums, rituals, and governance (planning cycles, cross-team reviews, shared roadmaps) that keep partner content strategy continuously aligned with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing as those channels evolve.
  • Partner with Analytics to define and implement measurement frameworks to track and optimize partner content performance across search visibility, AI citation/visibility, and enrollment funnel impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • A fully operational partner content strategy function with clear roles, workflows, and regular check-ins across every channel team.
  • Partner Content consistently discovered and cited by both traditional search engines and AI agents, with SEO, AEO/GEO, and AI search practices built into every partner content plan, brief, and template.
  • Partner Content strategy staying aligned with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing as those channels evolve.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Partner Content and Brand teams staffed correctly, structured, and operating against a clear content strategy operating model.
  • Regular optimizations set up with SEO, Paid Media, Lifecycle, Digital Experience, and Field Marketing to keep everyone connected.
  • AI-assisted partner content production workflows implemented and adopted across the team, with clear ownership for ongoing improvement.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

  • 8+ years in content strategy, SEO/AEO-driven content leadership, or digital marketing.
  • 4+ years managing people managers and cross-functional content teams.
  • Experience operating within a large, multi-stakeholder or multi-brand organization.
  • Advanced SEO/AEO/GEO expertise and experience adopting AI content production tools.

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience building or scaling a content operations function from scratch.
  • Background in higher education, EdTech, or multi-brand marketing.
  • Familiarity with CMP, DAM, or AI content tooling at scale.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Senior Security Engineer does at Worldwide

The Senior Security Engineer plays a key role in supporting Worldwide Clinical Trials’ Zero Trust and cloud-first security strategy. Reporting to the Senior Director of Information Security, this role is responsible for leading the implementation, management, and optimization of Zscaler technologies across the enterprise. The Senior Engineer works closely with stakeholders across IT, including Infrastructure and Security Operations to ensure consistent enforcement of access control, data protection, and user experience monitoring through Zscaler platform.

What you will do

Tasks may include but are not limited to:

  • Design, deploy, and manage Zscaler solutions, including:

    • Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA): URL filtering, SSL inspection, cloud firewall, DNS control, CASB, and DLP.

    • Zscaler Private Access (ZPA): Application segmentation, identity-based access, SAML/SSO integration.

    • Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX): End-user performance monitoring and diagnostics.

  • Lead incident response and troubleshooting related to Zscaler, such as DNS categorization issues, SSL decryption errors, or access anomalies.

  • Collaborate with Infrastructure and Security Operations teams to enforce endpoint posture checks, DLP policies, and access control rules across Zscaler platforms.

  • Integrate Zscaler logs and telemetry into SIEM platforms to support threat detection, forensics, and compliance reporting.

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and workflows using Zscaler APIs to support policy enforcement, reporting, and operational efficiency.

  • Conduct maturity assessments and contribute to the Zscaler roadmap aligned to Zero Trust architecture goals.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on Zscaler for cross-functional initiatives, vendor engagements, and system design reviews.

  • Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What you bring to the role

  • Deep understanding of Zscaler architecture, deployment models, and policy frameworks.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, especially in large-scale cloud security environments.

  • Proficiency with automation tools and scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs).

  • Effective communication skills, capable of translating complex technical topics for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with adjacent technologies such as endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), and data loss prevention (DLP).

  • Experience working in regulated industries or supporting compliance requirements such as GxP, HIPAA, or GDPR is a plus.

Your experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field with a minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise security engineering, with at least 2 years directly supporting Zscaler solutions or high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 7 years of experience in enterprise security engineering, with at least 2 years directly supporting Zscaler solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX in a production environment.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security concepts, identity management, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Experience with automation for security operations and policy management using APIs.

  • Zscaler certifications (ZCCA-IA, ZCCA-PA, ZCCP) are highly desirable.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

title: Technology Enablement Analyst
description:
Technology Enablement Analyst

About the Role

The Technology Enablement Analyst helps everyone at Specialized use technology safely, accountably, and productively. The leading edge today is AI enablement, but the role is broader: SharePoint and Atlassian administration, data-privacy and security awareness, and the practical governance that keeps our platforms well understood and well used. Working closely with IT, Cybersecurity, and Legal, this person is the bridge between our platforms and the people who use them.

We are looking for a teacher first. The hardest part of this job is not configuring a platform — it is sitting with a team that has already built its own workaround, understanding why, and bringing them onto a supported path they actually prefer. Roughly half the week is hands-on platform and reporting work; the other half is spent with people, running sessions, coaching teams, and steering Shadow IT back onto sanctioned tools.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You genuinely enjoy teaching — running a Lunch & Learn or walking someone through their first useful AI prompt is the best part of your week, not an interruption to it.

  • You would rather enable than gatekeep, and you get satisfaction from turning a guideline into a practice people adopt willingly.

  • You want your hands on the platforms you teach; credibility here comes from knowing the tools deeply enough to be trusted.

  • You are patient with people and impatient with friction — happy to explain something three times, then go remove the reason it needed explaining.

Key Responsibilities

AI Enablement and Safe Adoption

  • Lead AI enablement and training, including the AI Champions Lunch & Learn series, the AI Bootcamp, and the central training library.

  • Guide teams in safe, responsible, accountable AI use, and operationalize the tiered evaluation model that gates use cases by risk and data sensitivity.

  • Champion prompt-engineering practice and real use cases, and run intake for new ones by business value and risk.

Data Privacy, Security, and Shadow IT

  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Legal to socialize what safe and accountable use means, translating requirements into guidance people can follow.

  • Steer Shadow IT back onto sanctioned platforms, and maintain the sanctioned-tool catalog and request path so the approved option is the easy one.

SharePoint Administration and Governance

  • Own SharePoint site administration, architecture, permissions, and content lifecycle so information stays findable, secure, and governed.

  • Run periodic permission and external-sharing reviews with Cybersecurity, and manage site lifecycle and archival to control storage growth.

Atlassian Support and AI Cost Visibility

  • Serve as backup to the Atlassian Administrator across Jira, Confluence, and Rovo — supporting the platform, not owning it — including license hygiene ahead of renewals.

  • Produce the monthly AI consumption and cost reporting for Global Technology leadership on behalf of the Sr. Manager, System Administration, with variance to budget and the usage evidence behind renewals.

What Success Looks Like

  • Teams across the company use approved AI tools confidently for real work, with adoption measured rather than assumed.

  • New AI use cases are routinely assessed through the tiered evaluation model, so adoption scales without added risk.

  • AI spend is visible, forecast, and managed inside budget, and Shadow IT is materially reduced.

  • SharePoint is well governed, and enablement runs as a documented, repeatable service rather than a set of personal habits.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience administering Microsoft SharePoint, including architecture, permissions, and governance.

  • Strong platform administration background across one or more enterprise SaaS or collaboration platforms — provisioning, permissions and group management, configuration, integrations, and lifecycle management.

  • Scripting and automation capability — PowerShell, Python, or equivalent, working with REST APIs such as Microsoft Graph to automate reporting and administration.

  • Demonstrated AI solution capability: has built practical AI solutions others actually use — Copilot agents, custom GPTs, prompt libraries, retrieval-grounded assistants, or AI-assisted automation — with sound judgment about grounding data, accuracy, and limits.

  • Experience designing and running enablement — training, workshops, onboarding, office hours, or documentation people actually read — with evidence that adoption improved.

  • A track record of gaining voluntary compliance: bringing teams onto supported tools through partnership rather than enforcement.

  • Working knowledge of data-privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible-AI principles, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience administering or supporting Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Rovo.

  • Exposure to security-awareness, data-loss-prevention, or Shadow IT and SaaS-governance programs.

  • Experience building a champions network, community of practice, or internal training curriculum.

  • Power Platform, low-code automation, or SaaS integration experience; relevant Microsoft, Atlassian, security, or AI certifications.

  • Background in system administration or IT operations.
