title: Asset Review Specialist
description:
We’re an award-winning global outsourcer providing contact center and back office services on behalf of our global clients. Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

ASSET REVIEW SPECIALIST

Onsite | Ortigas | Night Shift


Love work that’s precise, high-volume, and directly impacts critical business timelines? As an Asset Review Specialist, you’ll support a North American lien search process by reviewing individual assets, applying detailed business rules, ordering required searches, and keeping files moving toward on-time auction readiness and seller payment.


COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Acquire Intelligence, our mission is to help business work smarter.
We bring together the best people, efficient processes, and automation to help companies grow faster and operate with confidence. Our purpose is to simplify how businesses work, improve performance, and lead meaningful change across the globe. If you’re passionate about making a real impact through innovation and collaboration, Acquire Intelligence is the place to grow your career.


WHY JOIN THE A-TEAM?

Come for a career, stay for the fun!

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

  • HMO coverage for you and your family
  • Epic Yearly Kick-Off Parties with major giveaways
  • Recognition through our Value Awards — we celebrate your wins
  • Real career growth with opportunities for internal promotions
  • Meaningful work with talented and supportive teams

Your future matters:

  • 900+ internal promotions every year
  • Access to 2,700+ leadership training courses

Extra rewards along the way:

  • 14th Month Pay after 5 years of continuous service
  • Employee Referral Program — earn up to ₱42,000 per successful hire

Enjoy work-life balance:

  • 24 Paid Time-Off Credits annually, with leave credits convertible to cash
  • Paid Birthday Leave — celebrate your day your way

ROLE SNAPSHOT

As an Asset Review Specialist, you’ll support a North American asset disposition client’s lien search process across Canada through PPSA ordering and the US through asset review and CSC ordering. Working primarily in Salesforce Lien Hub, you’ll review individual assets, apply detailed business rules to determine what requires searching, and keep every file moving toward on-time auction and seller payment.


This is high-volume, detail-critical, rules-based work with defined service levels, with Canada and the US receiving equal focus. Once your review is complete, files route to the client’s Lien Review team, who carry them through Lien Release, FinOps, and seller payment.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Asset Review & Search Ordering

  • Review the individual assets within each assigned LSS in Salesforce Lien Hub and determine searchable versus non-searchable status per client business rules.
  • Place required searches — PPSA orders for Canada and CSC lien searches for the US — on all searchable assets.
  • Record non-searchable dispositions and maintain the Asset Review change log.

Search Monitoring & Routing

  • Monitor searches through to completion.
  • Route completed results to the client’s Lien Review team and the correct Salesforce queue.
  • Submit search requests accurately and completely the first time, and route immediately on completion.

Priority, Escalation & Communication

  • Work through files in auction-date priority order unless instructed otherwise.
  • Escalate anything that risks on-time seller payment or auction readiness.
  • Meet turnaround and accuracy targets consistently.
  • Communicate professionally with stakeholders via Microsoft Teams.

Performance & Quality Standards

  • Consistently meet published SLAs for business-day turnaround.
  • Maintain 98%+ quality and accuracy across all search and disposition work.
  • Process files in strict auction-date priority and flag risks before they affect seller payment.
  • Keep documentation complete and audit-ready for every exception and non-searchable determination.

A BIT ABOUT YOU

Must-Haves

  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce or a comparable case- or queue-based system.
  • Demonstrated accuracy in high-volume, repetitive data-processing work.
  • Working comfort with Excel for tracking and classification.
  • Ability to follow detailed business rules exactly, without deviation.
  • Availability to work the core shift, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time.
  • Clear, professional written communication skills.

Good-to-Haves

  • Equipment or asset familiarity sufficient to read equipment lists.

CORE VALUES

We’re proud of our diverse global team, all working in a collaborative environment and happy to share these common values:

Curious and Clever: Smart questions spark smart solutions

Entrepreneurial Energy: Think like an owner. Solve like a founder

Fast with Intent: We move fast and deliver real results

Laugh and Learn: We don’t take ourselves too seriously, just our results


What are you waiting for? Come for a career, stay for the fun!

Join the A-Team and experience the A-Life!

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in United States.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
  • Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
  • Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
  • Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
  • Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
  • Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
  • Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
    • Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
    • Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
    • Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
    • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
    • Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
    • Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
    • Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
    • Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours focused on results and impact rather than time spent at a desk.
      • Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
      • 21 days of annual leave plus applicable local bank holidays.
      • Equipment provided to help you perform effectively in your role.
      • Premium access to the product and its features.
      • Opportunity to work on a large-scale consumer product with global reach.
      • Chance to work at the intersection of AI, behavioral science, gamification, and mobile product design.
      • Collaborative environment with significant opportunities to experiment, innovate, and influence the direction of the product.
      • Full-time position within an international and distributed team.

Job Summary:

  • Exposure to restaurant operations or the ability to learn.

  • Must have excellent communication skills, including the ability to speak, write, understand, and read English.
  • Must be able to operate standard serving equipment (salad bar/heating cart, trays, etc.).
  • Must possess the ability to always deal tactfully and professionally with personnel, residents, family members, guests, vendors, and the public.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

title: Drinking Water Plant Operator (Appr. - III)
description:
Position Title:

Drinking Water Plant Operator (Appr. - III)

Job Posting Closing Date:

09/09Provo City is seeking a full-time Drinking Water Plant Operator (Apprentice – level III) to provide skilled maintenance work operating and maintaining the City drinking water treatment plant. This position involves operating and maintaining wells, pumping stations, and other water infrastructure to ensure safe drinking water for Provo City residents. Qualified, civic-minded individuals interested in supporting these services for Provo residents are encouraged to apply.

Job Details

What is the compensation package?

Pay: (G25 - G28) $24.74 -$42.51 per hour (depending on experience)

Provo City offers generous employer-paid health insurance; retirement and pension plans, including 401k and 401k matching; paid leaves, including vacation, sick, holidays, bereavement, and parental leaves; educational assistance; competitive pay; and regular review of compensation practices to remain competitive with the market. Employees also receive great perks: free use of the Provo Recreation Center and Peaks Ice Arena, a Provo Library card, 50% off green fees at Timpanogos Golf Course, a 4/10 work schedule​, and others. For more information about benefits click here.

What are the main duties?

  • Assist with plant operations and processes involving operating and maintaining wells, pumping stations, meter stations, and other water infrastructure, preliminary treatment (coagulation), filtration, disinfection, pH, storage, and distribution.

  • Monitor and take readings on varied outputs (gauges, meters, and controls) associated with maintaining the UPDES permit.

  • Monitor SCADA system.

  • Conduct basic sampling, maintain raw data records, and assist with recordkeeping and process control reports.

  • Assist lab in running basic tests and general cleaning procedures.

  • Perform preventative maintenance, assist with repairs, and perform general maintenance and calibration of equipment, grounds, and buildings.

  • Assist the public and others by responding to emergency calls and guiding plant tours.

  • Under general supervision, independently perform lower-level operator duties.

  • Observe processes, flows, water characteristics, and discharges and identify abnormal conditions.

  • Resolve basic operation issues.

  • Assist others as needed and perform other related duties as required.

Higher level operators are distinguished by increased responsibilities and reduced supervision.

What are the minimum requirements?

At all Levels

  • High School Diploma or equivalent (GED).

Apprentice

  • One (1) year of experience in general construction, maintenance, semi-skilled craft or trade, or work that demonstrates mechanical aptitude.

  • A valid, lawful Driver License.

  • A valid, lawful Commercial Driver License (CDL) is required within 3 months of hire.

Level I

  • One (1) year of professional water/wastewater operator experience.

  • A valid, lawful Commercial Driver License (CDL).

  • A Utah Treatment Grade I (T1) Water Operator Certification.

Level II

  • Two (2) years of professional water/wastewater operator experience OR Utah Treatment Grade I (T1) Water Operator certificate and 4 years of water/wastewater operator experience with Division Director approval.

  • A valid, lawful Class B Commercial Driver License (CDL).

  • Utah Treatment Grade II (T2) Water Operator Certification.

Level III

  • Three (3) years of professional water/wastewater operator experience OR Utah Treatment Grade II (T2) Water Operator certificate and 6 years of water/wastewater operator experience with Division Director approval.

  • A valid, lawful Class A Commercial Driver License (CDL).

  • Utah Treatment Grade III (T3) Water Operator Certification.

What is the selection process?

Applications will be reviewed in the order they are submitted, with the first screening being held seven (7) days after initial posting. Job solicitation may be closed at that time. Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications listed above to be eligible for consideration.

If selected for hire, candidate will be required to successfully pass a drug screen and criminal background check. Non-disclosure may result in dismissal. Applicants with unsatisfactory drug screen results will be ineligible for appointment or application to any Provo City position for a minimum period of six (6) months.

Why Provo City?

Provo is a strong, community-centered city with thriving neighborhoods, dedicated residents, and a deep tradition of service and innovation. We build on these strengths by making city government more transparent and efficient, expanding diverse and affordable housing, revitalizing local business districts, and investing in smarter infrastructure and transportation. By planning growth thoughtfully and managing resources responsibly, we maintain a future for Provo that is vibrant, connected and welcoming for families, students, seniors, and business for generations to come. All of this makes Provo well-managed, friendly, economically vibrant, and livable for people at all stages of life. Visit to learn more!

Provo City is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

title: Vice President Electronics Manufacturing
description:

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, supply chain, sourcing, and operations while influencing senior executives and navigating complex, global business environments.
  • Champion transformation and change management, moving manufacturing capabilities toward more standardized, digitally enabled, scalable, and future-ready operating models.
  • Foster innovation, accountability, technical excellence, customer focus, and continuous improvement across the organization.
  • Contribute to software and configuration integration into late-stage manufacturing environments and help develop capabilities that support flexible product customization.
  • Monitor and improve performance across quality, service, productivity, cost, speed, and reliability while maintaining a strong focus on measurable business outcomes.
  • Travel approximately 25–50% to support global stakeholders, suppliers, customers, and strategic initiatives.

    • Exceptional executive presence and cross-functional influence, with the ability to align product, engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders around a common strategy.
    • Strong strategic communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical and manufacturing concepts into clear, actionable direction.
    • Ability to operate effectively in complex, ambiguous, and globally distributed environments while driving meaningful change.
    • Outcome-driven and customer-focused mindset, with a consistent emphasis on quality, speed, cost, reliability, and business value.
    • Demonstrated talent-development and organizational leadership capabilities, including the ability to build high-performing teams and evolve organizational structures.
    • Willingness and ability to travel 25–50% as required by the role.
    • Ability to frequently exert up to 20 pounds of force and/or continuously exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.

      • Benefits:

title: Research Engineer Intern
description:
Pluralis Research works on Protocol Learning: training and serving large models in a fully decentralized way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem, most recently Agora, a permissionless run that pretrained an 8B model from scratch on consumer GPUs spread over the internet, with no single participant ever holding the full weights (tech report). While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. For the mission in full, read A Third Path: Protocol Learning.

As a Research Engineer Intern you'll work on Agora, our production decentralized training system, alongside the engineers running real multi-node training at scale. Intern projects are well-scoped pieces of our live roadmap, not side experiments: you'll ship real work in week one and own a genuine open problem by the end of your internship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ship a roadmap project: Design, build, and ship a well-scoped project on the Agora roadmap, with a final presentation to the engineering and research teams.

  • Concurrent and parallel systems: Build and improve multiprocessing, async I/O, and threading components inside a production distributed training stack.

  • Training infrastructure: Work hands-on with large-scale training infrastructure across cloud providers (AWS/GCP).

  • Daily production work: Contribute to the production codebase every day, with code review and mentorship from a buddy on the Agora team.

What We're Looking For

  • ML background (required): Current enrollment in, or recent completion of, a Masters or PhD in machine learning, computer science, or a related field. You can keep pace with a research-driven team, not just a strong generalist engineering profile.

  • Strong engineering: Strong Python and PyTorch, and experience building concurrent or parallel systems: multiprocessing, async I/O, threading.

  • Distributed ML exposure: Hands-on exposure to distributed machine learning via internship, coursework, or serious projects, and experience with AWS, GCP, or other hyperscalers.

  • Mission alignment: You believe Protocol Learning is the viable third path for collective, trustless, and sovereign AI.

Nice to Have

  • Top-tier ML publications (welcome, but not required for systems-focused candidates).

  • Open-source contributions to ML frameworks, distributed systems, or networking libraries.

FYI's

  • This is a full-time, fixed-term internship: 3 months, with the option to extend. Australia-based candidates only.

  • We work remotely across the world, with the main teams in Australia and North America. You'll need to be comfortable working across timezones.

  • Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken).

  • Recruiters: we aren't looking for agency support at this time. We'll reach out if we need help.

We are backed by Union Square Ventures and other tier-1 investors, and we are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. Pluralis is unapologetically ideological. We believe AI, and the world, end up on a better path if we succeed in implementing the protocol for intelligence. If this resonates, please apply.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About Fortuna Health

We believe accessing healthcare should be as simple as doing your taxes on TurboTax. But for the millions on Medicaid, it’s not.

People lose coverage because of administrative barriers—like missing a notice and incorrect documentation. 60–70% of disenrollments in Medicaid happen for these procedural reasons. These are avoidable errors caused by fragmented systems, not ineligibility.

Fortuna Health is redefining the consumer experience for Medicaid. We’re helping millions navigate Medicaid end-to-end from eligibility and enrollment to renewing coverage. We're backed by a16z, BoxGroup, YC, and top healthcare angels.

We believe this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to dramatically improve the human condition for 90M people, and we need the help of high-throughput, growth-minded builders to make it happen.

About the role

What you'll do

As an early operations hire at Fortuna, you'll play a critical role in shaping how our company scales. We work fully in-person 5 days a week out of our NYC office, and believe deeply in the value of a focused, supportive, and tight-knit team.

As an Ops Lead, you will be leading efforts across our operations team. Your main responsibilities will be to build and refine the operational engine behind our consumer experience. That means helping strategize how Fortuna enters new states, leading implementations with new clients, and shaping how our product supports thousands of people navigating coverage every month. This is a fast-paced role with outsized visibility, perfect for someone who wants to own problems end-to-end and is energized by complexity, execution, and real-world impact.

This is a role that will likely grow into being a people manager. We're looking for highly driven generalists who can excel across multiple operational functions, while also being excited to lead and develop a team.

What we're looking for

Product Mindset
Our philosophy is that everyone should be product-oriented. We’re fundamentally building a consumer product for the masses. As such, we’re looking for an operations lead who’s motivated by delivering a seamless, user-centered experience. You care more about outcomes than org charts.

Ownership
There's plenty of greenfield, exploratory work to be done. We need someone to be able to take an ambiguous problem and run with it. As we gain traction with specific workflows, we would want you to own that end-to-end.

High Velocity
We are looking for a rockstar operator, someone who is energetic, motivated, and who brings serious focus and passion to everything they do. We need someone who can handle a high-output environment with both speed and detail-orientation.

Respectful Disagreement
We believe it's crucial to be able to openly disagree with anyone on the team. We are looking for someone who doesn't shy away from conflict, but is respectful and empathetic in their approach and always open to different ideas.

Humility
It's important to be able to admit when you're wrong. We are looking for a low-ego teammate who is able to take failures in stride and grow from them.

Requirements

  • 2-4+ years experience in operations or consulting

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity ownership in the company

  • Platinum health insurance plans

  • Free lunch every day

  • All commuter expenses covered

  • $100/month wellness benefit

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401k plan with company match

title: Family Intervention Specialist - Dayton, OH
description:
For over 35 years, Youth Villages has transformed the lives of children and families nationwide through innovative, research-based programs focused on preserving and restoring families.

As a national leader in children’s mental and behavioral health, we serve more than 47,000 youth, young people, and their families annually across 29 states and Washington, D.C. Our proven treatment models drive long-term success in child welfare, juvenile justice, and mental health systems. At Youth Villages, we do what works — partnering with others to expand our impact and advocate for meaningful, lasting change.

We're seeking purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 staff, Youth Villages is committed to investing in and supporting our employees by offering opportunities to build a fulfilling career through professional growth, personal development, and a mission that matters— helping children and families live successfully.

For more information, please visit




Program Overview:

Intercept®, developed by Youth Villages, is an evidence-based intensive, in-home program that focuses on keeping families together by preventing out-of-home placements or facilitating reunification after such placements, including foster care, residential treatment facilities, hospitalization, or juvenile detention centers. It is one of the first programs to receive the well-supported designation from Title IV-E Prevention Services Clearinghouse developed in accordance with the Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) having been shown to reduce out-of-home placements and accelerate permanency for children.

This program serves youth from birth to age 18 who are facing serious emotional or behavioral challenges or have experienced trauma, such as abuse or neglect. Services are provided by highly trained Family Intervention Specialists directly in the family’s home and community–Intercept® is not an office-based program.

Intercept provides intensive, strength-based support tailored to each family’s unique needs, ultimately helping them achieve lasting change through evidence-based mental health interventions, along with the development of new parenting and communication skills.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Family Intervention Specialist:

  • Carries a caseload of 4 to 6 families

  • Holds individual and family sessions with each family 3 times a week, scheduled at the convenience of the families

  • Conducts on-going assessment of youth to determine their needs from a strength-focused, solution-based perspective

  • Attends 3 weekly meetings (individual, team, and clinical consultation) for professional development and quarterly booster trainings to enhance clinical skills

  • Drives up to 60 to 80 miles to meet with families in their homes and communities (additional travel may be required)

  • Collaborates with other providers, case workers, and courts to formulate a collaborative treatment plan

  • Provides on-call crisis support to the youth and family (schedules vary by location)

  • Completes accurate and timely documentation in an electronic medical record system (EMR)

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Additional Information:

  • Schedule is flexible and non-traditional as it is based around the availability of youth and families served.

  • Applicants must possess a current, valid driver’s license, an automobile for work purposes, and proof of auto insurance.

  • Community-based staff will be reimbursed for applicable mileage.

Salary:

$56,000 - $64,000 - Based on education and clinical license

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a social services discipline (preferred)

From food relief to chaplaincy, crisis care to caring for the wellbeing of older people, every moment of connection matters. And it's not just what we do. It's how we do it: side-by-side, with compassion and care.

title: Senior SAS/Python Programmer
description:

Job Title

Senior SAS/Python Programmer

Job Type

Full-time

Location

Bethesda Office - Bethesda, MD 20814 US (Primary)
Remote (Virtual) - US - US

Job Description

About Econometrica, Inc.

Econometrica, Inc., is a research and management organization committed to providing high-quality, cost-effective economic and analytical services for clients in the private and public sectors. Since its founding in 1998, Econometrica has been involved in complex, high-profile contracts for numerous Federal departments and agencies in the healthcare, education, transportation, energy, housing, and finance sectors. Econometrica specializes in research, econometric, analytical, and technical support for our clients, with an emphasis on data science, data analytics, statistics, economic analyses, and program implementation and evaluation services.

The Opportunity

Econometrica is seeking a Senior Programmer to lead the AI-assisted conversion of large legacy SAS codebases into modern SQL- and Python-based cloud computing environments. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is genuinely fluent in both languages: the ideal candidate can read a 3,000-line SAS macro with nested%DOloops,PROC SQLpass-through, and multi-level formats and understand what the equivalent, maintainable Python or SQL implementation should look like.

The selected candidate will use large language models (LLMs) and generative AI tooling as a force multiplier — not as a black box. A central responsibility of this role is designing the workflow that makes AI-assisted conversion trustworthy: decomposing legacy code into translatable units, engineering prompts and context that produce correct output, and building the automated validation harnesses that prove the converted code reproduces the original results to the row and to the decimal. The candidate will work alongside a multidisciplinary team of statistical programmers, data engineers, data scientists, and client stakeholders, and will help establish the conversion patterns, standards, and documentation that subsequent modernization projects reuse.

Tasks may include the following:

  • Assessing and inventorying existing SAS code bases—including DATA steps, PROC SQL, macros, arrays, formats, and complex conditional logic—to determine business logic, data lineage, dependencies, and modernization priorities.
  • Designing, prompting, and iterating on LLM-based conversion workflows to re-engineer SAS programs for Python- and SQL-based cloud environments while avoiding literal "SAS-in-Python" anti-patterns and applying appropriate performance optimizations.
  • Building and running equivalence-testing harnesses that compare legacy SAS output against converted output at scale — row counts, key-level joins, column-by-column value comparison with defined numeric tolerances, distributional checks, and edge-case handling — and documenting every accepted discrepancy with its justification.
  • Refactoring machine-generated code into production-quality, modular pipelines in modern cloud environments, which may include Azure or AWS, and coordinating with the Data Engineering team on orchestration, scheduling, and deployment.
  • Identifying data quality issues surfaced during conversion and developing recommendations on how to resolve them to ensure data completeness, consistency, and accuracy for clients' analytical products.
  • Documenting conversion methodology, mapping logic, validation evidence, and residual risk in a form suitable for client acceptance, audit, and recordkeeping requirements — and preparing plain-language summaries for nontechnical audiences.
  • Mentoring junior SAS and Python programmers on modernization techniques and on the responsible, verified use of AI coding assistants.

Education and Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Five (5) or more years of hands-on experience using SAS for data analytics and reporting.
  • Three (3) or more years of hands-on experience manipulating data in Python, with required proficiency in Pandas.
  • Three (2) or more years of hands-on experience working in a modern cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Two (2) or more years of hands-on experience conducting advanced data analysis in SQL.
  • Ability to independently investigate and lead to completion programming tasks of high complexity, and to independently conduct quality assurance and troubleshoot coding issues.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team setting and to develop effective relationships with clients, consultants, and contractors.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain public trust security clearance.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • SAS Base and Advanced certifications.
  • Certifications in cloud architecture, data engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience converting, refactoring, or re-platforming legacy analytic code, with a documented approach to validating that modernized outputs match legacy results.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows, including code review and documentation.
  • Experience with distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark/PySpark) for large-scale data transformation.

Additional requirements for the position could involve occasional travel relevant to the responsibilities noted above.

Education

Master's or doctorate-level degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, or a related field; OR ten (10) years of applied work experience in one of the same fields.

  • Being part of a dynamic research group that continues to grow.
  • Company-sponsored healthcare plan and optional vision/dental coverage.
  • Excellent training and development opportunities.
  • 401(k) program.
  • Organized social activities.

This position is remote, though candidates may choose to work in Econometrica's office if they are local.

The office is located at a Metro stop in beautiful downtown Bethesda, MD, within walking distance of great restaurants and local fare. We have a typical office setting with a quiet-to-moderate noise level.

Physical Requirements

The physical requirements are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Other instructions and related duties may be assigned by the employee's supervisor.

title: Project Manager-Corporate Office IT & AV Upgrades
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager-Corporate Office IT & AV Upgrades based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact IT infrastructure and audiovisual upgrade projects across corporate office environments nationwide.
You will manage projects from initiation through completion, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
The position combines technical project management, client consulting, construction coordination, and technology delivery.
You will work directly with clients to define scope, budgets, schedules, resources, quality standards, and risk strategies.
The environment is highly collaborative, bringing together architects, engineers, technology teams, vendors, and contractors.
Success requires strong commercial judgment, technical understanding, and the ability to keep complex projects moving forward.
With exposure to diverse projects and stakeholders, this is an opportunity to make a visible impact on modern workplace environments.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage end-to-end project delivery for technical commercial real estate initiatives, including IT infrastructure construction, office relocations, new builds, restacks, technology upgrades, and audiovisual improvements.
  • Partner directly with clients to establish project scope, delivery resources, budgets, cost estimates, schedules, milestones, quality expectations, and risk-management plans.
  • Collaborate with project teams to document IT requirements and define appropriate technology solutions across network, voice/data, wireless, telephony, audiovisual, security, and related infrastructure.
  • Lead resource selection by working with pre-qualified providers, managing requests for proposals, evaluating bids, and recommending vendors, contractors, and other delivery partners.
  • Establish and maintain project documentation governance aligned with client and organizational requirements, ensuring project data is accurate, complete, timely, and well coordinated.
  • Direct architects, engineers, vendors, contractors, and other project contributors by providing clear expectations, mentorship, guidance, and accountability.
  • Develop action plans to maintain project objectives, budgets, schedules, and quality standards, while tracking progress and communicating status, risks, and variances to stakeholders.
  • Identify project threats early and develop mitigation and contingency strategies to reduce or eliminate risks.
  • Apply project management principles and technical knowledge to resolve complex challenges and develop practical, innovative solutions.
  • Mentor colleagues, share subject-matter expertise, build consensus among stakeholders, and promote collaborative decision-making throughout project delivery.
  • Maintain a high standard of professionalism, integrity, service, and excellence while managing client relationships and delivering successful project outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree preferred, with 5–8 years of relevant project management experience; equivalent combinations of education and experience may also be considered.
    • PMP, LEED AP, and/or CCM certification is preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience managing IT construction projects involving network design and setup, voice/data cabling, telephony, wireless infrastructure, audiovisual systems, access control and security monitoring, or sound masking.
    • General knowledge of commercial leases, contracts, construction practices, and the ability to interpret architectural drawings and project documentation.
    • Strong understanding of project planning, budgeting, scheduling, procurement, risk management, quality control, and construction coordination.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, as well as Microsoft Project.
    • Strong client-facing, communication, negotiation, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and manage several project priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
    • Comfortable identifying risks, making informed decisions, resolving conflicts, and building consensus among diverse stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively in changing environments and adapt project plans to evolving client requirements.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.
    • Willingness to travel overnight throughout the United States, with travel of up to approximately 25% depending on project requirements.
    • Ability to accommodate on-site presence requirements that may change according to client needs.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunities to work on diverse, high-profile IT infrastructure, technology, and corporate workplace projects.

title: Retail Crew Lead, Netflix House - Philadelphia

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

You will be expected to lead by example in real-time by supporting the Crew as they move through retail workspaces.

  • Act as the daily front-line supervisor of the retail Crew Members within Netflix House’s Shop, Kiosk, and Annex.

  • Assist with the ongoing presentation of retail displays by implementing the provided visual merchandising guidance.

  • Manage dynamic shift labor needs to ensure the correct number of Retail Crew Members are in place to meet daily attendance volume and event requirements.

  • Foster a culture of safety in all actions.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment

  • Prior experience leading teams in retail within immersive experiences, live entertainment, theme parks, or theatre.

  • A passion for retail experiences that focus on providing outstanding service.

  • Willingness to learn and/or understanding of environmental, health, and safety (EHS) protocols.

  • Ability to inspire and provide feedback to Crew in real-time.

Assists the Manager, Animal Care Operations to ensure that animal facility equipment and overall facility operations are adequate to assure institutional compliance with the regulatory requirements and to promote excellence in the conduct of animal based academic and experimental research protocol execution.


In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop, implement and supervise equitable daily tasks assignments in all areas of the Roger Guindon Hall and Vanier Hall animal facilities to ensure adequate staffing coverage and the smooth running of operations. This includes but is not limited to coordination of cage wash activities, work schedules for species specific husbandry care, veterinary technical nursing and/or experimental treatments to resident animals to ensure appropriate research protocol and housing requirements are achieved, documented and reported. A-27 (the Act) and the University of Ottawa Policy 31 (the Policy).

  • Schedule, assign and implement the sanitation and biosecurity/quarantine protocols within the facilities to preserve and protect animal health and reduce research variables.

  • Assists the Manager, Animal Care Operations in the continuing assessment of operational efficiency, development, implementation and review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) to ensure the highest standards in animal care, optimal operational efficiency and compliance with all regulatory bodies. Identify and communicate directly and promptly to the Manager, Animal Care Operations any issues that may negatively impact animal care and welfare or result in non-compliance with accepted guidelines and standards.

  • Experience in human resource policy administration and team/ conflict management.

  • Demonstrate an ability to gain consensus and achieve collaborations.

  • Experienced with the development of complex work schedules.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Greyspace
description:
SimSpace serves as an AI Proving Ground where organizations can confidently train, test, and outmaneuver adversaries in any environment. Trusted by allied governments, militaries, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide, SimSpace enables adaptive, AI-ready defenses that stay ahead of evolving threats. Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform unifies training, testing, and validation in a realistic, live-fire simulation—helping teams evaluate security investments, optimize performance, and compress cyber readiness cycles from months to days.

Why join SimSpace? We are an organization that is focused on building our culture and mindfully enhancing our atmosphere every day which is why we have collaborated on an integral value system. Our governing philosophy of being Human Centered is deeply embedded within our value system. We apply this philosophy to every one of our internal team members, external clients, and their customers.

How Do We Work? We believe that people are at the center of everything we do. SimSpace fosters a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. That belief shows up in action: in-house training, internal and external learning platforms, cyber conferences, industry events, and dedicated time for skill development. Our people are empowered to shape their careers - and it shows. Year over year, SimSpace consistently outperforms industry benchmarks in internal mobility, promotions, and total rewards growth.

Who Thrives Here? We are a team of innovators, protectors, and problem-solvers. We believe diversity of thought and experience fuels better solutions, and we’re committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve. Whether you’re remote or office-based, you’ll collaborate with talented colleagues across departments and time zones, united by the mission to create a safer digital world.

We invite you to apply today!

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build the operator experience for SimSpace’s internet simulation platform. This engineer will turn the platform’s control-plane capabilities into intuitive workflows for configuring simulated services, registering personas, managing topology, provisioning applications, integrating ranges, and monitoring platform state.

The role will work closely with the backend engineer who owns the control-plane API, event-driven orchestration, persistence, and deployment model. While the primary focus will be building the frontend experience in React and TypeScript, this engineer will also contribute to backend services and integration layers where needed. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving across the stack, translating complex distributed-system behavior into clear user experiences, and building interfaces that remain understandable when operations are asynchronous, long-running, or partially successful.

What you will help build

  • The web-based operator experience for configuring and managing the internet simulation platform across multiple ranges and environments

  • React and TypeScript workflows for creating services, registering personas, managing topology, provisioning simulated SaaS applications, delivering scenario content, and querying platform state

  • Reusable frontend architecture, components, and design patterns that support a growing collection of platform capabilities

  • Integration between the frontend and the control-plane API, including authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time status updates

  • Operational views that make platform state, deployment health, range connectivity, failures, and recovery actions understandable to users

  • Backend endpoints, service integrations, and supporting logic in collaboration with the engineer who owns the control plane

  • Testing and delivery practices that allow the frontend and backend to evolve together without breaking operator workflows

What you will do

  • Design and build the platform’s frontend using React and TypeScript, creating clear workflows for technically sophisticated operators

  • Translate complex platform operations—such as standing up a range, registering a persona, provisioning a service, or updating topology—into intuitive, observable user experiences

  • Build reusable components and frontend patterns for forms, resource configuration, status reporting, validation, error handling, and long-running operations

  • Integrate the frontend with the control-plane API, ensuring API contracts are used consistently and failures are presented with enough context for users to understand and recover

  • Partner with the backend engineer on API design so that frontend requirements, user workflows, and operational needs are reflected in the platform’s interfaces

  • Contribute to backend services and integration layers where needed, including implementing supporting endpoints, evolving data models, and troubleshooting cross-stack issues

  • Develop views for platform health, range connectivity, service lifecycle, operation history, and partial-failure recovery

  • Implement appropriate state-management and data-fetching patterns for a multi-tenant platform with asynchronous and event-driven backend behavior

  • Build automated tests across the frontend stack, including component, integration, and end-to-end coverage for critical operator workflows

  • Improve frontend performance, accessibility, security, and maintainability as the product and engineering team grow

  • Collaborate with product, design, backend, network simulation, and SRE partners to deliver cohesive features across the full platform

  • Help establish frontend development standards, code-review practices, observability, release processes, and documentation for the user experience


Who you are:

  • Strong experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript

  • Experience designing and delivering complex operator interfaces, administrative consoles, infrastructure-management products, or other workflow-heavy applications

  • Strong frontend architecture skills, including component design, application state management, data fetching, routing, forms, validation, and error handling

  • Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful or similar platform APIs

  • An understanding of asynchronous and distributed-system behavior and the ability to represent long-running operations, partial failures, retries, and eventual consistency clearly in a user interface

  • Backend development experience, preferably with Kotlin and Spring Boot, or the ability to become productive in that stack

  • Experience collaborating on API schemas and contracts with backend engineers

  • Strong testing practices across unit, component, integration, and end-to-end testing

  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, secrets handling, and secure frontend development

  • Experience instrumenting applications so that failures can be diagnosed across browser, API, and backend service boundaries

  • Strong product and user-experience instincts, particularly when simplifying technically complex workflows

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work closely with engineers across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and operations

We’re proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your well-being, growth, and success:

  • Compensation. Base monthly pay range: 1,500,000 CRC - 2,500,000 CRC reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

    • Health & Wellness. Private medical, dental, vision, and life benefits.

    • Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

    • Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

    • Ownership Opportunities. Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

    • Continuous Learning. Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

    • Social Connections. Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

title: Team Leader - CRM Operations, Governance & Reporting
description:
Responsible for performing data research and analysis to support business operations including:
•Creating data mining architectures/models/protocols, statistical reporting, and data analysis methodologies to identify trends in large data sets
•Blending historical data from available external and internal data sources
•Data processing, cleaning, analysis, modelling and visualization to identify data patterns and trends to help improve business decision making
•Analysis may be applied to various areas of the business (e.g., Market Economics, Supply Chain, Marketing/Advertising, Scientific Research, etc.)
•Researching and applying knowledge of existing and emerging data science principles, theories, and techniques to inform business decisions
•At higher career levels, may conduct scientific research projects with the goal of breaking new ground in data analytics


Purpose of the Role

The Team Leader - CRM Operations, Governance & Reporting is responsible for leading a team that delivers CRM operational support, reporting services, data governance, and continuous improvement activities in support of the Commercial organisation across Europe.

The role ensures the effective administration and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics CRM, delivering high-quality reporting, analytics, data integrity, and user support services that enable commercial decision making and sales effectiveness.

Acting as a key partner to the European Commercial Centre of Excellence (CoE), Sales Excellence, Sales Leadership, IT, and Global CRM teams, the role drives operational excellence, service performance, standardisation, and continuous improvement across CRM and commercial reporting processes.

The Team Leader is accountable for team performance, stakeholder satisfaction, service levels, governance, compliance, and capability development while fostering a culture of customer focus, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The role also acts as business owner for CRM operational data and reporting requirements, partnering with the commercial data assets, KPI definitions, and governance support scalable analytics and future AI-enabled decision making.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Service Delivery

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for CRM operations, reporting, user support, and data governance activities.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, performance measures, and development plans for team members.
  • Monitor team workload, capacity, and service delivery performance to ensure SLA commitments are achieved.
  • Create a high-performing, customer-focused culture that delivers quality, accuracy, and responsiveness.

  • Define and govern commercial KPI definitions and reporting standards across European markets
  • Prioritize reporting requirements with Commercial Excellence and the Commercial Intellingence Analytics & BI Team.
  • Ensure business definitions and reporting rules are consistently applied across CRM reporting.

CRM Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish and maintain CRM data governance standards, controls, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure data completeness, integrity, consistency, and compliance across all supported markets.
  • Lead regular audits, data quality reviews, and corrective action plans.
  • Define and monitor data quality KPIs and reporting metrics.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance data quality and system effectiveness.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

  • Lead implementation of new CRM capabilities, reporting enhancements, and process optimization opportunities.
  • Support commercial transformation programmes and digital initiatives impacting CRM and reporting processes.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize ways of working across European markets through enhanced data products, automation and emerging AI capabilities
  • Foster a culture of innovation and operational excellence within the team.

Compliance, Risk & Controls

  • Maintain robust controls surrounding CRM access management, data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure remediation actions are completed effectively.

title: Senior Automation Engineer – Central Automation
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Position:

The Senior Automation Engineer – Central Automation serves as the site Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the integration of automated manufacturing processes, data exchange, and centralized management of production information across the LKC automation architecture. This role is distinct from Process Engineering, which owns the design, programming, and troubleshooting of PLC, SCADA, and HMI applications at the equipment/process level. The Central Automation SME instead owns the layer that connects and orchestrates those systems: the flow of recipes, parameters, cycle and batch data, material and process identification, and material handling automation across the site network, ensuring that physical processes and data exchange occur in a consistent, automated, and compliant manner from the plant floor up through site and enterprise systems.

This role requires deep technical understanding of system integration architectures, data historian administration, MES/recipe management, and material handling/identification systems, combined with the ability to troubleshoot cross-system data flow issues that span multiple platforms and vendors.

Responsibilities:

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

Process & Systems Integration

  • Own the integration architecture connecting shop-floor control systems (PLC/SCADA/HMI, owned by Process Engineering) with site-level automation and business systems (MES, historian, LIMS, QMS, ERP interfaces)

  • Design, configure, and maintain data exchange interfaces (OPC UA, MQTT, web services, database interfaces) between control systems and central platforms

  • Serve as the technical owner for recipe management, parameter master data, and centralized batch/cycle report generation and distribution

  • Ensure consistency and integrity of process and material data as it moves across integration layers

Data Historian & Data Management

  • Administer and optimize the site data historian (e.g., OSI PI or equivalent), including tag architecture, data contextualization, and retention strategy

  • Support data analytics and reporting initiatives by ensuring clean, structured, and accessible process data

  • Partner with Data Analytics/IT teams to enable dashboards, trending, and KPI reporting from integrated data sources

  • Maintain data integrity compliance (21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+) across all integrated data flows

Material Handling & Identification Systems Integration

  • Serve as SME for the integration of automated material handling systems (AS/RS, AGVs/AMRs, conveyors, automated warehouse/logistics systems) with production and business systems

  • Own the integration of process and material identification systems (barcode, RFID, vision-based ID) into the site's data and tracking architecture

  • Ensure seamless, automated data exchange between material movement/storage systems and MES/ERP for traceability and genealogy

Technical Leadership & Compliance

  • Act as site SME for Central Automation integration topics, providing technical guidance to Process Engineering, Manufacturing, and IT/OT teams

  • Support investigations, root cause analysis, and change controls related to system integration and data flow issues

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation (functional specifications, data flow diagrams, interface control documents) for integrated systems

  • Support computer system validation (CSV) activities for integration platforms and data historian systems

title: Assistant Athletics Director, Compliance and Academics
description:
Job Description Summary

The Assistant Athletic Director for Compliance and Academic Success serves as the department's lead administrator for NCAA compliance, student-athlete academic success, eligibility certification, and admissions coordination. This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and monitoring systems that support institutional control and ensure compliance with NCAA, conference, and University rules and regulations.

The Assistant Athletic Director provides leadership for academic services and student-athlete support initiatives that promote retention, persistence, graduation, and overall student success. The position serves as a key liaison among Athletics, Admissions, Academic Services, the Registrar's Office, faculty, and campus partners while fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and student-athlete well-being.

This position may also provide sport administration oversight as assigned, including compliance support related to the institution's NCAA ice hockey program.

Essential Duties

NCAA Compliance and Governance

  • Serve as the department's primary compliance administrator and oversee all aspects of NCAA, conference, and institutional compliance.

  • Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously enhance compliance monitoring systems and procedures to support institutional control.

  • Interpret NCAA, conference, and institutional legislation and provide timely guidance to coaches, staff, student-athletes, boosters, and campus constituents.

  • Oversee monitoring activities related to recruiting, eligibility, amateurism, financial aid, awards and benefits, playing and practice seasons, camps and clinics, and personnel issues.

  • Coordinate student-athlete eligibility certification and continuing eligibility processes.

  • Investigate potential NCAA, conference, and institutional violations and prepare reports and corrective action plans as necessary.

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive rules education programming for coaches, staff, student-athletes, and campus stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate compliance records and ensure timely submission of all NCAA and conference reports.

  • Coordinate institutional reviews, audits, NCAA self-studies, conference reporting requirements, and compliance assessments.

  • Collaborate with athletics leadership to identify compliance risks and implement proactive strategies to mitigate those risks.

  • Serve as the compliance liaison for the institution's NCAA ice hockey program, monitoring recruiting, eligibility, financial aid, and sport-specific legislative requirements.

Academics Success and Student-Athlete Development

  • Provide strategic leadership for student-athlete academic support services and success initiatives.

  • Monitor academic progress, retention, eligibility, and graduation outcomes for all student-athletes.

  • Coordinate programs designed to support academic achievement, including study hall, tutoring, academic mentoring, and progress reporting.

  • Serve as a liaison with Academic Services, faculty, department chairs, the Registrar's Office, and other campus partners.

  • Assist student-athletes with academic planning, course registration, degree progress, and NCAA academic eligibility requirements.

  • Monitor degree completion and progress-toward-degree requirements utilizing institutional systems and reporting tools.

  • Identify academically at-risk student-athletes and develop intervention strategies in collaboration with campus partners.

  • Support initiatives that promote student-athlete engagement, leadership development, career readiness, and overall well-being.

  • Work closely with the Faculty Athletics Representative on academic matters and NCAA eligibility certification.

Admissions and Enrollment Coordination

  • Serve as the primary athletics liaison to Undergraduate Admissions regarding prospective student-athletes.

  • Coordinate admissions reviews, academic pre-read processes, and communication regarding priority recruits.

  • Partner with coaching staffs to facilitate admissions and enrollment processes for prospective student-athletes.

  • Maintain comprehensive recruiting and prospect databases to ensure accurate NCAA reporting and tracking.

  • Communicate admissions policies, procedures, and annual profile updates to coaching staffs.

  • Collaborate with Admissions, Financial Aid, the Registrar, and Academic Services to support a seamless transition for incoming student-athletes.

Sport Administration and Department Leadership

  • Provide sport supervision and administrative oversight for assigned programs.

  • Participate in departmental strategic planning, policy development, and student-athlete welfare initiatives.

  • Serve on institutional and departmental committees as assigned.

  • Support athletics events and championship operations as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Athletics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.

  • 2 years of related experience.

  • Preferred 1-2 years of progressively responsible experience in NCAA compliance, athletics administration, academic services, admissions, or a related higher education field.

  • Knowledge of NCAA rules and regulations and demonstrated ability to apply legislative interpretations.

  • Experience working collaboratively across campus departments and with diverse stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.

  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet institutional driving requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree.

  • Experience in NCAA Division II athletics administration.

  • Experience with NCAA compliance software platforms and student information systems.

  • Experience in student-athlete academic support, eligibility certification, or admissions coordination.

  • Experience conducting NCAA rules education and compliance monitoring programs.

  • Prior supervisory or sport administration experience.

Work Environment

  • Typical office setting with extensive sitting and computer work.

  • Ability to travel around campus for meetings and work related events

title: Senior Director, Telecom Media & Technology | Corporate Finance
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

Are you ready to dive into complex business environments and contribute to high-impact recommendations that drive client success?

As a Senior Director you will lead small engagements in formulating strategic recommendations and implementing changes to clients by leveraging your commercial acumen in performing key analysis, connecting it with the bigger picture and distilling recommendations to clients. You will be looked upon by the team as a culture and professional leader who will drive the team’s competence growth and build morale.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Director, you will lead client billable engagements or multiple workstreams on large engagements. You will play a leading role in problem solving through problem structuring with growing depth in sector knowledge. You will manage a small team to gather data, executing analyses and sense checking results to drive meaningful recommendations and high-quality deliverables for our clients

You will lead client meetings and independently manage and grow mid-level client relationships. In addition, you will build internal practice leadership in both sector knowledge, intellectual capital (e.g., white papers, point of views), business development (e.g., proposals), and office leadership.

At FTI Consulting, we believe in an apprenticeship model, where you learn continuously on the job. You should expect to receive regular feedback and proactively implement this feedback to address areas of improvement for both you and the resources you manage providing the opportunity to act as a role model and mentor to junior consultants.

This role demands a combination of strong analytical abilities and problem solving while working under pressure with effective communication and client team management.You are a logical and lateral thinker, who is intellectually curious, highly organized, and effective in your communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and add value in an international environment.

Someone who builds good professional and personal relationships with client teams at senior management levels and someone who is a team player and can work in a truly diverse setting, possessing cultural awareness and can influence and add value to the team.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Business Administration

  • 10+ years relevant post-graduate experience

  • Prior experience in professional services, consulting, investment banking with Telecom, Media & Technology as a focused area

  • Ability to travel to clients and FTI Consulting office(s) as needed

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis; this position will not sponsor applicant for work visas

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters in business and administration

title: Exercise Sciences – Health Across the Lifespan Initiative (HALI) Administrative Director, CFS Professional Faculty
description:
​Job Title: Exercise Sciences – Health Across the Lifespan Initiative (HALI) Administrative Director, CFS Professional Faculty

Posting End Date: October 15, 2026

*NOTE: Last day to apply is Wednesday, October 14, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. MST

Position Start Date: August 15, 2027

Required Degree: PhD, EdD, or other terminal degree related to the applicant’s discipline (MS, MBA, or MHA). The required degree must be completed by the start date.

Experience:

Required:

  • Experience teaching undergraduate and graduate courses in at least one of the following areas: Research Methods and Evidence-based Practices, Exercise is Medicine, Lifestyle and Chronic Disease Prevention, or Exercise Prescription.

  • Experience facilitating high-quality campus and community outreach initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring students in various settings.

  • Experience collaborating with multiple faculty, staff, and community leaders.

Preferred:

  • Experience identifying and developing external funding to provide resources for campus and community initiatives.

Duties/Expectations:

Teaching: 40% of time

Description: The faculty member will teach approximately 12 credits per year from the following existing courses.

  • EXSC 350 Research Methods and Evidence-Based Practices

  • EXSC 360 Exercise is Medicine

  • EXSC 387 Lifestyle and Chronic Disease Prevention

  • EXSC 468 Exercise Prescription

The faculty member will also be encouraged to develop at least one new course in an area that aligns with the (1) professional responsibilities described herein and (2) the faculty member’s educational background and research interests; e.g., Exercise Across the Lifespan, Sport or Data Science, or Aging. The faculty member will also be asked to assist in supporting other department curriculum needs such as student advising and curriculum oversight.

Professional Service: 40% of time

Description: The faculty member will assist current BYU faculty who are working to enlarge the capacity of the BYU Health Across the Lifespan Initiative (HALI) and provide more (1) experiential learning opportunities for BYU students and (2) meaningful service initiatives to our campus community, local communities, and society at large. The BYU HALI will be committed to enlarging campus and community outreach initiatives designed to improve physical, mental, emotional, relational, and spiritual health across all life stages, from children to older adults. These initiatives already stem from four existing entities in the BYU EXSC Department that seek to assist children and adolescents (BYU Strong Youth Project (SYP)), young and middle-aged adults (BYUMove and YBeFit), and older adults (BYU Gerontology). By more closely linking these four EXSC entities under the umbrella of the BYU HALI, increased synergy will result in increased impact. Currently across the BYU SYP, BYUMove, YBeFit, and BYU Gerontology, approximately 170 BYU students (undergraduate and graduate) are receiving experiential learning opportunities annually. We expect that the addition of this faculty member will allow us to provide approximately twice as many experiential learning opportunities for BYU undergraduate students in the following ways.

Related to the BYU SYP, the new faculty member would:

  • Assist in administrative responsibilities associated with ongoing service initiatives and research projects, including service and research projects designed to (1) reduce musculoskeletal injury risk for adolescent athletes and (2) increase accessibility to and benefit from organized sport experiences for underserved elementary school students.

  • Collaborate with proposed position #2 and other faculty in transforming current service initiatives into rigorous research experiences for undergraduate students that, among other positive social outcomes, produce scientific presentations, publications, and grant proposals.

  • Coordinate external fundraising efforts to support all facets of the BYU SYP.

  • Mentor BYU students as they design and deliver digital and physical educational services for youth sports stakeholders.

The BYU SYP now involves approximately 50 BYU students annually, and we estimate that this faculty member’s efforts will double that number.

Related to the BYUMove, the new faculty member would assist in performing administrative responsibilities associated with ongoing BYUMove efforts to:

  • Provide BYU undergraduate students opportunities to serve as exercise mentors to BYU undergraduate student peers.

  • Assist BYU undergraduate students in increasing theoretical knowledge and practical skills associated with exercise prescription and health coaching.

  • Mentor 1-2 graduate students who design and execute research to measure the effectiveness and impact of BYUMove and general physical activity regarding university student thriving.

BYUMove now involves approximately 20 BYU students annually, and we estimate that this faculty member’s efforts will double that number.

Related to YBeFit, the new faculty member would assist in performing administrative responsibilities associated with ongoing YBeFit efforts to:

  • Provide meaningful experiential learning opportunities for BYU undergraduate and graduate students by engaging them directly in the design, implementation, and evaluation of community-based health and fitness programs.

  • Assist BYU undergraduate and graduate students as they apply classroom knowledge in real-world settings, including exercise sessions, health assessments, and interactions with diverse populations, including underserved community members.

  • Support BYU undergraduate and graduate students through hands-on experiences that result in program delivery, communication and leadership skills, and data-informed decision-making experiences, while also gaining exposure to interdisciplinary collaboration and community engagement.

YBeFit now involves approximately 20 BYU undergraduate and graduate students annually and we estimate that this faculty member’s efforts will increase that number by 20.

Related to BYU Gerontology, the new faculty member would assist in providing more BYU students experiential learning opportunities, primarily associated with the Huntsman World Senior Games (HWSG), an annual event that is the largest annual senior games event in the world (more than 10,000 participants). For the past 25 years, BYU’s involvement in the HWSG has resulted in experiential learning opportunities for approximately 80 BYU students per year and we expect that this number would double with the efforts of this new faculty member. More students will be able to:

  • Be trained to conduct health screenings and collect related data at the annual HWSG; e.g., measures of blood pressure, body composition, cardiorespiratory fitness, functional strength, glaucoma, visual acuity, carotid artery ultrasound, hearing, and cholesterol.

  • Assist BYU faculty now involved with the HWSG to more effectively leverage current services into rigorous research experiences for undergraduate students and produce scientific presentations, publications, and grant proposals.

To summarize professional service expectations, this FTE will double the number of experiential learning opportunities for BYU students through BYU SYP, BYUMove, YBeFit, and BYU Gerontology, from approximately 170 to 340.
