title: Clinical Assistant
description:
The Clinical Assistant is responsible for direct care provided to patients and for contributing to efficient operations in the patient care environment. Direct patient care activities include, but are not limited to, obtaining vital signs, meeting the comfort needs of patients, drawing and collecting blood & other samples and assisting nursing/medical staff in performing invasive procedures, such as bone marrow aspirates. Indirect patient care activities include those that support clinic operations such as ordering and stocking clinical supplies and patient education materials, cleaning patient care areas and infusion room, transporting patients and specimens as needed, and monitoring the environment of care.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

  • Greets patients, families, and colleagues promptly in a welcoming and courteous manner. Responds promptly and courteously to requests for assistance from others
  • Ensures proper patient identification by verbally and visually confirming patients’ two identifiers and maintains patient safety, privacy, confidentiality and follows guidelines under HIPAA
  • Obtains and records vital signs, pain screens, weights and heights accurately into the medical record (Epic). Reports changes and/or abnormalities in vital signs; findings that are outside of defined parameters; and changes in patient’s conditions to the nursing/medical staff in a timely manner
  • Obtains specimens (urine, stool, sputum, etc.) and ensures accurate labeling in presence of patient, using two unique patient identifiers. Instructs patients/family members in collecting specimens
  • Performs phlebotomy and EKG as applicable and is competent in the two-patient identifier practice
  • May precept with specific training
  • Assists with unit specific procedural needs as applicable
  • Transports patients, medical records, specimens, blood components, equipment and supplies in accordance with Institute policy
  • Ensures that all patients on schedule are accounted for and communicate with providers/patients and colleagues as to approximate wait times
  • May be required to assist with research specific patient data entry, as applicable
  • Assures that all clinical areas have an adequate stock of medical supplies, equipment, and forms
  • Manages room assignments in order to maintain patient flow. Ability to strategize the day’s workload and make recommendations accordingly
  • Assist with medical record preparation
  • Properly cleans and maintains equipment and patient care environment
  • Safely manages hazards of biomedical waste and chemotherapy waste
  • Maintains a working knowledge of current computer systems used in clinical areas
  • Utilizes Epic to identify patients that require infection control precautions and take appropriate steps accordingly
  • Understands and utilizes the telephone/pager systems, including text paging staff, call system and emergency response system
  • Provides proactive instruction and time expectations to patient and family
  • Communicates patient and family status difficulties and concerns to appropriate staff
  • Works collaboratively with leadership to determine repair needs of equipment and/or future equipment needs of the unit
  • Attends mandatory training and education sessions, completes mandatory annual competency assessments and follows Institute policies
  • Accepts additional responsibilities based on the changing needs of patients, families, staff and unit
  • Recognizes and responds to emergency situations appropriately. Maintains BLS certification
  • Monitors the environment of care with attention to patient safety. Assures compliance with regulatory agency standards

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Self-starter with strong team player abilities
  • Ability to work as an effective member of an interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to function in a busy work setting with patients with complex needs
  • Strong analytical skills, written skills, technical skills, problem-solving skills, attention to details, ability to balance multiple tasks
  • Ability to be organized in a fast-paced environment, prioritize and meet pre-determined deadlines
  • Demonstrates respectful and courteous behavior toward peers, co-workers, visitors and management
  • Demonstrates understanding of special needs and behaviors of age groups of the population served: young adult to geriatric

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

The position requires a high school diploma or GED, with college coursework preferred. Candidates must complete an accredited Medical Assistant Program or have 1 year of experience in a clinical role such as Medical Assistant, Clinical Assistant, Certified Nursing Assistant, Emergency Medical Technician, or a similar role. Nursing students with at least 2 completed clinical rotations in an accredited bachelor’s program may also be considered. Phlebotomy certification may be preferred depending on the location. Additionally, 2 years of equivalent experience in a medical setting is required. The role involves developing technical expertise, applying institutional policies to resolve various issues, analyzing situations of moderate scope, exercising judgment within defined procedures, and building productive internal and external working relationships.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

No supervisory responsibilities. Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.

PATIENT CONTACT: Yes

title: Operator
description:
Operator

Vopak helps the world flow forward. We store the energy of today and tomorrow. But behind our impressive terminals and tanks, it is our people who make the difference. Guided by our culture of Trust, Collaboration, and Courage, we focus on creating an impact that brings the opportunity to grow and to make a real difference. As an Operator, you will play a key role in realizing our ambitions while building both the future of Vopak and your own.

Your Mission

As an Operator, you are responsible for ensuring that all products are loaded and unloaded safely and efficiently. You will perform critical terminal operations tasks as a highly collaborative team member, mitigating risks and supporting seamless, everyday facility operations.

What will you be doing?

  • Loading & Unloading: Load and unload railroad tank cars, trucks, ships, and barges by positioning mechanical load arms, hooking up product hoses, monitoring gauges, and adjusting flow rates.

  • Tank Operations: Ensure correct tank lineup for receipt and delivery operations, manually open and close valves, and ascend/descend ladders to perform manual tank gauging and temperature verification.

  • Quality & Verification: Review operation orders for errors, verifying proper backup, tank selection, and suitability of equipment while completing all associated documentation.

  • Safety & Emergency Response: Champion safety by adhering to all OSHA, U.S. Coast Guard, and environmental (e.g., RCRA) guidelines, responding rapidly to emergencies using appropriate equipment to mitigate damages.

  • Maintenance & Housekeeping: Perform simple maintenance (e.g., small to medium valve/hose change-outs, painting, refilling pump oilers) and maintain facility cleanliness by sweeping and cleaning truck stations and pipelines.

  • Continuous Learning: Actively participate in and complete all assigned safety, environmental, and operational training programs.

Why you’ll love working with us

  • A market-based salary depending on your experience and knowledge, plus attractive bonuses.

  • Various growth and career development opportunities.

  • Group health insurance where Vopak pays 50% of the nominal costs (Medical / Dental / Vision).

  • 401(k) Incentive Savings Plan.

  • Paid Holidays (9 fixed holidays and 2 floating holidays).

  • Basic Life/AD&D Insurance.

  • Tuition Reimbursement.

  • Great atmosphere! Plenty of freedom, room for initiative, and an engaging environment.

  • Want to know more about our great work culture? Follow us on Instagram or check out our stories on LinkedIn.

Does this sound like you?

  • You have a High School Diploma or GED (required) professional and intellectual level.

  • You have relevant work experience in terminal operations (preferred) and must possess a valid state Driver’s License.

  • You are proficient in English (reading, writing, and speaking), with the ability to clearly communicate across the organization and interpret manuals, written instructions, and regulatory documents.

  • You have strong basic mathematical skills (including fractions and conversions used in the petrochemical industry) and possess basic computer and database knowledge.

  • You are highly disciplined and adaptable, with the ability to multi-task, follow through on assignments, and work varying and/or rotating shifts.

  • You possess a strong understanding of general business concepts and environmental regulations, including OSHA standards and RCRA.

Don’t meet all our criteria? No problem! If this role energizes you and our culture feels like a good fit, we warmly invite you to apply anyway.

What energy will you bring? We’d love to meet you!

Together, we help the world flow forward. Apply directly via our website.

Work Environment

(Terminal Employee)

This position requires an employee to be exposed to outside elements. Most extreme elements are heat in the summer months of up to 100°+ and some exposure to cold of generally no less than 0° in the winter months. There will be exposure to various chemicals and compounds, including fumes and smells, some of them hazardous. The employee will enter confined spaces and work in elevated environments, potentially for lengthy periods of time. Employee must be able to wear PPE required by the location. Loud sounds and vibrations will be experienced at times. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. All environments are safe with appropriate PPE.

Physical Demands

(Terminal Employee)

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk (sometimes over long distances and carrying tools weighing up to 15 pounds), crawl, sit, speak, and hear. The employee is required, for extended periods of time, to stand, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; the employee will be required to climb or balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch; must be able to twist around repeatedly. The employee will be required to climb ladders and storage tanks up to 50’ in height. The employee will be required to enter confined spaces and crawl under rail cars or trucks. The employee will lift and/or move up to fifty (50) pounds including overhead; must be able to carry up to 25 pounds over a distance of up to 30 yards. The employee must be able to roll and tip dolly holding 55 gallon trash receptacle. Must be able lift and secure hose flanges; align and connect/disconnect 6” to 8” hoses manually. Must be able to pass a drug and alcohol screen. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to travel by car, truck or other land vehicles.

Work Eligibility

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States. The Company will not sponsor immigration or work visas.

Inclusion & Diversity:

Vopak stores vital products with care. Our commitment to care extends to all our stakeholders, including our own employees, new talents and people in our local communities around the globe. We believe that each individual has the right to be treated with respect and dignity, and to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal opportunities and prohibits discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, political orientation or trade union membership, allowing everyone at Vopak to develop their full potential.

It is Vopak’s policy to employ and administer employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status, or status as a disabled veteran or veteran of the Vietnam Era and in accordance with federal and state civil rights laws.

Accommodations

At Vopak we are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels they belong. To support this, we host several active Employee Resource Groups, including our International, Pride, Women’s and Young Professionals networks.

Vopak is an equal opportunity employer. Everyone is different, and the differences in people allow us to match our ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. That's why we are curious about who you are!

To support qualified individuals with disabilities, we provide reasonable accommodations throughout our application and interview process. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please email us at HR.USA@vopak.com. Please include "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and briefly describe the assistance you need. Note that this inbox is not monitored for application status updates.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin), Blipay
description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

About Blipay

Blipay is Tilt's Brazilian business unit. In Brazil, credit is still decided by a score that summarizes someone's past and ignores their present. We do it differently — using Open Finance and real-time financial signals, we look at people's actual financial lives and say yes to people the traditional market writes off too quickly. Over 1 million customers. Salary advance, FGTS, consignado. Products that put money in people's hands when they need it.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Backend

You'll work close to the product here — no intermediary layer between you and the problem. You're part of the conversation about what to build, you build it, and you watch it reach production. The loop is short and the stakes are real: salary advance, FGTS, and consignado move money in the lives of working people every month, so what you ship has direct consequences for someone. We're looking for a senior backend engineer who takes real ownership of their work, thinks carefully about how systems should behave, and wants to collaborate closely with product, credit, and compliance — not in isolation from them.

This role is remote. The team gathers at our Campinas office twice a year, and as part of Tilt you'll join two global offsites annually — past locations include Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Build and scale the backend systems behind salary advance, FGTS, and consignado lending — with a clear eye on reliability and correctness

  • Develop and refine the APIs that power an instant in-app experience, with the precision those transactions demand

  • Work on the integrations that make payroll-linked and FGTS lending function — systems where uptime isn't optional

  • Collaborate directly with product, credit, compliance, and analytics — your technical perspective shapes the work

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and team standards around quality, security, and operational excellence

  • Share what you know with junior engineers and be the kind of teammate that makes the work better for everyone around you

Why You're a Great Fit

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of meaningful work — if you're close and the rest fits, let's talk

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Java

  • Solid working knowledge of AWS, PostgreSQL, and ECS

  • Experience building consumer-facing systems at real transaction volumes

  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (C1) — part of the Tilt team operates outside Brazil and collaboration happens in English, written and spoken

  • Comfortable using AI-powered development tools as a genuine productivity lever (we use Claude; similar experience transfers)

  • Fintech, lending, payments, or regulated environment experience is a strong plus

Why Blipay

CLT employment with full benefits — health insurance, VR/VA meal allowances, and a home office stipend. Competitive compensation and Tilt equity. Remote-first with a team that spans 14 countries and 12 time zones. Direct access to leadership — good ideas travel fast here, and growth follows contribution, not tenure. And twice a year, the whole company gets together in person somewhere worth going.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

title: Medical Science Liaison – Romandie and Ticino
location: EMEA, CH, Kanton Fribourg, Fribourg, CSL Vifor
description:
Innovative and committed to patients worldwide.

CSL is a global biotechnology leader dedicated to developing and delivering innovative medicines that help people with serious and rare diseases live full lives. Through our businesses, including CSL Behring and CSL Vifor, we provide a broad portfolio of therapies to patients around the world.

For our Medical Affairs Switzerland team, we are looking for an experienced field-based medical professional to join us as

Medical Science Liaison – Romandie & Ticino (100%) (m/f/d)

In this highly field-based role, you will represent Medical Affairs across Romandie and Ticino and build trusted scientific relationships with Thought Leaders (TLs), healthcare professionals (HCPs) and other key stakeholders. Focusing on our Immunology and Nephrology portfolio, you will facilitate high-quality scientific exchange, gather relevant insights from the medical community and contribute to advancing our medical activities.

Working closely with the MSL Lead Switzerland and colleagues across Medical Affairs and other functions, you will act as an important scientific link between CSL and the external medical community. You thrive in a collaborative, matrix environment and enjoy building strong relationships across functions and with external stakeholders. With your scientific expertise, strong interpersonal skills and proactive mindset, you contribute to shared objectives and help foster a culture of collaboration and scientific excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Acquire and maintain an advanced level of clinical and scientific knowledge in the assigned therapeutic areas and disease states related to CSL's products, while maintaining an understanding of the broader product portfolio.
  • Accurately interpret and communicate balanced, factual scientific, clinical and health-economic data, and continuously evaluate new information relevant to CSL's products and therapeutic areas.
  • Identify and engage relevant regional Thought Leaders (TLs) and healthcare professionals (HCPs), building trusted professional relationships and facilitating high-quality scientific exchange.
  • Provide information on CSL's Investigator-Initiated Study (IIS) program in response to unsolicited requests and support the monitoring and communication of progress for approved studies.
  • Gather, translate and communicate actionable, strategy-aligned insights from interactions with healthcare professionals, educational activities and scientific conferences.
  • Deliver approved scientific and educational programs to relevant healthcare audiences.
  • Attend relevant national and international scientific and medical meetings and share relevant scientific developments and insights with internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver approved scientific education and training to relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to special medical projects and cross-functional initiatives as required, working collaboratively within CSL's matrix organization.

Qualifications

  • Advanced scientific degree in Biology, Pharmacy, Medicine, Biochemistry, Life Sciences or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a comparable field-based Medical Affairs role within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining scientific relationships with Thought Leaders, healthcare professionals and other stakeholders within the medical community.
  • Strong scientific communication and presentation skills, with the ability to discuss complex clinical and scientific topics confidently with healthcare professionals.
  • Experience in Immunology and/or Nephrology is highly desirable but not required.
  • Good understanding of pharmaceutical industry requirements, healthcare compliance and the principles governing non-promotional scientific exchange.
  • Fluent French and very good English skills in both written and spoken communication; German skills sufficient for collaboration with internal stakeholders are highly desirable.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and within a complex matrix organization.
  • High degree of independence, flexibility and organizational skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and plan field activities effectively.
  • Willingness to travel regularly throughout Romandie and Ticino, and attend national and international scientific meetings, including occasional activities outside standard working hours.

About this position

  • You will join our Swiss Medical Affairs organization and report directly to the MSL Lead Switzerland. As part of a close-knit MSL team, you will have a high degree of autonomy in managing the Romandie territory while collaborating closely with colleagues across Medical Affairs and other functions in a matrix environment.
  • This is a predominantly field-based position requiring regular travel throughout Romandie and Ticino, and flexibility to align your schedule with healthcare professionals, hospital meetings and scientific events.
  • We support continuous professional development through a structured development approach, with an initial focus on strengthening therapeutic-area and role-specific expertise and opportunities to broaden your responsibilities as you progress within the role.

Interested in this opportunity? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV, employment references and degree certificates.

About CSL Vifor

CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

title: Visual Design Lead, Emerging Creative Live
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About The Opportunity

Come join the Emerging Creative (ECXD) Live creative team at Netflix as we invent what live events look and feel like for a global audience. In this role, you will be a key contributor in building out our design language for live event graphics, directly impacting how millions of fans experience our live moments.

About the Team

We are a team that prioritizes culture just as much as the final product. You’re stepping into an environment where we lean on listening and learning equally, ensuring that every teammate feels supported both in the work and beyond it.

Culture Requirements:

  • Radical Selflessness: We carry ourselves with a dedication to making the work experience as good as possible for everyone involved.

  • Curiosity: We value leaders and teammates who showcase constant curiosity and a "helpful yet independent" point of view.

  • Nimble Collaboration: We expect our team to be nimble and helpful as our properties evolve, riding the line between high-pressure asks and sustainable solutions.

  • Mentorship and Growth: Our highest priority is helping one another grow and expand our influence, acting as consistent educators to those around us.

  • A "We" over "Me" Mentality: We are thoughtful teammates who working tirelessly to set each other up for success

About the Role

We are seeking a Visual Design Lead who is both hands-on and directorial: someone who can get into the work and lead it at the same time. This is a role for a world-builder. Someone who can take our brand DNA and shape it into a fully realized environment that feels immersive and unmistakably Netflix. It isn't only about mastering software, it's about setting a direction sharp enough that everyone building around it lands in the same world, whether you're executing the work yourself or directing it on a sketchpad before a single pixel exists. Build design systems sustainable enough to endure past the moment they were made for, and adaptable enough to flex as new sports, formats, and genres join the Netflix Live slate.

This role also carries the push forward: finding where the technology can go further, not just where it sits today. The work is bigger than any single premium event. It's about helping define how Netflix pushes content within our own platform, not just how it looks in the moment someone's watching.

What You’ll Do

  • Build immersive worlds that expand our brand DNA, whether you make it or direct it.

  • Build design systems that endure and flex as new sports, formats, and genres join the slate.

  • Turn a creative vision into fully realized work, from first sketch to final output.

  • Push where the technology can go further, using new tools to raise the bar.

  • Finish polished work for delivery while building systems the team can build on next.

  • Leverage AI advancements and emerging technologies to speed up workflows and improve the visual quality of our renders.

  • Extrapolate design visions into fully functional 3D assets, ensuring technical excellence from modeling to final render.

About You

  • You move fluidly between doing the work yourself and directing someone else to get there, and you always know which mode the moment calls for.

  • You think in systems, not just deliverables. What you build today still has to hold up as new sports, formats, and genres join the slate.

  • You're pulled toward where the technology is headed, not just where it's comfortable, and you bring the rest of the team with you.

  • Your voice carries in a room: sharp, refined, and decisive enough that senior leadership trusts the direction you set.

  • You lead cross-functional partners toward one vision and can write the brief that captures it, all while running more than one production at a time.

The Must-Haves

  • Proven track record building original creative worlds from a blank page.

  • Real experience leading cross-functional partners toward one shared vision.

  • Presentation chops to sell and defend that vision to senior leadership.

  • Track record managing multiple productions at once without losing your voice.

  • Comfortable writing creative briefs from scratch, capturing brand essence.

  • 10+ years of experience, with a focus on high-end broadcast or cinematic deliverables.

  • Direct partnership with cross-functional leadership, extending a world beyond broadcast into out-of-home, social, or experiential space.

Even Better

  • Familiarity with evolving enterprise design systems at scale.

  • An eye for how work travels across platforms, formats, and time, long after launch.

  • A track record leading other creative directors and designers as a program scales.

Why This Role Matters

Leadership and execution are what this job runs on, because they're what keep our domestic and global slate meeting the world-class bar Netflix members expect. The voice behind that work carries real influence, so it has to be sharp, refined, and decisive. This is a chance to stand at the front of Netflix Live as it takes shape.

title: Sr. Director, Creative Direction - TFT
description:
Game Creative Directors at Riot define and oversee the overall creative strategy for a product. You’ll create inspiring creative direction across experiences that genuinely surprise and delight players. You will help build the product strategy and tie the product’s goals to the target audience. Creative direction is for the team; as the Creative Director acts as the intersection between aesthetics, story, and brand that evokes a visceral response in players. At that intersection you’ll lead with vision and demonstrate incredible taste with a high quality bar.

As a Senior Creative Director, you will be front and center in defining the creative direction of Teamfight Tactics, the world’s largest strategy game. In this role you will help lead a passionate, multi-discipline development team to own the Autobattler genre on PC and mobile by hyper-serving Teamfight Tactics players globally. Game Creative Directors are the most senior creative team leaders who define, communicate, align and maintain the overall creative direction of a product. Game Creative Directors will drive a holistic vision across all aspects of a game, working with every discipline and team to bring that creative vision to life. Game Creative Directors will manage the careers of developers and leaders from many creative crafts (art, audio, narrative, and technical art). You will be fostering a creative culture that focuses on players and delivering quality content.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a creative partner to the Executive Producer (EP) and Game Director, ensuring alignment and parity with product strategy and creative direction.
  • Define, maintain, and communicate the creative vision for Teamfight Tactics in support of the overall game vision.
  • Shepherd the creative direction of the product from concept through completion.
  • Accountable for the consistency, cohesion, fidelity and overall excellence of the total creative experience.
  • Communicate the IP internally and externally in ways that inspire developers and players.
  • Provide a creative and IP lens to product, portfolio, and ecosystem decisions as a member of the Game Leadership Team.
  • Collaborate with production to build and improve processes that support timely, high-quality creative work.
  • Establish & uphold creative direction expectations, feedback philosophies, priorities and quality standards across the product for all creative craft leads.
  • Build and lead a strong creative leadership team representing key creative crafts, including Art, Audio, and Narrative.
  • Ensure creative leadership collaborates effectively across the team, including with product, production, engineering, quality, design, and publishing creative leadership.
  • Be accountable for the hiring, development, performance, growth, and overall culture of creative leaders and direct reports.
  • Ensure performance measurement and best practices are consistent with product leadership and the creative department.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years industry experience in holistic game development process
  • 7+ years of management experience
  • Proven record of driving and delivering quality work in collaboration with art, narrative, audio and design
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience managing multiple direct reports in Lead roles or higher
  • Knowledge of current game development and creative trends

Desired Qualifications:

  • Has shipped multiple full-games as a Creative Director or key Creative decision maker
  • Demonstrated experience, passion for, and understanding of strategy games
  • Experience with stylized multiplatform games, particularly on PC and mobile
  • Experience and passion for the League of Legends IP
  • Experience managing multiple direct reports in Director roles or higher
  • Experience managing franchise level product and creative decisions affecting multiple platforms and diverse audience needs
  • Experience developing a global game with an understanding of different regional gaming cultures
  • Experience collaborating with publishing or marketing teams and driving creative decisions across development and publishing

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. title: Senior Radiation Therapist: Per Diem
description:
The Senior Radiation Therapist, operating under the oversight of the Chief and Lead Radiation Therapists, administers prescribed ionizing radiation treatments following protocols established by the Radiation Oncologist.
This position requires autonomous decision-making capabilities in the execution of sophisticated radiation therapy procedures, demanding both advanced technical expertise and the ability to independently evaluate and respond to complex treatment scenarios. Core responsibilities include: the assessment and precise delivery of prescribed radiation therapy regimens; independent verification and meticulous documentation of treatment records; discretionary implementation of radiation safety protocols; execution of specialized procedures; Training and mentoring staff members and students and self-directed participation in comprehensive quality assurance initiatives.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical Responsibilities:

  • Performs radiotherapy on site at assigned department.
  • Responsible for daily patient care and education. Appropriately involves the patient and their family in care and care decisions. Maintains and demonstrates respect for patient confidentiality and modesty. Explains all treatment and imaging procedures. Arranges daily radiation treatment schedule. Attentive to patient needs and concerns by continuous monitoring of the patient’s physical and physiological response and reactions to treatment and refer patient for appropriate management as needed.
  • Administers radiation therapy treatment accurately and safely, following departmental policy and procedure.
  • Positions and immobilizes patients according to the treatment plan and effectively evaluates images according to standard guidelines. Mobilizes patients using appropriate mechanical assistive devices, such as ceiling lifts and lateral transfer devices, during the provision of patient care.
  • Assesses patient relative data as deemed pertinent to age-specific needs and provides care as described in the department’s policy and procedure manual.
  • Participates in the clinical instruction and evaluation of the Radiation Therapy students. Accurately perform and teach all policy, procedure, and QA measures including New Start and Cone Down chart checks, weekly chart checks, scheduling, treatment procedures, image review guidelines, and billing procedures.

Simulation Procedures:

  • Explains simulation procedure, including the administration of permanent tattoos for set up purposes.
  • Operates equipment and software, including but not limited to CT scanner and software, Treatment planning software (Eclipse), LAP Lasers, IV contrast Power injectors.
  • Create immobilization devices, bolus, and accurately documents set up instructions.
  • Assists and interacts with all departmental Radiation Therapists, demonstrating the ability to answer all questions and details pertaining to simulation to ensure quality treatment.
  • Participates in the IV contrast program, including Patient Screening, and Peripheral IV placement.
  • Administers Oral Contrast.
  • Assists in scheduling/rescheduling appointments, as needed.

Administrative Responsibilities:

  • Assists the Lead Radiation Therapist in the efficient operation of the assigned clinical area. Performs daily QA measures to ensure proficient operation of all imaging and treatment equipment. Performs daily shutdown procedures. Assists in organizing team during equipment failures and notifies patients as well as all functional areas of the department. Assists in resolving clinical problems and difficult set-ups.
  • Assumes Lead responsibilities in the absence of the Lead Radiation Therapist, when requested. Assists the Chief and Lead Radiation Therapist to ensure coverage for meeting attendance and administrative duties.
  • Strives for continuous improvements and technique standardization.
  • Assists with the triage of emergent cases and demonstrates the ability to negotiate the scheduling of emergent cases with other care team members.
  • Accurately performs all new start QA measures, weekly chart checks, patient scheduling, treatment delivery, image review, and billing procedures involving the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
  • Utilizes the Quality Assurance (QA) program to encompass all aspects of treatment, treatment delivery and quality patient care.
  • Accurately documents treatment variances and inconsistencies using the appropriate tools.
  • Practices the QA program of each treatment unit and assists with the instruction of new staff members and students as part of orientation.
  • Responsible for the safe and accurate utilization of all aspects of the electronic medical record (EMR) and Record and Verify system. Accurately documents all treatment delivery information in the EMR.
  • Participates in and appropriately documents the Time Out procedure for every treatment.
  • Assists with orientation, teaching, and instructing new staff, students, visitors, and other staff members who are unfamiliar with the department or specific procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Demonstrated competencies for all procedures performed within assigned treatment and/or simulation areas, including but not limited to 3D, IMRT, Align RT and tattoo less workflows, stereotactic related procedures, Adaptive Radiotherapy and contouring, Craniospinal Radiotherapy, Pediatrics, Total Body Irradiation.
  • Demonstrated ability to care for patients, including acute inpatients, pediatric patients, and pediatric patients requiring anesthesia.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform all aspects of both treatment and simulation.
  • Understands the function of all equipment and software, accessories, treatment policies, procedures, and protocols and applies knowledge appropriately. Including but not limited to CT scanner and software, Treatment planning software (Eclipse), LAP Lasers, IV contract Power Injectors.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the principles of growth and development from all life stages, ranging from infancy to geriatric. Able to assess patient relative data as deemed pertinent to age-specific needs and provide care as described in the department’s policy and procedure manual.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the patient functional mobility assessment tool and mobilizes patients using appropriate mechanical assistive devices, such as ceiling lifts and lateral transfer devices, during the provision of patient care.
  • In-depth knowledge and demonstrated ability to accurately perform all new start QA measures, weekly chart checks, patient scheduling, treatment delivery, image review, and billing procedures involving the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
  • Advanced knowledge of and ability to accurately perform and teach all policy, procedure, and QA measures including New Start and Cone Down chart checks, weekly chart checks, scheduling, treatment procedures, image review guidelines, and billing procedures.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in patient scheduling systems and revenue cycle management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School + Certificate in radiation Therapy or associate’s degree in Radiation Therapy required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Valid Massachusetts State License in Radiation Therapy required.
  • Valid ARRT certification required.
  • Valid BLS certification within 60 days of hire date.

Minimum of three (3) years of continuous clinical experience required

title: Senior Director, Counsel – Litigation, Legal Policy and Strategy
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


The Senior Director, Counsel – Litigation, Legal Policy and Strategy is for a creative, curious, and strategic litigator with impeccable judgment and experience at the intersection of law and policy. This role focuses on litigation, policy engagement, and other advocacy to to foster a legal and administrative environment that supports innovation and ensures that patients can access the medicines they need without undue legal or regulatory impediments. The successful candidate must be energized by an evolving legal and regulatory environment, learn dense and unfamiliar subject matter quickly, collaborate closely with legal and business colleagues, influence cross-functionally including with external stakeholders, and earn the trust of senior business and legal leaders. This is a remote position and reports to the Associate Vice President, Assistant General Counsel – Litigation, Legal Policy & Strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategy — and advise senior leadership and the business — on litigation, policy engagement, and other advocacy addressing the laws, regulations, and trends that shape the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Proactively identify and assess potential new affirmative litigation and advocacy opportunities to advance Lilly’s policy objectives.
  • Provide litigation counsel to Government Affairs, Communications, Regulatory Affairs, Lilly Value and Access on legal policy and strategy priorities, including drafting and reviewing communications, comment letters, and related materials.
  • Manage litigation, government investigations, and other disputes across the portfolio from strategy through resolution.
  • Lead and manage outside counsel, including the development and oversight of reasonable budgets, and coordinate internal efforts to deliver results within them.
  • Engage with key external parties — government agencies, state attorneys general, trade associations, industry, and the outside policy and counsel network — to ensure Lilly’s legal policy interests are represented and advanced.
  • Build and maintain relationships across Lilly’s legal and business functions.
  • Monitor and analyze litigation, enforcement, and policy developments affecting drug pricing, access, and reimbursement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and J.D.
  • Active license to practice law.
  • A clerkship on a federal court of appeals.
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience as a practicing attorney, including managing complex litigation and developing and executing strategy at a global company and/or top law firm.
  • A proven track record of success in complex litigation at both the trial and appellate levels — including taking matters through discovery, dispositive motions, and trial, and briefing and arguing appeals.
  • Experience litigating constitutional claims, statutory and regulatory challenges, and APA matters.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging on complex policy issues and proven ability to master complex new subject matter quickly and exercise sound judgment before becoming a subject-matter expert.
  • Strong client-service orientation and executive presence, including the judgment, poise, and clarity to advise senior leaders and represent the Legal function credibly.
  • Highly motivated and collaborative partner with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with team members, other lawyers, and management across all levels of the company.

  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to

    F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Skills/Preferences:

  • Experience litigating class actions, matters involving state and federal healthcare programs (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, 340B), and fraud and abuse laws (e.g., AKS and False Claims Act).
  • Experience managing litigation within the pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry.
  • Enthusiasm for harnessing artificial intelligence and emerging technology to litigate and practice more effectively.
  • Demonstrated leadership and effectiveness in working with senior leadership.
  • Good judgment and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to influence others.
  • Demonstrated ability to appropriately handle highly confidential information.

We're with you for life’s journey. At Denver Health, purpose isn’t just something we believe in—it’s something we live every day, for life’s journey.

Our Values

Respect | Belonging | Accountability | Transparency

Department

Doula Services

Job Summary

A birth/postpartum doula is a person trained to support families during childbirth and is an integral member of the inpatient birth team. Doulas provide continuous presence, information, emotional support, and physical comfort to a birthing person before, during, and immediately after childbirth. Doula care extends into the postpartum period, supporting breastfeeding and emotional and physical recovery from childbirth.

Essential Functions:
  • Partner with members of the inpatient birth team to identify patients amenable to doula care and services on the labor and delivery and postpartum units (10%)
  • Model and encourage effective communication and support informed decision making (20%)
  • Provide non-medical comfort techniques for labor, including but not limited to positioning and movement, comforting touch, visualization, breathing techniques, affirmation, and aromatherapy (30%)
  • Support and assist breastfeeding initiation (5%)
  • Answer general questions about and assist with non-medical infant care (10%)
  • Support the family and listen as they process their birth experience (10%)
  • Seek to contribute to a culturally aligned, respectful, and positive birthing and postpartum experience (10%)
  • Provide support to the birthing person’s support partner and/or family (5%)

  • High School Diploma or GED Doula training and certification required for birth doula, postpartum doula, or both Required

Work Experience:

Licenses:
  • ICBD-Certified Birth Doula - DAA - Doula Accredited Association (various) Required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and customer service skills
  • Ability to work well in a team of care providers
  • Ability to provide patient support independently and be self-directed
  • Knowledge of comfort measures to promote a sense of wellbeing during labor, birth, and postpartum

title: Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights
description:
Want to join a fast-moving company, work among convivial teams, and take part in the global growth strategy of one of the most prestigious and comprehensive portfolios in the wine & spirits industry? We are looking for a Global Head of Sensory and Technical Insights! You will be based at The Island, our office in central Paris.

Your key missions:

Reporting to the Global Research, Sensory and Analytical Sciences Director, you will lead the development and application of sensory science, technical product understanding and consumer-relevant insights to support innovation, product quality, reformulations and strategic decision-making across our spirits portfolio. As the bridge between consumer understanding, sensory perception, analytical data, product development, quality and brand strategy, you will make sure product decisions are grounded in robust science and translated into meaningful business outcomes – building the capabilities, best practices, expert teams and panels that unlock growth.

Sensory strategy & leadership

  • Define and own the global sensory and technical insights strategy, driving capability development, scientific excellence and business impact across innovation, renovation and quality

  • Shape portfolio decisions by identifying sensory whitespace opportunities, product superiority drivers and emerging consumer preferences

  • Monitor emerging scientific developments and translate them into competitive advantage

  • Drive the development of novel sensory methodologies, predictive approaches and insight-generation techniques

Product & technical insights

  • Lead the generation of technical product insights across spirits categories – whisky, gin, vodka, rum, tequila, liqueurs, aperitifs and low/no alcohol products

  • Translate sensory and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for R&D, marketing, quality, operations and brand teams

  • Support the identification of key product drivers, sensory attributes, flavour profiles and technical levers influencing consumer perception and product performance

  • Connect sensory data with analytical chemistry, processing, maturation, packaging and consumer research to build a holistic understanding of product experience

  • Provide sensory and technical guidance throughout the innovation process, from early concept screening to final product validation

  • Ensure product changes are assessed with appropriate sensory and technical risk evaluation

  • Help protect brand consistency and consumer trust by ensuring sensory-critical attributes are understood, monitored and controlled

Sensory data

  • Drive the adoption of a digital sensory platform, advanced analytics, AI-enabled insight generation and predictive modelling approaches

  • Ensure data quality, governance, accessibility and knowledge management across sensory activities globally

  • Drive the integration of sensory, analytical, consumer, quality and product data to generate deeper technical understanding

  • Define and oversee the development of sensory data models, product landscapes and insight platforms

  • Champion the use of digital tools, sensory software, databases and data visualisation to improve knowledge management and decision-making

  • Translate complex scientific and sensory information into clear narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders

Capability building

  • Build and lead a global sensory and technical insights community of practice, aligning methodologies, capability development and knowledge sharing across sites, brands and business units

  • Lead the development, training, calibration and performance management of sensory panels, including expert, descriptive, discrimination and quality panels

  • Define standards for sensory panel governance, panel reliability, data quality and continuous improvement

  • Ensure consistent application of sensory methodologies across sites, markets and categories

  • Build internal capability through training, coaching, tools and best-practice sharing

Collaboration

  • Partner with R&D, brand, marketing, consumer insights and quality teams to support new product development and reformulation projects

  • Act as the company’s leading expert in sensory and technical insights, influencing strategic decisions at senior leadership level

  • Represent sensory and technical insights in executive reviews, innovation governance forums and strategic portfolio discussions

  • Define and govern global sensory standards for product quality and brand consistency

  • Provide sensory expertise for quality investigations, product changes, supplier transitions, process modifications and market complaints

  • Work closely with blenders and liquid R&D teams

  • Represent the company at industry forums, scientific conferences and external collaborations

Team leadership & development

  • Lead, develop and inspire a team of sensory scientists, technical insight specialists, panel leaders and product researchers

  • Set clear priorities, objectives and performance expectations aligned with business needs

  • Develop and manage the sensory and technical insights budget, prioritising resources, external partnerships, technologies and capability investments

  • Build a culture of scientific excellence, curiosity, collaboration, impact and continuous improvement

  • Coach team members to strengthen their technical expertise, influencing skills and business-partnering capabilities

If you recognize yourself in the description below, don’t wait to apply!

You have:

  • an MSc or PhD in Sensory Science, Chemistry, Flavour Science, Consumer Science or a related scientific discipline (training in sensory statistics, consumer research, flavour chemistry, data science or spirits production is a plus)

  • Significant experience in sensory science, product research, consumer science, technical insights, R&D or product development – ideally within spirits, alcoholic beverages, food, flavour or FMCG

  • Proven experience building and leading global scientific capabilities or centres of excellence

  • a track record of influencing senior leadership and shaping strategic business decisions

Nice to have:

description:

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in Brazil.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
  • Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
  • Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
  • Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
  • Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
  • Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
  • Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
    • Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
    • Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
    • Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
    • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
    • Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
    • Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
    • Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
    • Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours focused on results and impact rather than time spent at a desk.
      • Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
      • 21 days of annual leave plus applicable local bank holidays.
      • Equipment provided to help you perform effectively in your role.
      • Premium access to the product and its features.
      • Opportunity to work on a large-scale consumer product with global reach.
      • Chance to work at the intersection of AI, behavioral science, gamification, and mobile product design.
      • Collaborative environment with significant opportunities to experiment, innovate, and influence the direction of the product.
      • Full-time position within an international and distributed team.

title: Senior Associate Scientist, Bioreactor Process Design
description:
Job Title: Senior Associate Scientist, Bioreactor Process Design

Location: Seattle, WA

About Us:

At Just-Evotec, we believe that curiosity is the spark that drives innovation and success. As a forward-thinking team, we thrive on challenging the status quo, learning from each other, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We're on a mission to create a place where curiosity isn't just encouraged, it’s celebrated.

Are you someone who asks questions, seeks answers, and isn't afraid to go deeper? #BeCureious with us and see where your curiosity can take you!

The Role:

We’re looking for a passionate and curious Associate Scientist to join our team. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might just be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects, collaborate with bright minds, and explore uncharted territories.

As a Senior Associate Scientist at Just-Evotec, you'll have the freedom to ask the hard questions, think outside the box, and find creative solutions that push us forward. It’s a role where your curiosity will fuel both your personal growth and the success of the team.

What You’ll Do:

The Senior Associate Scientist will join a fast-paced, collaborative, and multidisciplinary team to support bioreactor process development (perfusion and intensified fed-batch) at the bench scale for the advancement of low-cost biotherapeutics manufacturing. The successful candidate will be detail- oriented, self-motivated, and efficient in completing hands-on laboratory tasks. Experience with bioreactor equipment operation, cleaning and maintenance, ordering and managing inventory, and organizing workspace and tasks are preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills as well as experience with common software packages (such as Microsoft Office, Google Suite, etc.) are desired. The ideal candidate is curious, creative, engaged, and the type who works well independently and in teams while constantly looking for ways to advance scientific processes and improve technology.

  • Preparing and running bench-scale bioreactors and bioreactor-related equipment (controllers, pumps, autoclaves, etc.) including building and autoclaving bioreactor parts and assemblies as well as assisting with bench-scale bioreactor operations (daily sampling and analytics, cleaning and maintenance, inoculation activities, run preparation, and troubleshooting).
  • Performing mammalian cell culture work in an aseptic hood such as cell passaging and cell banking.
  • Acquiring a high degree of proficiency in bioreactor control systems, software, analytical equipment; maintaining and troubleshooting instruments while maintaining a clean and organized lab space.
  • Serving as a team member or functional area lead for platform client early-stage (FIH) or technology development projects; may also serve as a team member for complex client early-stage (FIH) or late-stage Process Characterization (PC) projects.
  • Designing, executing, and analyzing statistically designed experiments (DOE) with supervision.
  • Documenting best practices and technical results in ELNs, SOPs, summary reports, etc. with minimal supervision.
  • Working with vendors and manufacturers in developing, ordering, and troubleshooting prototypes.
  • Assisting with media and buffer preparation when needed.
  • Potential for weekend work (5-day work week/ 2 days off) and being on-call for critical bioreactor runs.
  • Other tasks as assigned.

Who You Are:

  • BS in Engineering, Biochemistry, Biology, or related field and 2+ years industry experience or MS degree in Engineering, Biochemistry, Biology, or related field with 2-4 years industry experience.
  • Excellent attention to detail and focused when completing technical tasks; able to stay organized and relaxed in complex situations while keeping track of multiple tasks and data.
  • Strong writing skills and efficient at documentation; comfortable communicating with project managers and subject matter experts about processes and technologies.
  • Enthusiastic problem-solver who is self-motivated, able to make and follow through on goals, action-oriented, flexible, and eager to learn and grow their science and technology skill set.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office apps (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds with assistance

Pluses:

  • Experience with aseptic technique and small-scale mammalian cell culture.
  • Experience with upstream and/or downstream bioprocessing equipment, especially perfusion technology.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting scientific or electronic equipment.
  • Experience preparing cell culture media and buffers.
  • Experience with design of experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis.
  • Experience with paper or electronic lab notebooks or other record-keeping methods.
  • Experience analyzing data in tools such as JMP, R, or Python.
  • General understanding of cell biology, fluid dynamics, and biotransport.
  • General understanding of circuits (grounding, power, signal, etc.).
  • Experience working in a cGMP or clean room setting (this job is non-GMP but knowledge of GMP is helpful for process/tech transfer activities).
  • Experience working in retail, service industry, or other environments that require physical work and positive attitude.

Why Join Us:

  • Growth Opportunities: We’re a company that believes in continuous learning and development. Whether it’s professional courses, mentorship, or new projects, we’ll help you grow.
  • Inclusive Culture: We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued, and curiosity is encouraged.
  • Innovative Projects: You’ll have the chance to work on groundbreaking initiatives and cutting-edge technology in an atmosphere where your curiosity is the key to success.
  • A Place for Big Ideas: We don’t just talk about thinking outside the box—we throw the box away. If you’ve got ideas, we want to hear them.

Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind, just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you and how it will shape the future of Just-Evotec.

Let your curiosity guide your career #BeCureious and explore the endless possibilities at Just-Evotec!

The base pay range for this salaried non-exempt position at commencement of employment is expected to be $82,000 to $86,000; Base salary offered may vary depending on individual’s skills, experience and competitive market value. Additional total rewards include discretionary annual bonus, comprehensive benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision and 401k company match, flexible paid time off and paid holiday, wellness and transportation benefits.

Evotec (US) Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, age, disability, genetic information, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or veteran status.
