title: Research Regulatory Coordinator
description:
Location:

Remote Position

Pay Range:

$25.19 - $44.31

Job Description Summary:

Research Regulatory Coordinator is responsible for collaborating with the PI’s and internal and external members of the clinical research team within scope of clinical trial regulatory submission and compliance. Assist in preparing regulatory submissions and maintaining the regulatory files. Coordinate the preparation of regulatory documents for submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or other IRB’s as determined, other internal committees and the FDA as necessary including but not limited to: Initial documents submission; Continuing Reports; Amendments and addendums to research protocols and consent documents and Adverse Event reporting. Collaborate with study team members to perform these duties. Assist in maintaining master regulatory files in accordance with institutional, state and federal regulations.

Demonstrates working knowledge of all facets of role, relevant regulations, and organizational and departmental policies and procedures. Performs other duties and projects as assigned. Performs all duties in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies and procedures.

Primary Key Performance Areas:

KPA 1 – Creates and maintains central regulatory files in accordance with site SOP.

  • Adhere to and maintain working knowledge of practice policies, the Federal regulations, ICH, and GCP guidelines.

  • In compliance with the Code of Federal Regulations under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), assure that patient records will be kept confidential and secure.

  • Maintain the investigative site study files and regulatory binders.

  • Responsible for the preparation of archiving closed studies for long-term storage

  • Collect and maintain study specific documentation (for main and satellite locations as needed) in the appropriate Regulatory Binder as well as the electronic document system including:

    • Create and maintain the Research Delegation of Authority logs and role specific profiles, ensure revised profiles to investigators and research staff as roles and responsibilities necessitate.

    • Create and maintain study-specific FDA Form 1572, ensure form is reconciled and updated as change necessitates.

    • Collect and maintain Financial Disclosure Forms as completed by investigators, escalate reported disclosures to leadership if reported.

    • In collaboration with various departments, maintain historical credentials all current and previous Investigators and research staff, laboratory licenses, CLIA/COLA. Produce as needed for Sponsor/CRO review.

  • Maintain credible documentation by using ALCOAC method (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete).

  • Support GCP and protocol specific training for staff and investigators by:

    • Upload and archive protocol specific training modules for all studies.

    • According to site SOP, distribute training module assignments and maintain documentation GCP training for all research staff and investigators.

KPA 2 – Ensure completion, submission and subsequent distribution of IRB approved documents in accordance with site SOP.

  • Process regulatory documents: initial submission, ongoing required documents for each study, continuing review, study closure procedures in accordance with GCP, ICH/FDA requirements.

  • Process IND safety reports.

  • Prepare and ensure timely reporting and submissions to IRB in accordance to site SOP and federal regulations including:

    • Initial IRB submission and approval is obtained at study activation and maintained in the Regulatory Binder

    • Obtain documentation of IRB approvals, including amendments and revision to study related documents, such as revised informed consents and protocols and maintain in the Regulatory Binder.

    • Complete the IRB Continuing review reports required by the IRB and submit to the applicable IRB. File all correspondence regarding continuing review report submission in the Regulatory Binder.

    • Ensure the process is followed for reporting any Serious Adverse Event (SAE) to the IRB that meets IRB reporting guidelines, as determined by the PI.

  • Notify the Research Coordinators and applicable investigators via email when a new/amended Protocol or ICF has been IRB approved.

    • Ensure research coordinators are provided IRB instructions for reconsenting subjects in timely manner.

    • Review signed ICFs for completeness and notify the Research Coordinator of any discrepancies

    • Maintain internal log of consent versions

  • Maintain a master subject/enrollment list electronically for each study until the study is terminated and records are ready to archive

KPA 3 – Effectively manage monitoring and audit activities according to site SOP

  • Support on-site and remote monitoring activities through:

    • Scheduling and preparing for interim monitoring visits (IMV) by ensuring the Regulatory Binder is complete prior to IMV. When discrepancies are noted during the monitoring visit, work collaboratively with the research coordinator to ensure any noted discrepancies are corrected. Request that the monitor summarize any findings, issues or concerns during the visit in a follow-up letter and note status of resolution.

    • Meet with the Sponsor representative as needed during visits to ensure issues are resolved appropriately and in a timely manner.

    • Maintain the Site Visit Log and ensure monitors complete the log prior to departure.

    • Following the IMV, review monitor report/letters and forward to appropriate staff for review. Ensure all identified issues are addressed prior to the next monitoring visit. Maintain a copy of the letters in the Regulatory Binder

    • Complete daily communication with the Sponsor/CRO and responds within a timely manner

  • Termination and Closeout activities

    • Work with monitor to schedule, prepare, and conduct the Study Termination Visit.

    • Prior to scheduled Study Termination Visit, ensure all study documents are filed and any discrepancies are addressed in a NTF. Send required documents to Sarah Cannon and ensure all electronic documents and reporting systems are final signed.

    • After study closure and all queries have been resolved, ensure files are packaged and archived

  • Prepare for internal and external audits by retrieving all documents and ensuring all study related documents are complete prior to the audit.

  • Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

Position Qualifications/Requirements:

Education:

  • High school education required

  • Bachelors’ degree in Biological Science, Social Sciences, English, or other related field preferred

Certifications/Licenses:

  • Valid state Driver’s License for travel to satellite offices and offsite meetings. Compliance with the company Driver Safety Operations and Motor Vehicle Records Check Policy is required.

Previous Experience:

  • Prior clinical research experience is preferred but not required.

Core Capabilities:

  • Analysis & Critical Thinking: Critical thinking skills including solid problem solving, analysis, decision-making, planning, time management and organizational skills. Must be detailed oriented with the ability to exercise independent judgment.

  • Interpersonal Effectiveness: Developed interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, diplomacy, tact, conflict management, delegation skills, and diversity awareness. Ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential material and sometimes emotionally charged matters.

  • Communication Skills: Good command of the English language. Second language is an asset but not required. Effective communication skills (oral, written, presentation), is an active listener, and effectively provides balanced feedback.

  • Customer Service & Organizational Awareness: Strong customer focus. Ability to build an engaging culture of quality, performance effectiveness and operational excellence through best practices, strong business and political acumen, collaboration and partnerships, as well as a positive employee, physician and community relations.

  • Self-Management: Effectively manages own time, conflicting priorities, self, stress, and professional development. Self-motivated and self-starter with ability work independently with limited supervision. Ability to work remotely effectively as required.

  • Must be able to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities and demands from a variety of stakeholders and sites.

  • Computer Skills:

    • Proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, Power Point, and Outlook expected.

Travel: 0%

Standard Core Workdays/Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

title: Salesforce Architect
description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Salesforce Administrator does at worldwide

The Salesforce Administrator will lead the ongoing development of the Salesforce.com deployment. The successful candidate will have a record of success in improving processes and adoption using the Force.com platform. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with a broad range of functions within the company, including inside and outside salespeople, sales management, proposals, finance, Information Technology (IT), and other subject matter experts to develop and deploy new enhancements to the Salesforce implementation. The Salesforce Administrator will be responsible for executing the day-to-day configuration, support, maintenance, and improvement of the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.

What you will do

  • Own, manage, and drive optimization of the entire Salesforce.com (SFDC) platform

  • Establish and implement best practices regarding system maintenance, configuration, development, testing, and data integrity

  • Understand, analyze, and improve upon business systems in place, as well as integrated applications

  • Work in tandem with company leadership to design, document, build, test, and deploy enhancements to Salesforce custom objects, page layouts, workflows, alerts, reports, and complex dashboards

  • Analyze business requirements and Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) and implement them using Salesforce custom objects, junction objects, master-detail relationships, and lookup relationships

  • Maintain and support custom objects, formulas, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, approvals, and assignment rules

  • Create and manage custom objects, fields, formulas, validation rules, custom workflows, custom flows, custom processes, and approval processes

  • Utilize Salesforce administrator skills to continuously deliver business solutions while maintaining existing Salesforce functionality

  • Partner with management, analytics, and end users to create and manage Salesforce functionality, including workflow rules, data validation, and process builders

  • Test all new functionality before it is added into production

  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) in the discovery and investigation of critical production problems

  • Follow and maintain best practices in change management

  • Evaluate new Salesforce releases to determine functionality requirements and provide detailed information on how changes will apply to all affected departments and users

  • Research changes in upcoming versions of Salesforce.com and other integrated applications and provide recommendations for enhancing sales efficiency and productivity

  • Maintain database integrity and accuracy, including data cleansing and duplicate record management

  • Identify new solutions that will improve sales and marketing effectiveness

  • Manage daily administration of users, profiles, and roles, as well as customization of objects, fields, record types, and page layouts in Salesforce

  • Maintain user roles, profiles, permission sets, security, and access settings

  • Manage operational requests and reporting, including customer analysis and individual views, and troubleshoot issues

  • Work with business insights, business intelligence, and management teams to create dashboards that provide insight into business performance

  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to improve system usability

  • Develop and create customized reports and dashboards in Salesforce

  • Identify solutions to inefficient workflows

  • Maintain required documentation and proactively identify improvement opportunities through systematic measurement and analysis

  • Mentor, teach, and instruct Salesforce users in CRM best practices

  • Work with teams on core operational processes and uses of Salesforce.com (SFDC)

  • Develop training materials and provide training and support to Salesforce users

  • Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What you bring to the role

  • Self-motivated with a tenacious drive for results

  • Demonstrated communication skills, a positive attitude, teamwork abilities, and the ability to achieve established targets

  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective internal and external relationships

  • Understanding of relational databases and data integration tools

Your experience

  • Minimum of five years of professional experience, preferably in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) or healthcare industry

  • Minimum of two years of experience as a Salesforce.com Administrator

  • Salesforce.com Administrator (ADM201 and ADM211) certification

  • Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Developer certifications preferred

  • Proven ability to design and implement new processes and facilitate user adoption

  • Strong understanding of the platform, with the ability to build custom applications, objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce.com best practices and functionality

  • Strong data management abilities

  • Documented history of successfully driving projects to completion

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex requirements

  • Experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, or Contract Research Organizations preferred

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates):


United States of America - $84,000.00 - $167,000.00


The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: Advisor, Center for International Student and Services
description:
Job Description Summary

The International Student & Scholar Advisor is a core member of Bentley’s Center for International Student & Scholar team. The International Student Advisor serves as both a Designated School Official (DSO) and Alternate Responsible Officer (ARO) for international students and scholars. The Advisor performs a wide range of duties to meet the needs of graduate and undergraduate international students including advising students on maintaining lawful status, resolving concerns, orientating new students and scholars, initiating and providing programs for international students. The advisor also supports a caseload of international scholars.

Essential Duties

  • Serves as Designated School Official (DSO) and Alternate Responsible Officer (ARO) for a population of 1000+ international students, scholars, and their dependents in the F and J non-immigrant visa classifications; responsible for performing a variety of SEVIS related processes and functions to update and maintain accurate student and scholar records.

  • Advises student case load via email, in-person meetings, and open advising hours regarding visa-related matters in compliance with the Student & Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP).

  • Issues Forms I-20 and DS-2019 and updates student and scholar immigration records.

  • Develops and implements programs with and for international students including new student orientation, international education week, informational sessions and presentations on regulatory processes, educate the international community, and aid in campus adjustment

  • Works collaboratively with campus partners to support international students and scholars.

  • Assists with drafting mass communications and website updates to students, including but not limited to general reminders about maintaining status, updates to office procedures and changes to immigration policy.

  • Aids in data management and maintenance of office databases and systems.

  • Assists with international scholar intake through document processing, liaising with academic departments, creation of DS-2019s, and facilitating J-1 visa orientations.

  • Manages confidential student records data in accordance with university, FERPA, USCIS, DHS, and DOS regulations.

  • Supervises and coordinates training for the CISS graduate intern.

Other Duties

  • Support divisional programming and student support initiatives, including serving as a BentleyPlus Advisor by attending trainings, facilitating advising sessions and sending follow-up communications to advisees.

  • Other duties, as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required with 1 to 2 years of related experience, preferably in an international student advising office.

  • Evidence of U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency (required to sign immigration documents and DSO / ARO authorization, a standard job responsibility of this position).

  • Experience in a higher education setting or other setting working with international students.

  • Strong understanding of and empathy for the unique needs of international students.

  • Evidence of quick adaptability to technology and systems.

  • Proficiency in planning, organizing, assessing and delivering a wide variety of events for a range of students.

  • Ability to research and analyze information, including government documents and regulations, to solve problems.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including strong writing ability, presentation skills, and the ability to communicate effectively to non-native speakers of English.

  • Ability to balance competing priorities and meet deadlines in a high-pressure environment.

  • Detail oriented, self-directed, and the ability to handle multiple tasks.

  • Ability to work occasional nights and weekends as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or 3-5 years of relevant work experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong IT skills. Experience using batching software (Terra Dotta preferred) or related international student database management and project management tools strongly recommended.

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced office environment with extensive sitting and computer work.

  • Ability to maintain a hybrid schedule, including in-person and remote work.

  • Occasional evening and weekend hours to support office and greater university programming.

Pay Transparency

At Bentley we offer a “total rewards” package designed to attract, motivate, retain, and reward our employees. This includes competitive compensation, robust benefits, career development and opportunities, generous paid time off, workplace flexibility and a positive, engaging employee experience. In alignment with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Act and our commitment to equity and transparency, we’re sharing the salary grade range for this role. title: Technical Product Manager - AI Investing
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

title: CX GTM Project Manager
description:
Aderant is a global industry leading software company providing comprehensive business management solutions for law firms and other professional services organizations with a mission to help them run a better business. We are motivated by a collective desire to drive the legal industry to the forefront of innovation. With over 2,500 clients around the world, including 95 of the top AmLaw 100 firms, we are changing the outside perception of the legal sphere; where there was once resistance to modernization, we are creating a culture that embraces new ideas and technology.

At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the “A”. We bring the “A” to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward.

Our people are our strength.

The CX GTM Project Manager is the on-the-ground pod lead for day-to-day GTM execution. This role runs cadence, tracks milestones, routes blockers, and ensures no phase gate advances without complete sign-off — across the full five-phase journey from Pre GTM through Scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operational cadence of assigned GTM pod(s) across all five phases: Pre GTM, Build, Pre-Launch, Launch, and Scale

  • Own pod-level milestone tracking — every open task has a status, owner, and next action updated daily in the cross-pod tracker

  • Prepare and present the readiness gate package for each phase: checklist completion, open risk items, and sign-off documentation

  • Route blockers to the GTM Manager or SME Pool the same day they are identified — escalation is a core competency of this role

  • Maintain RACI fidelity within the pod: every team member knows their responsibility per phase at all times

  • Facilitate pod retrospectives within two weeks of Scale phase completion and submit findings in the standard format

  • Write a weekly pod health summary: milestone completion rate, open blockers, phase gate outlook, and risks to launch date

  • Flag pods at risk of schedule slip to the GTM Manager at least five working days before the affected gate

What Success Looks Like

  • Zero un-escalated blockers older than 24 hours across all assigned pods

  • Readiness gate packages delivered 48 hours before every gate review — complete, no missing items

  • 100% of assigned pods complete a structured retrospective within two weeks of Scale phase

  • Pod health summaries submitted weekly with zero gaps in the cross-pod milestone tracker

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years in project or program management — PMP, CAPM, or equivalent experience preferred

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with overlapping timelines

  • Strong written communication — able to produce clear, concise milestone summaries and escalation briefs for a senior audience

  • Experience running daily standups, gate reviews, and retrospectives in a structured methodology

  • High attention to detail — comfortable owning a complex checklist with zero margin for missed items

title: Staff Validation Systems Engineer
description:
The role

Wayve’s AI Validation Division builds trust in the Wayve AI Driver for our customers. As a Staff Validation Engineer, you will lead the development, execution, and reporting of validation for ADAS Functions. Collaborating with systems engineers and data scientists, you will leverage Wayve’s unique simulation and evaluation technology, and meet emerging AV industry standards as autonomy transitions to fully end-to-end learned models—helping bring the Wayve AI Driver to millions globally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive validation strategy across test modalities to assess ADAS Functions that are part of the Wayve AI Driver product.

  • Define and implement general purpose metrics for validating on-road and simulated driving behavior.

  • Define test coverage requirements and build comprehensive test suites.

  • Develop acceptance criteria through collaboration with Product, Safety, and AV Engineering teams.

  • Analyze test results and report findings to Release and Autonomy Engineering stakeholders.

  • Identify data, simulation, and evaluation team dependencies to enable timely, scalable, and automated validation execution.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, Data, Simulation, and Autonomy leads to design and implement comprehensive yet efficient test strategies.

About you

To succeed as a Validation Systems Engineer at Wayve, you’ll bring the following skills and experience:

Essential

  • Clear, concise communicator with excellent documentation skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in evidence-based decision-making.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating and validating complex engineered systems — whether through simulated scenario development, real-world testing, or both.

  • Experience in the Automotive or AV industries.

  • Proficiency in Python to implement metrics and work with evaluation codebase.

  • Experience with both simulated and physical testing environments for autonomous systems.

  • Experience analyzing and reporting validation results.

  • Demonstrated ownership driving validation concepts from ideation to implementation in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace, or a related field.

Desirable

  • Background in ML, Computer Vision, Motion Planning, or Data Science.

  • Experience in the Automotive or AV industries.

  • Experience with SOTIF and safety validation.

  • Skilled in evaluating and validating learned or adaptive behaviors.

  • Experience with modern AI tools and agentic workflows

  • Experience analyzing large datasets with SQL

  • Deep understanding of driving behavior and how to measure driving performance.

This is a full-time role based in our office in London. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.

title: Regional Director, Los Angeles
description:
About 3i Members

3i is a rapidly growing, invitation-only community of family offices and private investors sharing deals, insights, and networks. With a focus on alternative and off-market deal flow, shared benefits, and investor services, 3i serves as a kitchen table around which highly engaged high net worth individuals can discuss and debate compelling investment opportunities. Our network of 800+ investors has deployed nearly $2 billion through the community over the past few years since launching.

We're looking for a Regional Director based in Los Angeles to serve our local members across Southern California.

Regional Director, Los Angeles (Remote)

The Regional Director at 3i is responsible for ensuring that members derive maximum value from the platform. This is a highly-autonomous, remote role based in Los Angeles that includes both setting the strategy for how to engage and grow the 3i network across Southern California as well as executing that strategy to turn it into reality. You will primarily be responsible for growth in regional SoCal hubs outside of LA, specifically: Orange County, San Diego, and Santa Barbara.

Responsibilities include:

  • Setting the regional strategy

    • Every region/city is unique. You'll get to know the members in your region and understand how the 3i network can best help them achieve their investment, personal, philanthropic, business and career goals

    • You'll be the voice of your members to drive 3i forward in your region

    • You'll set the strategy for member engagement and growth in your region to ensure you're equipped to deliver the power of the organization locally, partnering with the 3i HQ team as well as the region's Executive Director who is also based in LA

  • Member engagement

    • Manage the onboarding process for new members to ensure that they're thoughtfully integrated into the 3i community and can immediately leverage the power of the organization

    • Conduct quarterly check-ins with members to track their progress and ensure they are succeeding as members of 3i

    • Connect members with products that enable them to achieve their goals, such as investing groups, in-person and virtual events, masterminds, curated introductions, deal diligence calls, and more

    • Be the conduit between your members and the 3i investment team, to ensure your members are always aware of deals that match their investment interests

    • Ensure members have a positive experience such that they renew their memberships

  • Member growth

    • Drive the growth strategy for how you will invest in the growth of the 3i network within your region

    • We are a referral-only network so you'll need to be comfortable thoughtfully requesting, qualifying and engaging with referrals from your members, and partnering with other Regional Directors whose members have connectivity to your region

    • Run a sales process to close your prospects in a high-touch way

  • Local community-building

    • You'll build relationships with some of the most interesting and prominent people who live in your region

    • Set an event and engagement strategy for the regional hubs you'll cover in Orange County, San Diego, and Santa Barbara

    • Plan and execute events in your region that build community cohesion and engage members. You'll do this in partnership with our Events team, who handle the actual event logistics. You'll be responsible for identifying the event theme, curating the attendee list, and hosting the events

    • You should enjoy and be comfortable facilitating small curated meals with current and prospective members as well as hosting larger events

About you

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in account management or sales, preferably in the financial or investment industry

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Willingness to regularly travel for in-person meetings and events across Southern California and sometimes to other cities

  • Passion for community, building relationships, and helping people succeed

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation

  • Paid time off – Unlimited vacation

  • Health Coverage — We cover up to $1,000 a month for healthcare premiums

  • 401K plan

  • Cultura com foco na segurança.

Nosso pessoal é proativo, positivo, resiliente e persistente. Se isso soa como você, inscreva-se agora e construa sua carreira com as pessoas que levam energia ao mundo.

description:

The Driver Helper is responsible for safely loading waste, as well as carrying bags and containers to the vehicle for disposal. title: Spring 2027 - Master's Level Paid Internship
description:
For over 35 years, Youth Villages has transformed the lives of children and families nationwide through innovative, research-based programs focused on preserving and restoring families.

As a national leader in children’s mental and behavioral health, we serve more than 47,000 youth, young people, and their families annually across 29 states and Washington, D.C. Our proven treatment models drive long-term success in child welfare, juvenile justice, and mental health systems. At Youth Villages, we do what works — partnering with others to expand our impact and advocate for meaningful, lasting change.

We're seeking purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. With a dedicated team of more than 5,000 staff, Youth Villages is committed to investing in and supporting our employees by offering opportunities to build a fulfilling career through professional growth, personal development, and a mission that matters— helping children and families live successfully.

For more information, please visit




Program Overview:

Youth Villages offers paid internship opportunities for bachelor’s and master’s students across select residential and community-based programs. Placements are determined during the interview process based on availability, academic requirements, and your individual experience.

We collaborate with you and your academic program to design an internship that fits your practicum needs and class schedule to ensure you can obtain course credit. Additionally, internships can serve as a valuable opportunity to gain professional experience beyond an academic requirement. Internships are offered nationwide during the fall and spring semesters, with select locations in Tennessee over the summer semester.

Spots are limited and offers are extended on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged. If you're seeking meaningful hands-on experience with a leading mental health agency, Youth Villages may be the right fit for you!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Master's Level Intern:

  • Shadows counselors in home- and community-based family sessions with Youth Villages staff

  • Carries a reduced caseload and implements interventions

  • Facilitates individual, group, and/or family therapy sessions

  • Utilizes evidence-based practices

  • Attends 3 weekly meetings (individual, team, and clinical consultation) for professional development to help enhance clinical skills

  • Accesses clinical trainings

  • Provides transports to various locations as needed

  • Completes accurate and timely documentation in an electronic medical record system (EMR)

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Additional Information:

  • Schedule is flexible and non-traditional as it is based around the availability of youth and families served.

  • Applicants must possess a current, valid driver’s license, an automobile for work purposes, and proof of auto insurance.

  • Community-based staff will be reimbursed for applicable mileage.

Qualifications:

  • Actively pursuing a Master’s degree in a social services discipline (required)

    • Degrees that can be considered include: social work, drug and alcohol education or counseling, psychology, criminal justice, guidance counseling, or marriage and family therapy (others subject to review)




Youth Villages Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug Coverage and Vision

  • 401(k)

  • Time off:

    • 2 week paid vacation (full-time) / 1 week paid vacation (part-time)

    • 12 paid sick days per year

    • 11 paid holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Mileage & Cell Phone Reimbursement (when applicable)

  • Tuition reimbursement and licensure supervision

  • Growth & development through continuous training

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in Canada.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
  • Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
  • Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
  • Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
  • Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
  • Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
  • Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
    • Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
    • Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
    • Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
    • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
    • Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
    • Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
    • Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
    • Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours focused on results and impact rather than time spent at a desk.
      • Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
      • 21 days of annual leave plus applicable local bank holidays.
      • Equipment provided to help you perform effectively in your role.
      • Premium access to the product and its features.
      • Opportunity to work on a large-scale consumer product with global reach.
      • Chance to work at the intersection of AI, behavioral science, gamification, and mobile product design.
      • Collaborative environment with significant opportunities to experiment, innovate, and influence the direction of the product.
      • Full-time position within an international and distributed team.

title: Software Engineer - Fixed Duration
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Organization Overview At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 39,000+ employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first.

Lilly Small Molecule Discovery is an organization purpose-built to create molecules that make life better for people. We focus on using cutting-edge science and technology approaches that can treat people suffering from diseases with poor treatment options.

  • Demonstrated experience building full stack Django applications in Life Sciences, Biotech, or a similar R&D environment
  • Active GitHub profile with public contributions demonstratinge experience in Python.
  • Experince with relational databases (PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with Django ORM, migrations, and model design
  • Experience with Django REST Framework for API development
  • Experience implementing robust CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Familiarity with ADME assays or compound management systems
  • Knowledge of cheminformatics or pharmaceutical research workflows
  • Strong ability to optimize SQL queries and design efficient schemas for high-throughput data.
  • Knowledge of AWS ecosystems (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.

Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate.

SUMMARY:

The Assistant Director of Communications and Media Relations leads the planning, management and day-to-day operations of East Texas A&M University’s communications function in support of institutional strategy and priorities established by the Chief Marketing Officer.

The position develops communications plans, establishes project workflows, manages staff and resources, works directly with university stakeholders, and leads the editorial planning and institutional storytelling approach across communications functions. The Assistant Director is responsible for moving the communications unit toward established strategic objectives through coordinated planning, execution, measurement, reporting and continuous improvement.

The position oversees media relations, university news and owned media, internal communications, e-communications, crisis and issues communications, and the professional staff responsible for those functions. The Assistant Director also collaborates closely with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure communications efforts are coordinated across channels and contribute to broader university priorities.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Communications Leadership, Planning and Operations

  • Leads the planning, management and day-to-day operations of the university communications function.
  • Translates institutional priorities and communications strategy established by the Chief Marketing Officer into actionable plans, workstreams, assignments and timelines.
  • Develops and maintains communications plans, editorial calendars, project workflows, standards and processes that support efficient and coordinated execution.
  • Works directly with university leaders, colleges, divisions and other campus stakeholders to understand communications needs, clarify objectives, establish priorities and determine appropriate communications support.
  • Leads the university’s editorial planning and institutional storytelling arc across communications functions, ensuring planned editorial, responsive news and communications activities reinforce institutional priorities.
  • Assigns work, manages team capacity and staffing, establishes priorities and ensures projects move efficiently from planning through execution.
  • Monitors progress, results and resource needs and provides regular reporting and recommendations to the Chief Marketing Officer.
  • Uses communications performance, audience insights, stakeholder feedback and operational data to improve plans, workflows and allocation of resources.
  • Leads through empowerment, support and shared achievement by providing staff with clear objectives, appropriate authority, context and resources to succeed.

Media Relations

  • Supervises the university’s media relations function and the Senior Media Relations Specialist.
  • Provides direction and priorities for proactive earned-media efforts, media pitching, faculty-expert placement, external media relationships and response to media inquiries.
  • Ensures media relations efforts support university priorities, institutional reputation and broader editorial and storytelling objectives.

Editorial, University News and Owned Media

  • Leads the university’s editorial plan and storytelling strategy across university news and other owned communications channels.
  • Oversees planned editorial content, responsive and opportunity-driven news, institutional announcements, feature storytelling and other centrally produced university content.
  • Establishes editorial priorities and ensures stories are developed and distributed through the channels and formats most appropriate to the audience and objective.
  • Maintains standards for writing, editing, accuracy, institutional voice and editorial quality across university communications.
  • Oversees the university’s owned media channels within the communications function and ensures they work together as a coordinated system rather than as independent outlets.
  • Maintains the university’s communications lexicon, editorial conventions and related writing standards.

Internal Communications

  • Oversees the university’s internal communications function and the staff responsible for faculty and staff communications.
  • Leads planning for faculty and staff communications, including university announcements, leadership messages, digital publications, newsletters and operational information.
  • Ensures internal communications are coordinated, timely and aligned with institutional priorities.
  • Provides communications support to university leaders and campus partners for significant internal initiatives, organizational changes and other institutional needs.

E-Communications

  • Oversees the university’s e-communications function and the professional staff responsible for digital communications support.
  • Ensures e-communications services effectively support university priorities and the communications needs of partner areas, including Enrollment Management and Philanthropy and Engagement.
  • Establishes priorities, standards and workflows for email and other digital communications supported by the communications team.
  • Coordinates e-communications activity with broader editorial, internal communications and institutional messaging plans.

Crisis and Issues Communications

  • Leads the development, maintenance and regular review of crisis communications plans, protocols and messaging resources for university emergencies, emerging issues and sensitive situations.
  • Coordinates communications execution during crises and emerging issues in collaboration with the Chief Marketing Officer and university leadership.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for media relations during crises, emerging issues and sensitive situations, coordinating inquiries, responses and information flow as appropriate.
  • Monitors emerging issues and recommends communications approaches, messaging, timing and response needs.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Collaborates closely with Web, Content, Creative, Design, Social Media, Brand, Marketing and Analytics teams to ensure communications activity is coordinated across the department.
  • Works with cross-functional teams to align storytelling, messaging, content development, audience strategy and distribution across earned, owned, social and digital channels.
  • Participates in integrated planning for major university initiatives, campaigns and institutional priorities.
  • Helps ensure communications plans can be effectively supported and reinforced across the university’s broader marketing and digital ecosystem.

Supervision

  • Supervises professional staff responsible for media relations, editorial and storytelling, internal communications and e-communications.
  • Assigns and reviews work, establishes priorities and performance expectations, provides coaching and professional development, and completes performance evaluations.
  • Builds a collaborative team environment centered on empowerment, support, accountability and shared achievement.
  • Encourages professional staff to exercise expertise and sound judgment within established priorities and standards.

Performs other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, English, marketing or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Seven years of progressively responsible experience in communications, journalism, media relations, public relations, editorial operations or a related field. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing communications plans. Demonstrated experience in writing, editing, media relations, editorial planning or institutional communications. Experience supervising professional staff or providing significant team leadership. Experience managing multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a complex organization.
  • Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
    • Exceptional writing, editing, verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Strong news judgment and knowledge of journalistic standards, media practices and AP style.
    • Ability to translate strategic objectives into coordinated communications plans and operational priorities.
    • Strong leadership, project management, organizational and staff-management skills.
    • Ability to manage competing priorities, allocate team capacity and maintain effective workflows.
    • Ability to build productive relationships with university leaders, faculty, staff, students, journalists and community partners.
    • Ability to lead editorial planning and identify compelling institutional stories and communications opportunities.
    • Ability to use data, analytics and communications results to evaluate performance and improve future work.
    • Ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion and professionalism during sensitive or rapidly changing situations.
    • Ability to work collaboratively across functional areas and influence outcomes in a complex organization.
    • Ability to work outside regular business hours when emergencies, major announcements or media activity require.
  • Licensing/Professional Certifications: None
  • Physical Requirements: None
  • Other Requirements:
    • This position may require occasional work beyond normal business hours as work requirements indicate.
    • This position must be able to work with confidential or sensitive information and exercise sound judgment in its handling.
    • This position may require occasional travel to other locations and instructional sites.
    • This position’s primary duty station is located in Commerce, TX but may require weekly work at the Dallas educational site.

PREFERRED EDUCATION/ SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing or a related field.
  • Communications experience in higher education, government or another complex public organization.
  • Experience leading an institutional communications, editorial or news operation.
  • Experience with earned media, crisis communications and organizational-change communications.
  • Experience advising leaders and working across multiple organizational units.
  • Familiarity with the Texas media environment and public higher education.

SUPERVISION OF OTHERS:

Responsible for hiring, training and supervising student workers, graduate assistants, staff and support staff

CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE COMPETENCY:

Ability to maintain the security and integrity of critical infrastructure, which may include communications systems, computer networks and systems, cybersecurity systems, electrical grid, hazardous waste treatment system or water treatment system.

WHY WORK AT EAST TEXAS A&M UNIVERSITY?

Competitive Benefits & Work-Life Balance:

  • Employee tuition assistance for master’s and doctoral programs.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability insurance.
  • ETAMU contributes to employee health and basic life insurance premiums.
  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays, plus up to eight hours of paid sick leave and vacation each month.
  • Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS), with optional additional retirement plans (ORP).
  • Physical wellness program and wellness release time for eligible employees.

Career Growth & Development:

  • Access to cutting-edge research opportunities at a designated R2 Research Institution.

Academic Excellence:

  • ETAMU is ranked among the top 30% in five online degree programs and offers national recognized academic programs.
  • Over 140 degree programs, including nationally ranked online and graduate options.
  • First accredited institution to offer a competency-based bachelor’s degree in criminal justice.
  • Distance education offerings in Corsicana, Dallas, Frisco, McKinney, Mesquite, Bryan, and online.

State-of-the-Art Facilities:

  • Work in advanced facilities such as the 113,470-square-foot Nursing and Health Sciences Building, featuring a state-of-the-art simulation hospital and a 1,300-acre agricultural research farm.

Vibrant Campus Life:

  • Engage with over 95 student organizations and 14 NCAA Division I athletic teams, contributing to a thriving campus community.

Prime Location & Growth:

  • Enjoy the benefits of working in rapidly growing regions, with abundant career opportunities at six locations across Dallas and Northeast Texas.

Visit us on our social media:

  • Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and ETAMU News

description:
This is a remote-friendly role. Ideally, candidates will sit in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MA, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI.

At this time, Tapcheck does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas (e.g., H-1B, L-1, TN, etc.). Therefore, candidates must already possess the right to work in the United States without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

About the Job

Tapcheck's Platform organization is building the next generation of our core financial infrastructure across Money Movement, Risk, and the Execution Foundation. We're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager with deep payments and money-movement experience who can step into active work immediately and help us turn complex financial flows into products and platform capabilities that Engineering can build, operate, and scale.

This is not a strategy-only role, and not a requirements coordinator role. You will work directly with Engineering and Product leadership from week one, taking ambiguous problems and existing initiatives, pressure-testing requirements, identifying gaps, making product decisions, and driving them through implementation.

The initial focus will include Payments, ACH and bank rails, Payouts/Disbursements, Repayments, Card, Payment Orchestration, Settlement/Reconciliation, and Risk & Fraud. The role is intentionally broad because the Platform team is working across multiple connected money-movement capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Own product definition for money-movement capabilities, from problem definition through requirements, technical design, launch, and iteration

  • Pressure-test existing requirements and designs across Payments, Repayments, Card, Orchestration, Payouts, Settlements/Reconciliation, and Risk & Fraud, identifying missing requirements, edge cases, conflicting assumptions, and unresolved product decisions

  • Partner directly with Engineering to translate complex business and financial requirements into clear PRDs, functional requirements, workflows, state transitions, API requirements, acceptance criteria, and launch criteria

  • Work at the transaction level when necessary, understanding payment states, processor responses, retries, returns, failures, reconciliation issues, and operational exceptions

  • Help define how money moves through the platform across funding, authorization, debit/credit, processing, settlement, payout, recovery, and exception flows

  • Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Data, Operations, and Engineering to ensure product decisions account for financial correctness, risk, regulatory requirements, operational impact, and customer experience

  • Drive active initiatives including Risk, Payouts, and related Money Movement workstreams

  • Use data and operational signals to identify problems and measure outcomes, including payment success/failure, loss, recovery, payout performance, reconciliation breaks, cost, and operational volume

  • Surface risks and unresolved decisions early, make recommendations, and drive issues to resolution

  • Own the day-to-day product execution needed to keep engineering teams moving: backlog refinement, requirements reviews, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, launch readiness, and post-launch iteration

  • Flex across Platform workstreams as priorities evolve, moving between a payment-rail problem, a payout failure, a reconciliation issue, or a risk-decisioning requirement without needing a long ramp

What You've Done

Required

  • Spent 8+ years in product management, with substantial hands-on experience in payments, money movement, financial infrastructure, fintech, or risk

  • Directly owned payment or money-movement products and flows, personally shipping products involving payment rails, bank transfers, cards, payouts, repayments, payment orchestration, settlement/reconciliation, or transaction risk

  • Built deep expertise in at least one payments or money-movement domain, with the ability to understand the underlying transaction flow and system behavior, not just the customer-facing experience

  • Worked directly with payment rails, processors, banks, or PSPs such as ACH, RTP, card networks/processors, or bank payment infrastructure

  • Translated ambiguous problems into engineering-ready product requirements and worked closely with engineers through implementation

  • Demonstrated strong technical fluency, comfortable discussing transaction lifecycles, state machines, APIs, events/webhooks, retries, idempotency, processor integrations, reconciliation, settlement, and failure handling

  • Used payment, risk, financial, or operational metrics to make product decisions

  • Operated with high autonomy and incomplete information, contributing from week one

  • Communicated effectively in writing and in person across Engineering, Risk, Legal/Compliance, Finance, Data, and Operations

Preferred

  • Worked across multiple areas of money movement, such as ACH/bank rails, cards, payouts, payment orchestration, settlement/reconciliation, repayments, or fraud/risk decisioning

  • Built or operated payment platforms, payment orchestration, routing, multi-processor integrations, or money-movement infrastructure

  • Worked with payment exceptions, returns, retries, reversals, refunds, disputes, reconciliation, or recovery flows

  • Worked with risk/fraud decisioning engines or financial controls

  • Worked in Earned Wage Access, consumer lending, wage advance, payroll, or adjacent financial products

  • Worked in a platform organization or built 0→1 financial infrastructure

  • Operated products where reliability, financial correctness, transaction success, loss, recovery, and basis-point economics matter

  • Brought Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent-level product management experience

This Role Is a Great Fit If You...

  • Can look at a payment flow and quickly identify what is missing

  • Can sit with an engineer and discuss the implications of a transaction state, timeout, retry, processor failure, or reconciliation break

  • Don't stop at writing the PRD, and stay close through implementation and launch

  • Are comfortable pulling data, investigating failed transactions, and figuring out what is actually happening

  • Can distinguish a product problem from a technical problem, an operational problem, and a risk problem

  • Can make decisions when the requirements aren't fully defined

  • Enjoy complex financial infrastructure rather than being intimidated by it

  • Understand that in payments, “mostly works” isn't good enough

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a strategy-only product management role

  • Not a project manager role

  • Not a business analyst / requirements-only role

  • Not a consumer checkout PM role with limited exposure to underlying money movement

  • Not a role where you spend the first 60–90 days learning the payments domain

We're looking for someone who already knows payments and can immediately help us build better payment infrastructure.

Engagement Details

  • Engagement: Direct contract with Tapcheck. Agency and third-party staffing submissions will not be considered.

  • Initial term: 90 days, with the option to extend based on performance and business need.

  • Reporting to: Senior Director of Product, Platform.

  • Location: Remote, Central or Pacific time zones.

About Tapcheck

Tapcheck is a digital platform offering an easy and convenient way to access on-demand earnings early. Available at no cost to employers, our app-based on-demand pay solution helps relieve the financial stress that many employees experience on a daily basis.

The Tapcheck team is passionate about our mission to improve financial wellness and boost business productivity. How We Get Things Done

Our core values act as a steadfast guide, directing our decisions and anchoring our actions. We consider these values non-negotiable, especially when it comes to our hiring process.

Our employees approach challenges with a positive attitude, acknowledging their strengths and weaknesses while celebrating the achievements of their colleagues.

  • Grit: We admire individuals with grit, those who demonstrate unwavering determination and resilience in the face of obstacles. At Tapcheck, we take pride in overcoming challenges together, pushing the boundaries of what is possible, and embracing failure as an opportunity for growth.

  • Raising the Bar: Continuous improvement is at the heart of our culture. We are committed to setting high standards and pushing ourselves to exceed them. We seek employees who are innovative and strive for excellence, constantly seeking ways to enhance our products, services, and processes.

  • Striving for Growth: We foster an environment that encourages personal and professional development. Our employees are driven to learn, grow, and adapt to new circumstances. We support individuals who take initiative, seek out new challenges, and actively contribute to their own growth and the growth of the company.

Why Join Tapcheck?
