title: Front End Web Developer
description:
Front End Web Developer

REMOTE | Full-Time | Reports to Ecommerce Manager

JOB SUMMARY

As we continue to grow our portfolio of brands, we are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Front End Web Developer to join our team remotely. This role supports day-to-day ecommerce operations across our 6 Shopify storefronts, company Wix website, and additional custom sites, working closely with our Ecommerce Manager and serving as an internal resource alongside our external development agency.

The ideal candidate is technically capable, highly organized, and comfortable shifting between front-end development, site quality assurance, content operations, and accessibility work. This is a hands-on role with real ownership across several web properties. You will be the person who catches issues before they become problems, keeps our sites running cleanly, and fills in the gaps that keep our ecommerce engine moving.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Front End Development and Site Ownership

  • Own all updates and maintenance for our Wix company website and additional custom sites (such as our parts website), handling front-end edits, content updates, and ongoing upkeep
  • Build custom landing pages across Shopify and Wix using a combination of custom HTML/CSS and existing Shopify sections, delivering on-brand, functional pages.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first front-end updates across all web properties, consistent with each brand's visual identity and standards
  • Ensure all owned sites reflect current brand standards and are free of errors, broken links, and outdated content
  • Serve as an internal support resource alongside our external development agency, helping manage and track tasks, filling in on smaller work items, and reducing agency dependency for quick fixes
  • Act as a first line of response for emergency front-end errors on Shopify storefronts, resolving straightforward issues directly without escalating to the agency
  • Provide an extra layer of QC and testing on Shopify development work before changes go live, catching issues early and communicating clearly with the agency when revisions are needed
  • Help the Ecommerce Manager stay organized on active development projects by tracking task status, flagging blockers, and following up on open items in Asana and Notion

Site QC and Monitoring

  • Conduct regular quality checks across all storefronts and web properties to identify broken links, display errors, layout issues, and functionality gaps
  • Monitor site performance and surface improvement opportunities to the Ecommerce Manager
  • Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure a consistent, error-free experience for all users
  • Document and track identified issues in Asana or Notion, following up to confirm resolution

ADA and Accessibility

  • Implement front-end accessibility fixes in line with WCAG 2.1 AA standards, including color contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and semantic HTML
  • Audit pages for accessibility compliance and prioritize remediation in coordination with the Ecommerce Manager
  • Stay current on ADA compliance requirements as they apply to ecommerce websites

Shopify Admin and Content Operations

  • Edit products in Shopify & Salsify, including but not limited to descriptions, images, and meta fields.
  • Build and manage collection pages, including rules-based and manual collections
  • Create and publish blog content within Shopify, formatting posts and applying appropriate tagging and categorization
  • Make content updates and layout adjustments using Shopify's theme customizer, including banners, sections, and promotional content
  • Customize and maintain Shopify transactional notification emails, including order confirmation, shipping, and other customer-facing templates
  • Maintain accuracy and consistency across all product and content entries, upholding brand standards and internal SOPs

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2 or more years of hands-on experience with Shopify, including theme customization using Liquid and familiarity with the Shopify admin
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; comfort editing and writing front-end code independently
  • Experience with Shopify admin operations including products, collections, blogs, notification email templates, and the theme customizer
  • Experience managing or updating Wix websites
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and the ability to implement code-level fixes
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify, document, and communicate site errors clearly
  • Experience working alongside or supporting an external development agency -- comfortable reviewing work, managing task flow, and flagging issues
  • Proficient in Asana and Notion for task management and project tracking
  • Self-directed and able to manage multiple concurrent responsibilities in a fully remote environment
  • Excellent written communication skills for async collaboration across internal teams and external partners
  • PLUS: Familiarity with cookie consent platforms (OneTrust, Cookiebot, or similar) and the ability to test and manage consent banners and privacy configurations on site
  • A solutions-oriented mindset, when something is broken, this person fixes it

*Remote work arrangement

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About BackOps
BackOps AI transforms supply-chain operations with agentic AI that automates complex workflows, freeing teams to focus on what matters most. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, we foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and measurable impact.

The Role
Engineering is at the size where the hardest problems stop being technical and start being cross-cutting. Work arrives from everywhere. Dependencies between teams get discovered late. Decisions that touch three teams wait on one person's calendar.

You would be our first Technical Program Manager, and you would own that layer. Not by adding process, but by building the smallest set of mechanisms that make the org self-coordinating, and then getting out of the way.
This role reports to the VP of Engineering with direct exposure to the CTO and the Head of Product. You will not be assembling status reports for a hierarchy. You will be deciding which programs exist and making them land.

Your Impact
  • Own the operating system this organization runs on: the planning cadence, how work arrives, and how it gets prioritized. Programs are the output. The system is the job.
  • Set the program agenda with the VP of Engineering. Decide which programs exist and which do not.
  • Own our top strategic programs end to end, from framing the problem through to the thing being live and working.
  • Build the dependency and risk picture across engineering, product, and customer delivery, and surface problems early enough that they are still cheap to fix.
  • Fix how work arrives. Reducing unplanned work is one of the highest-leverage things anyone can do here.
  • Own the operational programs that cross every team: incident and escalation design, cloud cost, and how we adopt AI tooling internally.
  • Define the metrics that show whether a program is working, and give leadership a trustworthy read on delivery risk without anyone having to chase it.
  • Grow other program managers as the function scales.

What We're Looking For
  • 10+ years in technical program management, engineering, or a blend, including time at a startup where the process did not exist yet and you built it.
  • You have owned an operating system, not just programs. Planning, intake, and prioritization as a system that keeps working after you stop pushing on it.
  • Technical credibility with senior engineers and architects. You can hold architecture and delivery risk in the same conversation, read a design doc, ask the question that changes the design, and push back on an estimate with reasons. You do not need to write production code. You do need engineers to want you in the room.
  • A track record of landing an organization's most important programs across teams that do not report to you.
  • Experience growing other program managers, and shaping how an engineering organization works rather than only working inside it.
  • Clear, compressed written communication. You can put a complicated delivery risk in front of an executive in a paragraph and have them make the right call.
  • Comfort with genuine ambiguity. Several of the programs above do not exist yet and are yours to define.

Nice to Have
  • AI/ML or agentic systems experience, especially the reliability and evaluation problems that come with non-deterministic software.
  • You have built a planning or intake system from scratch and seen it survive a year.
  • Enterprise or regulated-customer delivery experience.
  • Incident and escalation program design.

What Success Looks Like
  • Every cross-team initiative has an owner, a definition of done, and a status you can trust.
  • Intake has a front door, and unplanned work is measured weekly rather than estimated once a year.
  • The org plans and re-plans without it being an event.
  • Escalation paths are designed, written down, and used in a real incident.
  • Systemic problems get fixed once rather than escalated repeatedly.
  • Leadership makes decisions on current information without anyone assembling it by hand.

Why BackOps
  • A function to define rather than inherit, with the mandate and the executive backing to do it.
  • Real scope: you will shape how a fast-growing engineering organization operates.
  • Small team with real autonomy and direct access to founders and customers.
  • Backed by exceptional investors and advisors.

Rewards
  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401(k) plan, disability insurance, and life insurance.
  • Flexible time off.
  • Daily meals in the office, and regular team events and offsites.

title: Tram Operator - Snowbird
description:
Snowbird is situated in the middle of the Wasatch Mountain Range and is not only home to awe-inspiring views and mighty terrain, it is also home to employees equally as remarkable. Snowbird is continually looking for the best, those who share a passion for these mountains and the outdoors. Snowbird is a unique resort with distinct summer and winter seasons and offers full-time, part-time and seasonal positions.

TITLE: Tram Operator

LOCATION: Snowbird Resort

STATUS: Full-time, Hourly

SCHEDULE: Variable

  • Anticipated start: Early November
  • Regularly scheduled work shifts require being on-call and working weekends, holidays, and some evenings.
  • Required to work one overnight shift per week at the Summit
  • Shifts generally begin at 6:00 am and may exceed 10 hours based on operational needs.

SUMMARY

Join Snowbird's Tram, Lift & Gate (TLG) Operations team and play a key role in delivering a safe, efficient, and exceptional mountain experience for our guests. As a Tram Operator, you will operate Snowbird's iconic Aerial Tram, assist guests during loading and unloading, maintain safe operating areas, and provide informative announcements throughout the guest experience.

Our team is proud of the welcoming, inclusive culture we've built and the strong leadership that supports it. With experienced supervisors and managers dedicated to safety, service, and operational excellence, you'll be joining a team committed to creating memorable mountain experiences for every guest.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Operate the Aerial Tram safely and efficiently in accordance with established procedures.
  • Assist guests with loading and unloading while maintaining a safe and welcoming environment.
  • Monitor and maintain hazard-free loading and unloading platforms, walkways, and station areas.
  • Complete required daily logs, inspections, and operational checks.
  • Deliver tram announcements and provide guests with mountain information.
  • Provide outstanding guest service and answer guest questions.
  • Work closely with Lift Maintenance, Ski Patrol, and other resort departments to support safe and efficient mountain operations.
  • Respond appropriately to changing weather, operational conditions, and guest needs.
  • Support lift, gate, and dig crew operations as needed.

WHAT YOU NEED TO GET THE JOB DONE

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and perform basic math functions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Positive attitude and ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete logs and operational documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team and maintain a high level of situational awareness.
  • Previous customer service experience preferred.

WORK SCHEDULE

  • Typical shift: 6:00 am to 4:30 pm.
  • Some afternoon and evening shifts may run from 3:00 pm to midnight.
  • Regular weekend, holiday, on-call, and weekly overnight Summit shifts required.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Work outdoors in variable winter weather conditions and at high elevations.
  • Stand for extended periods and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Bend, kneel, reach, grasp, and perform repetitive motions.
  • Work efficiently under pressure with frequent guest interaction.
  • May experience periods of increased stress related to weather conditions, guest volume, and transportation challenges.
  • May be required to stay overnight during road closures, severe weather events, or operational needs.

WHY WORK HERE

  • Ski pass and complimentary ticket benefits.
  • Employee discounts on dining, retail, lessons, lodging, and daycare.
  • Medical, dental, vision, and accident insurance eligibility based on position.
  • 401(k) program.
  • Discounts with POWDR partner resorts.
  • Free employee transportation, including UTA Bus, rideshare vans, Alta Shuttles, and Employee Blue Shuttles.

title: Data Scientist III, Operations Research
description:
About the Role

Total Wine & More is seeking a Data Scientist, Operations Research to join our Data Services team in Bethesda, MD. In this role, you will develop and implement optimization and decision-science solutions that support business decisions across areas such as pricing, inventory, supply chain, and marketing.

You will translate defined business problems into mathematical models, evaluate potential solutions, and help integrate model outputs into business processes and production workflows. This role requires foundational experience in operations research, data analysis, and software development, along with the ability to work independently on routine to moderately complex assignments. You will collaborate with more experienced team members and business partners when addressing unfamiliar or challenging problems. This role reports to the Senior Director, Data Science.

You will

  • Develop mathematical optimization models, including linear programming (LP), mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), and related techniques, based on defined business objectives and constraints.
  • Design and implement optimization solutions using Gurobi or comparable solver technologies.
  • Assess business requirements, available data, and operational constraints to determine appropriate modeling approaches.
  • Evaluate model results through scenario testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to confirm that solutions meet defined business needs.

title: Multi-Media Managing Editor, WMAR
description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps ABC Station in Baltimore, MD, is searching for a Multi-Media Managing Editor to help lead a new era of local news. We're looking for a newsroom leader who understands that today's audiences expect news wherever they are, whether that's on a streaming channel, a phone, social media, or television.

You'll be at the center of our operation, helping drive a 24/7 news stream while ensuring the newsroom stays connected, informed, and focused on the stories that matter most. This role is part coach, part editor, and part conductor. You'll help reporters and MMJs tell stronger stories, make smart decisions in the moment, and find creative ways to connect our journalism with the communities we serve.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead the daily execution of WMAR's streaming and digital news coverage, ensuring audiences have access to timely, relevant content around the clock.

  • Serve as the newsroom's central information hub, helping coordinate coverage plans, breaking news response, and content priorities.

  • Coach and develop reporters and MMJs to elevate storytelling across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.

  • Collaborate with newsroom leadership to execute audience-focused content strategies that drive engagement and community impact.

  • Oversee the writing, editing, and publishing of stories across all platforms while maintaining quality and consistency.

  • Provide timely and constructive feedback that helps journalists strengthen their reporting, writing, and presentation skills.

  • Develop and refine workflows that support multiple news products, including streaming, digital, social, and broadcast content.

  • Ensure all content meets the highest standards of journalistic ethics, accuracy, fairness, and legal compliance.

  • Help identify opportunities for enterprise and accountability reporting that resonate with local audiences.

  • Support breaking news coverage and provide multi-platform content leadership when news demands immediate action.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Seven or more years of experience in journalism, digital content, newsroom leadership, streaming, or a related field preferred.

  • Proven experience managing content in a fast-paced newsroom environment and making sound editorial decisions under deadline pressure.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Deep roots in digital journalism, streaming content, and audience engagement strategies.

  • Strong understanding of broadcast-style storytelling and how to adapt stories across platforms.

  • Demonstrated expertise in coaching journalists and helping teams produce stronger, more impactful work.

  • Exceptional editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics, media law, and libel standards.

  • Curiosity about the communities, issues, and people that shape the stories we cover every day.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • A collaborative leadership style that builds trust and encourages innovation throughout the newsroom.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities can shift quickly.

  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays when news coverage requires it.

OUR TEAM:

WMAR is home to journalists who care deeply about serving Baltimore and Central Maryland. We're a collaborative team of reporters, photographers, producers, digital content creators, and newsroom leaders who believe local journalism should inform, connect, and strengthen the communities we serve. Our team is committed to impactful storytelling, breaking news excellence, accountability journalism, and meaningful community engagement. We embrace innovation, encourage new ideas, and support one another as we evolve for the future of local news.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Baltimore offers the energy of a major metropolitan area with the accessibility and character of a close-knit community. Located along the Chesapeake Bay and within easy reach of Washington, D.C., Baltimore is a city rich in history, culture, and opportunity. The region features vibrant neighborhoods, world-class healthcare and education institutions, thriving arts and entertainment districts, and some of the most diverse communities in the country.

Whether you're exploring the Inner Harbor, attending Orioles or Ravens games, enjoying the city's renowned food scene, spending time on the waterfront, or discovering the unique stories that define Maryland's communities, Baltimore offers endless opportunities for both professional growth and personal enjoyment. It's a market where local journalism matters and where impactful storytelling can make a meaningful difference.

At WMAR, you'll have the opportunity to lead coverage in a market known for passionate audiences, diverse communities, and stories that shape conversations across Maryland.

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. title: Supervisor, Transitions of Care Associate
description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

We want to help patients navigate the healthcare system in a better and safer way, feel their best, and better manage their chronic diseases. The Associate Supervisor leads a team of TOC Associates who support patients during one of the most vulnerable moments in their healthcare journey, transitioning home after a hospital stay. As a supervisor, your mission is to ensure your team delivers safe, timely, high-quality support that prevents unnecessary re-admissions and creates a compassionate, family-like experience for every patient.

You will coach, develop, and support your team while ensuring operational excellence, consistent workflow execution, and strong collaboration with clinical partners. You’ll help shape a culture of accountability, empathy, continuous improvement, and member-centered care within Devoted’s post-acute ecosystem.

Our ideal Supervisor is organized, mission-driven, proactive, and energized by developing people, improving processes, and advocating for members during critical care transitions.

Responsibilities will include :

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a team of Transitions of Care Associates to achieve performance, quality, and patient experience goals.

  • 30% of the time will be dedicated to providing TOC patient care. Time spent on clinical responsibilities will fluctuate depending on the number of direct reports.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, team meetings, and coaching sessions to support skill development and engagement.

  • Create a supportive, inclusive, high-performing team culture grounded in Devoted’s values.

  • Provide timely feedback and performance management, escalating concerns when appropriate.

  • Support onboarding, training, and competency development for new team members.

  • Ensure team adherence to TOC workflows, documentation standards, and escalation pathways.

  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly key performance indicators (KPIs)

  • Use data to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Partner with leadership on staffing needs, workload balancing, and scheduling.

  • Support your team in ensuring timely outreach to patients after hospital discharge.

  • Guide associates on navigating complex cases

Required skills and experience:

  • An active and clear Medical Assistant Certification

  • 2+ years of direct lead or supervisory experience in a virtual setting

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience working in a remote, high-volume, fast-paced environment

  • Experience with transitional care, post-acute workflows, or care coordination

  • A history of being organized and having high attention to detail - it’s the little things that matter

  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish strongly preferred

Salary Range: $58,000 - $82,000 / year

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: RNA Automation Project Lead
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


RNA Automation Project Lead

Location: Shanghai

Job Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned, highly experienced RNA Automation Project Lead to own end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex laboratory automation initiatives across our RNA therapeutics R&D pipeline. Serving as the core technical and project leadership anchor, you will drive innovation and scale intelligent, high-throughput automation systems to transform traditional RNA research workflows.

You will lead cross-functional collaboration among internal RNA scientists, assay developers, automation engineers, IT/informatics teams, and external partners to design, validate, and deploy robust automated solutions that significantly improve assay efficiency, data accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability. You will take full ownership of project timelines, resource allocation, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication to ensure consistent delivery of high-impact automation outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of comprehensive hands-on R&D experience spanning RNA synthesis, cell biology, NGS sequencing, and analytical characterization, paired with proven expertise in laboratory automation design and project delivery. If you are passionate about leading digital and automated transformation for RNA therapeutic discovery, this senior role will enable you to drive strategic, company-level impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, design, and execute end-to-end roadmaps for integrated RNA automation workflows, covering core capabilities including RNA extraction, RT-qPCR quantification, siRNA/miRNA synthesis, LC-MS analytical testing, and high-throughput NGS sample preparation and sequencing.
  • Lead the re-engineering and full automation of manual RNA protocols, substantially reducing manual labor, eliminating systematic human error, and elevating overall process consistency and experimental reproducibility.
  • Lead cross-functional technical teams including RNA synthesis scientists, cell biologists, analytical scientists, assay developers, and process engineers to translate scientific requirements into stable, scalable, and production-grade automated lab solutions.
  • Establish standardized operating procedures (SOPs) for all automated RNA workflows, and lead technical training and capability building for lab operation teams to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient instrument utilization.
  • Oversee integration, validation, and daily operation of robotic liquid handling platforms and automated instruments to streamline end-to-end RNA R&D pipelines.
  • Partner closely with automation engineering, informatics, and data science teams to enable closed-loop, data-driven, AI-empowered experimentation for continuous RNA workflow iteration.
  • Own end-to-end data quality control, experimental reproducibility, and technical documentation; lead ongoing process assessment, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization of automated systems.
  • Develop and implement standardized data management frameworks and drive LIMS integration to enable full digital traceability and intelligent operation of automated RNA workflows.
  • Evaluate benchmark and introduce cutting-edge automation and RNA technological innovations to continuously upgrade organizational RNA biology and analytical capabilities.
  • Ensure all automated workflows and instrument operations strictly comply with global lab safety standards and internal R&D compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate and align with global LAL sites (Boston, Indianapolis, San Diego) to establish cross-site unified workflow standards, automation specifications, and quality metrics.
  • Maintain regular global cross-team synchronization and project governance; support occasional domestic and international business travel as required.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Synthetic Biology, RNA Biology, Biochemistry, Analytical Science, or related life science disciplines.
  • 10+ years of hands-on pharmaceutical/biotech R&D experience in RNA research, covering RNA extraction, RT-qPCR, siRNA/miRNA synthesis, NGS method development and sequencing, LC-MS analytical testing, and automated lab system deployment.
  • Comprehensive understanding of end-to-end RNA research principles spanning synthesis, biology, cellular functional validation, sequencing profiling, and analytical characterization; fully aware of critical technical pitfalls in RNA sample handling, processing, and data interpretation.
  • Proven hands-on experience with mainstream automation platforms (Tecan, Hamilton, Labcyte Echo) and independent automation workflow design, deployment, and validation is strongly preferred.
  • Familiar with multi-omics analytical tools including RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, qPCR, Northern blot, and Western blot, with strong capability for result analysis and scientific interpretation.
  • Excellent independent troubleshooting, protocol optimization, and systematic problem-solving skills for complex automated RNA workflows.
  • Solid experience integrating and operating automated core instruments including qPCR and NGS sequencing platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analysis for systematic assay and workflow optimization.
  • Working proficiency in Python, C# or other scripting languages for automated instrument control and experimental data analysis is a plus.
  • Prior formal project leadership experience in biotech/pharma automation or RNA therapeutic R&D is highly preferred.
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication, global stakeholder alignment, and team leadership skills to drive cross-site project delivery.

title: Director Enterprise System Standards
description:
Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

Position Summary


Leads the Enterprise System Standards function within Integrated System Planning (ISP). Accountable for defining and governing the planning-grade standards that establish what the holistic energy system must be capable of doing across Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Gas, DERs, storage, load, and controls. Ensure System Standards are forward-looking and durable supporting investment decisions, ISP studies, and portfolio development, and to foster a build-it-once design basis across planning cycles. Also serves as the operational lead for the multidisciplinary Planning Council, the executive governance body that approves shared futures, assumptions, scenarios, and preferred portfolios across all commodities. This role stewards the forum through the creation and maintenance of charter, cadence, materials, decision process, and follow-through.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Direct the cross-functional and cooperative development, publication, and refinement of enterprise System Standards, including system intent, capability and performance targets, resilience criteria, and the build-it-once design basis. Ensure standards are technology-agnostic where possible, traceable to enterprise strategy and long-term plans, and are consistently described across jurisdictions and planning horizons.

  • Conduct the multidisciplinary Planning Council as its operational lead. Own the Council charter, operating cadence, agenda pipeline, decision materials, minutes, and action tracking for the Council members consisting of VP, SVP and EVP executive leaders. Coordinate participation and manage re-convening triggers.

  • Accountable for the System Standards work cycle end-to-end: signal intake, translation into planning-grade standards, governance approval, integration into ISP products, KPI tracking, and scheduled refresh.

  • Build and lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers, analysts, economists and consultants. Establish clear RACI with enterprise stakeholder groups and develop bench strength through subordinate leadership.

  • Partner across ISP Integrated Planning (North, PSCo, South), Model Innovation, Operations, Regulatory, Finance, and the Operating Companies to align standards with business objectives, regional needs, and regulatory expectations. Benchmark against peer utilities to inform standards development and governance practice.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Economics, or related discipline; advanced degree in Engineering, Business, Public Policy, or related field preferred.

  • Minimum of 10 years' utility industry experience, including 5+ years of leadership experience in strategy, standards, or integrated planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise across two or more of: generation, transmission, distribution, gas.

  • Experience with scenario-based planning, futures methodologies, and cross-commodity portfolio evaluation.

  • Proven ability to design and operate cross-functional governance forums, including charter, decision rights, cadence, and action management.

  • Strong financial and regulatory acumen, including familiarity with rate case and long-term planning deliverables.

  • Demonstrated organizational, leadership, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior executives and multidisciplinary teams without direct authority.

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior experience developing enterprise or system-level standards, planning criteria, or design-basis frameworks.

  • Familiarity with peer utility approaches to enterprise standards and how such standards are housed, refreshed, and enforced.

  • Continuous improvement experience, including PD Tree, KPIs, and management-of-change processes.

  • Previous operations experience with linear or fixed assets.

As a leading combination electricity and natural gas energy company, Xcel Energy offers a comprehensive portfolio of energy-related products and services to 3.4 million electricity and 1.9 million natural gas customers across eight Western and Midwestern states. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in India.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
  • Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
  • Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
  • Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
  • Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
  • Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
  • Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
    • Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
    • Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
    • Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
    • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
    • Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
    • Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
    • Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
    • Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours focused on results and impact rather than time spent at a desk.
      • Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
      • 21 days of annual leave plus applicable local bank holidays.
      • Equipment provided to help you perform effectively in your role.
      • Premium access to the product and its features.
      • Opportunity to work on a large-scale consumer product with global reach.
      • Chance to work at the intersection of AI, behavioral science, gamification, and mobile product design.
      • Collaborative environment with significant opportunities to experiment, innovate, and influence the direction of the product.
      • Full-time position within an international and distributed team.

title: Sr. Director- Trial Management
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Verve Therapeutics, a Lilly Research Labs subsidiary, is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company on a mission to solve cardiovascular disease. Founded by leaders in cardiovascular medicine and gene editing, Verve is developing one-time gene editing treatments aimed at turning chronic management into a single-course cure. Its lead programs target PCSK9 and ANGPTL3 to lower LDL-C, the root cause of cardiovascular disease.

The Senior Director, Trial Management provides strategic and operational leadership for the trial management function across Verve’s early development gene editing clinical programs. This role leads trial management leaders, strengthens consistency in execution, and advances standard practices to support high-quality, efficient, and compliant delivery.

This leader will play a key role in harmonizing ways of working across Verve and Lilly processes, helping build an integrated operating model that enables clarity, speed, and quality across the portfolio. As a member of the Development Operations leadership team, this individual will contribute to broader functional priorities, organizational decisions, and cross-functional alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop trial management leaders, setting clear expectations for performance, collaboration, and execution
  • Standardize and continuously improve trial management best practices, tools, and operating rhythms across programs
  • Drive harmonization of trial management processes across Verve and Lilly to support a consistent and scalable operating model
  • Serve as an active member of the Clinical Development Operations leadership team, contributing to strategic planning, organizational effectiveness, and functional direction
  • Provide oversight across clinical programs to ensure delivery against timelines, quality expectations, budgets, and study goals
  • Partner closely with cross-functional team members including Clinical Development, Regulatory, Data Management, Patient recruitment /retention, Study start up, Medical Writing, Supply Chain, Quality, Clinical Compliance, and other key functions to support aligned study execution
  • Work with Compliance and Oversight to strengthen governance, escalation, and decision-making processes to identify and address operational risks early
  • Ensure teams apply a risk-based approach to planning, study oversight, and issue resolution
  • Oversee CRO and vendor strategy within the function, including expectations for performance, partnership, and accountability
  • Support development and refinement of SOPs, workflows, and business processes that promote quality, compliance, and consistency across trials and programs
  • Champion compliance with GCP, ICH, and applicable global regulatory requirements, while supporting inspection readiness
  • Monitor key operational metrics and use data-driven insights to improve execution, resource planning, and leadership visibility
  • Foster a culture aligned with Team Lilly expectations, including collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement
  • Coach, mentor, and develop talent within the trial management organization to strengthen capability and succession depth
  • Represent the trial management function in cross-functional and leadership forums

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred
  • Significant clinical operations or trial management experience within a sponsor organization

Additional Skills/Preferences

  • Demonstrated success leading leaders and building high-performing teams in a matrixed clinical development environment
  • Strong experience overseeing global clinical trials across multiple phases of development
  • Deep understanding of GCP, ICH, and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Proven ability to standardize processes, implement operational improvements, and lead through change
  • Strong critical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution
  • Experience supporting organizational integration, process harmonization, or operating model evolution preferred

title: Senior artificial intelligence platform engineer, ai platform & fabrics
description:
Date limite pour présenter sa candidature :

09/29/2026

Adresse :

33 Dundas Street West

Groupe de famille d'emploi :

Technologie

Hybrid Work Model

BMO is building the platform capabilities that make enterprise AI safe, governed, and scalable. We are seeking experienced Senior Engineers to help build and operate the core infrastructure that governs how AI runs at BMO: the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, and AI Observability.

This is a build-and-run engineering role. You will design, implement, and operate significant components of these platform capabilities; writing production code, building integrations, and helping run what you. You will not build the AI models or applications themselves (those are domain-owned); you help build the governed platform they run on and the runtime evidence that proves they run within policy, across AWS, Azure, and Microsoft AI surfaces, under OSFI and OCC expectations.

You are a hands-on engineer with a strong production track record who takes ownership of your components, cares about operability and correctness, and collaborates well within your team. You work within technical direction and standards set by the team's Principal Engineers and Leads, contribute to design discussions, and mentor more junior engineers. You are energized by hardening and scaling real engineering assets; an existing developer portal, an AI registry, a body of policy-as-code, and gateway integrations into enterprise-grade capabilities.

What You'll Build & Operate

Working within one of the platform squads, you will build and operate components of one or more of the following:

Enterprise AI Control Plane

  • Portal & Registry: features of the AI Registry (agents, models, tools, channels, evaluations), self-service onboarding flows, and lifecycle workflows; integrations with external registries.
  • Policy Engine: components of the policy-as-code infrastructure (Cedar/OPA), the compilation pipeline, GitOps-based distribution, and the policy simulation sandbox.
  • Observability & Audit: telemetry pipeline components, OpenTelemetry GenAI instrumentation, trace correlation, and audit-lake ingestion supporting regulator-ready evidence.
  • Governance & Lifecycle: certification workflow components, compliance-scoring automation, and evidence-generation tooling.

AI Domain Orchestration

  • Gateway Runtime: components of the inline enforcement engine: request-time policy evaluation, routing, residency, budget/quota, and circuit breaking, built to strict latency budgets; domain-hub deployment across AWS and Azure.
  • Guardrails Runtime: stages of the safety pipeline (input moderation, prompt-injection defense, PII, output validation, hallucination detection, policy enforcement), including bilingual EN/FR support.
  • Identity Fabric: components of workload identity for AI (SPIFFE/SPIRE), token-exchange flows, trust-boundary configuration, Entra Agent ID integration, and cross-cloud token federation.

Note on scope: Two of these platforms (Identity Fabric, Policy Engine) are built with AI as the incubation context but are designed to transition to bank-wide ownership at maturity.

What You'll Do

  • Own and deliver components/features within your squad’s capability, design (with guidance), implement, test, ship, and help operate in production.
  • Participate in on-call for the services your team runs.
  • Build APIs, MCP Servers, integrations, and tooling through which domains, DevOps pipelines, and enterprise systems consume platform capabilities.
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-instrumented code; build operability in from the start (metrics, tracing, SLO-aware design).
  • Ensure your components produce the runtime evidence connecting AI activity to policy enforcement, identity, and lineage for model-risk and regulatory review.
  • Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions, applying standards and patterns set by Principal Engineers and Leads.
  • Mentor junior engineers and collaborate actively across the squad.
  • Partner day-to-day with AI Developer Experience, AI Security, and AI SDLC counterparts as needed to deliver your work.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master's an asset).
  • 5+ years of software/platform engineering experience, including hands-on experience building and operating production services.
  • Experience with production operations (deployments, monitoring, incident response, on-call), ideally in a regulated industry (financial services an asset).
  • Hands-on depth in at least one of: API/gateway services; policy-as-code/authorization; workload identity/security; observability/telemetry; audit/data platforms.

Required Core Skills

Platform Engineering Foundations

  • Solid software-engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code; API design; and an understanding of distributed-systems concepts (latency, resilience, availability).
  • Strong programming skills (Python and/or Go preferred; TypeScript/Java an asset) for building services, APIs, and integrations.
  • Working proficiency in cloud-native development on AWS and/or Azure: containers/Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation/ARM).
  • Practical CI/CD, GitOps, and DevSecOps experience; Git-based workflows (Bitbucket/GitHub), Jira, Confluence.

Capability-Specific Depth (one or more)

  • Policy/Authorization: Cedar, OPA/Rego, or comparable authorization systems.
  • Identity/Security: SPIFFE/SPIRE, mTLS, OAuth/OIDC, token exchange, or federated identity.
  • Observability/Audit: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, Dynatrace/Splunk or equivalents, immutable/audit data stores.
  • Gateway/Guardrails: API gateway usage/development, LLM routing/abstraction, prompt-injection/PII defenses, or AI evaluation.
  • Registry/Portal: service catalogues, asset registries, lifecycle/onboarding workflows.

GenAI & Governance Context

  • Working knowledge of GenAI platform patterns (LLM/AI gateways, RAG, agentic patterns, embeddings, guardrails) sufficient to build supporting infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML tooling (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, SageMaker, MLflow) and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) an asset.
  • Awareness of Responsible AI, AI/data governance, privacy, cloud security, and IAM as applied to AI workloads.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (Professional an asset) / ML - Specialty
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure Solutions Architect Expert

About This Role:

Sr. Product Manager, Digital Platform – Clinician Workflow

iRhythm is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to join the digital platform product team. This role will focus on clinican-facing web portals, helping define, prioritize, and deliver workflow capabilities that support clinician-facing experiences, operational efficiency, and scalable platform growth. Over time, the role is expected to expand into broader digital platform responsibilities across clinician workflow, integrations, and adjacent platform capabilities that support iRhythm’s evolving product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering, design, clinical, operations, commercial, regulatory, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate user needs and business priorities into high-quality software solutions that can scale across multiple products and workflows.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead product discovery for accountable products, including voice of customer, clinician workflow research, internal stakeholder feedback, data analysis, and assessment of unmet needs and pain points.

You care deeply about building healthcare technology that improves workflows, supports clinicians, and enables better patient and customer outcomes. The end user is always your first priority, and you seek to understand day-to-day pain points through data, research, workflow observation, and direct stakeholder engagement. You know enough about software delivery, systems, and integrations to partner effectively with technical teams and can communicate complex ideas at the right level for executives, engineers, operators, and clinical stakeholders. You bring structure to ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicate your rationale clearly so teams stay aligned and moving forward.

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with software platforms, workflow applications, or digital health products.
  • Experience in healthcare IT, medical device, digital health, clinical workflow, or regulated software environments.
  • Strong ability to define product scope, write clear requirements, prioritize effectively, and guide teams through ambiguity.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Deep knowledge of product management best practices, including discovery, roadmap planning, agile delivery, launch readiness, and outcome measurement.
  • Strong end-user orientation, with experience gathering feedback from both internal and external users and translating insights into product decisions.
  • Experience using analytics, business intelligence, or product data to monitor adoption, workflow performance, and business impact.
  • Strong systems analysis, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrates initiative as a self-starter; results oriented, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence, road mapping tools such as Aha!, and analytics tools such as Tableau, Pendo, Google Analytics, or SQL.
  • BA/BS in science, engineering, business, healthcare, or a technical field. Advanced degree or MBA desired.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or improving applications that support multiple end-user personas and complex workflow handoffs.
  • Experience with clinician-facing software, care team workflows, reporting tools, patient monitoring platforms, or healthcare operations platforms.
  • Familiarity with EHR integrations, interoperability concepts, customer care systems, user management tools, or revenue cycle management workflows.
  • Experience with requirements management applications such as Jama or DOORS and design control applications such as MasterControl.

title: Databricks Engineer (Contract)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Databricks Engineer to join our delivery team on a contract basis to design, build, and optimize modern data platforms on Azure Databricks. In this strategic role, you will work directly with both Data Elephant and client data and analytics teams, helping them migrate, modernize, and scale their data workloads while applying best practices in data engineering, security, ML, AI and data governance. This is a hands-on engineering role with strong exposure to architecture decisions, client interaction, and end-to-end delivery.

Responsibilities

Play an integral project team role in the implementation of modern data platforms and architectures on Databricks (including ETL, workload migrations, and Unity Catalog).

Design and implement data pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, SQL)

Build and optimize batch and streaming data workloads

Migrate legacy data workloads to Azure + Databricks

Implement Delta Lake patterns (medallion architecture, CDC, data quality)

Integrate Databricks with Azure services such as ADLS, ADF, Azure Key Vault and DevOps/Github

Optimize performance and cost (cluster sizing, job orchestration, query tuning)

Collaborate with solution architects, analytics engineers, and client stakeholders

Contribute to reusable accelerators, standards, and internal best practices

Support client enablement through knowledge transfer and documentation

Provide hands-on solution delivery, including guiding and working closely with client engineers and ensuring best practices.

Implement governance models and Unity Catalog including data access, lineage, and security frameworks.

QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years of experience in data engineering.

4+ years of recent, hands-on experience building production solutions with Databricks, including advanced features such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow.

Strong experience developing data pipelines using PySpark and SQL.

Proven experience leading large-scale data migrations, including ETL workloads and cloud platform migrations.

Strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and experience working with Azure data services, including ADLS, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Synapse Analytics, Azure Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.

Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including lakehouse, medallion architecture, and ELT/ETL.

Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data workloads.

Strong understanding of enterprise data governance, security, and compliance best practices.

Excellent communication skills with experience working directly with client teams.

Previous consulting or professional services experience is strongly preferred.

Databricks and Microsoft Azure certifications are considered an asset.

Be part of Canada’s leading boutique consulting firm focused on Databricks and modern data platforms.

Work on challenging, high-impact projects with mid-sized and enterprise clients across industries

Collaborate with a senior, high-performing team that values speed, pragmatism, and client success.

This role requires regular onsite work at a client location in Calgary.

title: Clinical Assistant Inpatient Per Diem (Nights)
description:
Under the direction of a registered/licensed nurse (RN), the Clinical Assistant II, Inpatient, is a member of the interdisciplinary health care team, provides essential clinical and supportive care functions to promote a safe, compassionate, and patient-centered care environment. The Clinical Assistant II, Inpatient supports patient comfort, safety, and daily care needs while adhering to established clinical protocols, safety standards, and institutional policies. This role is expected to align with and actively support Dana-Farber Cancer Institute’s mission, vision, and core values of Impact, Excellence, Compassion & Respect, Discovery, and Inclusion in all aspects of its work.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

• Provide direct patient care and daily living support
Delivers basic patient care under the direction of the registered nurse, including assistance with activities of daily living (hygiene, bathing, toileting, dressing, mobility), meal set-up and feeding as indicated, skin care, positioning and turning, ambulation and range of motion, admission and discharge support, safe patient transport, and orientation of patients and families to the care environment.
• Support patient monitoring, data collection, and specimen collection
Obtains and records patient data such as vital signs, pulse oximetry, non-invasive blood pressure, height, weight, intake and output, blood glucose results, and 12-lead ECGs; performs bladder scanning and specimen collection using two patient identifiers; promptly reports changes in patient status or abnormal findings to the RN/licensed nurse.
• Prepare, use, and maintain equipment and the care environment
Retrieves, sets up, and cleans patient care equipment (e.g., cardiac monitors, portable oxygen, pulse oximeters, suction systems, lifting equipment, scales) according to unit protocols; maintains a clean, safe, and organized patient care environment; follows equipment management and infection prevention practices, including standard precautions and hand hygiene.
• Promote a safe, healing, and respectful environment
Supports a Culture of Safety by performing hourly rounding, responding promptly and appropriately to call lights and patient/family requests, providing constant observation when assigned, using Safe Patient Handling principles, monitoring for and reporting safety concerns, and consistently demonstrating respect, kindness, and cultural sensitivity while protecting patient privacy and confidentiality.
• Document care and communicate effectively within the care team
Accurately documents assigned aspects of care and patient data in approved forms and the electronic medical record; communicates clearly and respectfully with patients, families, and all members of the interdisciplinary team; seeks RN assistance when needed to meet patient/family needs and to escalate concerns.
• Participate as an engaged member of the interdisciplinary team
Collaborates with nurses and other team members to meet patient, family, and unit needs; proactively offers assistance to others; performs delegated responsibilities within scope and adapts to changing unit demands; provides care appropriate to the age and condition of patients on assigned unit(s).
• Support learning, development, and mentoring
Participates in ongoing education by identifying learning needs, completing required annual training, and attending in-services; supports orientation and mentoring of new Clinical Assistants to help them meet performance expectations and adhere to unit and institutional standards.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Knowledge of English language sufficient to read, speak and write accurately.
• Knowledge of simple math.
• Ability to lift and transport patients using the appropriate physical technique in a safe manner for the patient and self-according to the safe patient handling guidelines.
• Proficiency in basic computer skills.
• Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively with patients, visitors, and personnel.

Minimum Job Qualifications:

High School diploma or equiavalent.

License/Certification/Registration Required:

Certification as a nursing assistant required upon hire, unless incumbent is a nursing student who has completed her/his fundamentals of nursing with a clinical component (clinical rotation or simulation lab). May not currently hold a valid nursing license. Basic Life Support (BLS) or CPR certification by the American Heart Association (AHA) or the Red Cross required upon hire.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No

Patient Contact:

Yes, Direct and continuous contact with adult oncology patients and families in an inpatient environment.

Special Working Conditions:

• Exposure to hazardous drugs and biohazards; adherence to personal protective equipment (PPE) and safe handling policies required.
• Walking, standing, and lifting up to 35 lbs.; follows Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI) safe patient handling and ergonomics practices.
• May require rotating shifts or extended hours based on operational and patient care needs.

description:

Description:

The Grants Management Specialist will provide support in the administration of national and international research grant awards. She/he will be responsible for the smooth handling of the research and financial management portfolio within the Research Grants Unit. The portfolio revolves around the pre-award, due diligence and grants and contracts management and post-award phases. This includes the administration of a number of research grants; participate in multi-disciplinary teams preparing and compiling research grant proposals; reviewing cooperative agreements and policies, project setup, preparing financial and progress reports for research investigators, collaborators and external funders; compliance and institutional reporting obligations. In addition, the Grants Management Specialist will be responsible for maintaining grants databases, financial reconciliations, creating boiler templates and coordination and support activities. The position requires high level analytical skills, be deadline driven, attention to detailed orientated and multi-tasking skills. Grants Management Specialist will support both AHRI’s operating sites i.e. Somkhele and Durban.

The position will report to the AHRI grants managers and dotted line to their assigned faculty members.

1. Pre-Award Grants Management


Funding Announcements:

  • First point of contact for principal investigators (PIs) seeking support with research funding
  • Offers info sessions, grantsmanship, application guides for major competitions, and various research funding options.
  • Advises on rules, regulations and submission procedures for grant applications opportunities.
  • Check eligibility

  • Provide proposal and budget development support services to faculty, senior and early-career researchers.
  • Liaises with collaborators and funders when necessary.

  • Involved in smooth and timely submission of grant applications

Just-In-Time:

2. Due Diligence and Grants and Contracts Management


Due Diligence Reporting:

title: Wireless Software Engineer
description:
Company Background

Specter's mission is to help automate the physical world.

Today, we build video sensors with state-of-the-art AI agents that answer any question, anywhere in their environments. Our systems can automatically detect and reason about any physical activity captured on camera, from security incidents (e.g. perimeter intrusion, theft, LPR), to safety monitoring (e.g. PPE detection, injured people), to operational efficiency (e.g. material tracking, congestion monitoring). We offer both long range wireless (1km range) and wired sensor variants to suit any deployment.

Our co-founders Xerxes and Philip are passionate about empowering our partners in the fast approaching world of physical AI and robotics. We are a small, fast growing team who hail from Anduril, Amazon, Tesla, Uber, and the U.S. Special Forces.

The Role

Specter is hiring a Wireless Software Engineer to own the wireless software stack across our distributed mesh sensor network, spanning radio configuration and control on the device, fleet-wide telemetry and diagnostics, and the tooling our RF team uses to design, deploy, and debug real sites.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain the wireless software running on Specter's deployed edge devices, including radio configuration and control, channel and power management, QoS policy, rate control, and the device-side interfaces for remote node interrogation.

  • Own fleetwide telemetry and diagnostics: collect, transport, store, and analyze per-link statistics across hundreds of deployed nodes, enabling remote diagnosis of link degradation.

  • Integrate and characterize vendor wireless chipsets, drivers, and firmware including driver-level failure modes and engineering around vendor limitations we do not control.

  • Debug complex issues spanning radio, driver, kernel, and application layers; determine root causes and instrument systems for future diagnostics.

  • Collaborate closely with RF, Hardware Engineering, Embedded Software, and Backend teams to co-design interfaces, support new radio platforms, and ensure strong connections between wireless performance and end-to-end video quality and latency.

  • Build and maintain automation and tooling for fleet operations, including monitoring, alerting, configuration management, and targeted recovery processes.

  • Develop RF simulation and deployment planning tools for real site design, including propagation modeling, channel assignment, and capacity estimation.

  • Support field deployments through bring-up, site characterization, and post-deployment debugging, feeding insights from real-world behavior back into the design process.

  • Contribute to the wireless foundations underpinning Specter’s next generation of autonomous and robotic platforms, such as drone communications and distributed node coordination.

What you'll bring

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with fluency in Python and at least one systems language such as C, C++, Go, or Rust.

  • Extensive Linux experience, including systemd services, working within the networking stack, and operating headless remote machines over SSH.

  • Deep understanding of WLAN standards, including Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) MAC protocols, WFA protocols, and coexistence with other wireless technologies such as Bluetooth, UWB and cellular.

  • Familiarity with the Linux wireless userspace: cfg80211/nl80211, hostapd, wpa_supplicant, and the related drivers.

  • Experience with telemetry or data pipelines: collecting, storing, and querying operational data.

  • Solid grasp of networking fundamentals across the whole stack from drivers up through application layer.

  • Solid understanding of embedded system design principles, including memory estimation, resource allocation, power management, and performance optimization.

  • Experience building and debugging distributed or networked systems.

  • Proficiency with wireless performance analysis using tools such as Wireshark, logging frameworks, and low-level tracing.

  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware/software interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and embedded logging tools.

  • Ability to work at the hardware/software boundary, including reading datasheets, driver source, and register maps.

Nice to have

  • Experience with sub-GHz wireless, 802.11ah, or mesh networking.

  • Deep architectural understanding of LTE/5G Protocol Stacks (NAS, PDCP, RRC, RLC, MAC, PHY) and 3GPP specifications.

  • Familiarity with embedded interfaces (UART, I2C, I2S, SPI, CAN, PCIe, etc.).

  • Exposure to Video pipeline: encoder control, RTP or QUIC transport, and an understanding of the impact of packet loss on perceived quality.

  • Familiarity with software-defined radio, signal processing, or spectrum analysis tools.

  • Experience with time-series data infrastructure and observability tooling.

  • Previous work with field-deployed hardware, where environmental and software issues both affect reliability.

  • Understanding of QoS concepts and data path optimization algorithms.
