title: Architectural Project Manager
description:
Position Overview

Oversees the architectural project development for Burlington’s downsizes, and remodels. APM will oversee our direct hired architectural teams and coordinate with landlord hired architects thru the architectural development of project until handoff to construction team. The APM will be responsible for visiting sites with architects, contracting with our direct hired architects, coordinating CD development, and permitting, review and redline of all construction documents, updating all project data in Lucernex, tracking and managing all soft costs and invoices on their projects to stay within budget. The APM will also coordinate with our internal prototype design team on any drawing related issues that create or could potentially create issues in the field. The APM will be the primary point of contact for cross-departmental collaboration in completion of all projects related tasks to deliver stores to construction team in expeditious manner.

A Day in the Life

  • Visit potential store sites to assess existing conditions to verify scope of work provided by pre-development team is complete and verify that the proposed feasibility plan is adequate. At peak times the APM will assist pre-development team in completion of scope of work document and photo documentation of project sites. For turnkey projects coordinate with landlord’s architect/engineer and landlord on schedule for construction document completion and permitting to report back to internal partners any risk to project schedules. Assists with any scope questions and RFI’s to landlord teams.
  • Review and redline of all construction documents so that drawings are following prototype standards, scope of work, landlord work letter, and lease documents. Review any required shop drawings.
  • For as-is projects contract with our site adapt architects for CD development. Performs kick off call with architect/engineer design team and all applicable internal Burlington partners and serves as the primary point of contact and manages the scope deliverables per scope of work, landlord work letter, and proposed initial budget. Coordinate with all internal partners to have all required deliverables for their applicable scope of work to include in final construction documents.
  • Assist real estate directors in finalizing any scope of work questions with landlords and any deliverable timelines for CD completion and permitting.
  • Manage direct hired permitting vendor and assist with any required documentation and signatures to expedite permits.
  • Coordinate with construction team on bidders list and assist in sending out bid packages to GC’s. Attend pre-bid walk with construction and architect to assist with responding to any site-specific questions to drawings and/or any field conditions that are identified.
  • Coordinate with store innovations prototype team on global design changes that need to be rolled out into the field.
  • Assist with financial forecasting for assigned projects to maintain all soft costs in budget and reduction of change orders. Attend weekly project development kick off calls, value engineering calls, and project development status calls.
  • Scope and Impact - This position has complete responsibility for all architectural project management related to new stores, downsizes and remodels.
  • Must collaborate with real estate directors, store planning managers and pre-development scope team to ensure lease work letter, design of store block plan, and scope of work for new stores, remodels, and downsizes are all aligned.
  • Has significant involvement with Real Estate, Facilities, Loss Prevention, Information Technology, Construction and Store Innovation teams.
  • Must be process oriented, can come up with solutions to design and construction problems, has knowledge of MEP systems, and can negotiate with landlords on scope of work and lease language.

You'll Come With

  • 5+ years of experience in architectural and/or construction management with a major retail brand or design firm

title: Commercial Parts Pro Store 7954
description:
Job Description

Professional level sales position capable of supporting advanced functions on the commercial side of the business. Position is responsible for profitable growth of the commercial business via customer retention and growth. Position partners with GM to manage Team Members. The role has expert knowledge of automotive system and part knowledge. The role has the ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc. The role has the ability to direct the drivers to ensure timely and accurate delivery. Position is full time.

Primary Responsibilities

· Maintain commercial customer relationships

· Provide GAS2 selling experience commercial customers

· Achieve personal / store sales goals and service objectives

· Provide day-to-day supervisory support for Team Members

· Collaborate with GM on coaching and developmental needs for Team Members

· Dispatch drivers ensuring delivery standards are achieved

· Maintain commercial stocking programs

· Build and maintain a network of second source suppliers

Secondary Responsibilities

· Maintain core bank and commercial returns

· Maintain commercial credit accounts

· Partner with GM to ensure proper driver coverage

Success Factors

· Friendly communication

· Ability to locate and stock parts

· Safety knowledge and skills

· Operating inventory systems and store equipment

· Parts and automotive system knowledge skills

· Operating POS and Parts lookup systems

· ASE P2 certified or ASE ready equivalent

· Advanced solution, project and product quality recommendation ability

· Ability to source from numerous places including special order, FDO, second source, etc.

· Advanced selling skills for commercial customers

· Ability to multi-task and remain organized·

Effective communication, listening and problem solving skills

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Commercial Parts Pro

· Working knowledge of automotive systems, and diagnostic ability to include: internal engine, suspension, brakes, electronic, exhaust, etc.

· Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management

· Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals; ability to write simple correspondence

· Understand and execute instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form

· Successfully complete the Parts Knowledge Assessment

· Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals

· Use Microsoft software effectively (Word, Excel required)

· Strong organizational skills

· Understand Commercial profitability concepts, including knowledge of competition, market opportunities, and customer prioritization (may work with the Commercial Account Manager to determine pricing discounts for specific Commercial customers)

· Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Commercial Parts Pro up for Success

A minimum of 3 years of prior automotive parts experience preferred

Proven sales ability with past experience in fulfillment of customer transactions

Formal or informal experience leading teams, including supervising daily tasks, and working together to achieve goals

Education

High school diploma or general education degree (GED)

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

ASE certification preferred, but not required

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Position is eligible for sales commission based on individual or store performance.

title: Creative Design Lead
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You Will Do

1. Brand & Visual Strategy

  • Own BJAK’s UK brand identity and visual systems across all platforms

  • Build a UK-first visual narrative tailored to local users, culture, and market trends

  • Translate marketing and business objectives into impactful visual storytelling

  • Develop creative campaigns that build awareness, trust, and adoption

  • Ensure consistent brand expression across digital, social, product, and offline channels

2. Creative Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a small, multidisciplinary UK creative team

  • Set high standards for design quality, speed, and execution

  • Review and approve visual assets to ensure alignment with the UK brand vision

  • Foster a collaborative, high-ownership, and execution-driven team culture

3. Execution & Optimization

  • Build and manage creative workflows balancing quality, speed, and scalability

  • Partner with UK growth, product, and leadership teams to align visuals with strategic goals

  • Use data, insights, and market trends to optimize campaigns and creative output

  • Stay up-to-date on consumer, design, and digital trends to keep the brand relevant

You Will Thrive Here If You…

  • Care deeply about visual storytelling, brand building, and design excellence

  • Are hands-on, fast-moving, and obsessed with execution quality

  • Lead confidently while staying close to the work

  • Perform well under pressure and ambiguity

  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end and drive for measurable impact

  • Continuously push for higher standards and better outcomes

  • Manage multiple projects efficiently without losing structure or focus

  • Communicate clearly and provide actionable, constructive feedback

  • Want to build something meaningful fast and at scale

What You Bring

  • 4–6 years of experience in visual design, brand design, or creative leadership

  • Strong portfolio showcasing visual storytelling, digital campaigns, and multi-channel projects

  • Deep understanding of branding, design systems, and digital content strategy

  • Proven experience leading creative teams and raising creative standards

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, and modern production workflows

  • Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills

  • Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer brands

  • Experience building or localizing brands specifically for the UK market

Our Team & Culture

  • Lean, high-output team that moves fast and expects the same from everyone

  • Everyone contributes meaningfully, thinks like an owner, and raises the bar

  • Clarity, execution, and iteration drive everything we do

  • Results, speed, and ownership matter more than titles

Location

This role is based in Malaysia. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Malysia office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Cloud networking is a strategic investment area for Confluent with the potential to impact the company’s top and bottom line. The control plane area in the Traffic team builds and operates Confluent Cloud’s networking foundation, providing APIs and workflows to create and manage networking resources while improving platform velocity, resiliency, and efficiencyWe are looking for someone with an interest in building large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on building and managing core platform services that power Confluent Cloud Networking

  • Design, build, and operate backend services that are secure, reliable, and scalable in a cloud-native environment.

Master's Degree

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

title: Gruppeleder Lønn - Norconsult
description:
I Norconsult jobber vi målrettet med å profesjonalisere og effektivisere leveransene våre. Nå søke r vi en gruppeleder for lønn som skal sikre høy kvalitet i lønnsleveransen, samtidig som vi tar et viktig steg til en mer digital og fremtidsrettet arbeidsform i SAP.

Dette er en nøkkelrolle der du kombinerer operativ leveranse, ledelse og utvikling av fremtidens lønnsfunksjon. Du får ansvar for fire dyktige og motiverte lønnsmedarbeidere.

Lønnsenheten flyttes fra Økonomi til People & Culture-avdelingen fra 1. januar og vil dermed inngå i et større HR-miljø på rundt 30 personer. Du vil samarbeide tett med People & Culture, økonomi og linje i Norge, og være en sentral drivkraft i utviklingen av effektive og digitale HR-leveranser. Stillingen rapporterer til EVP HR.

Arbeidssted er ved vårt hovedkontor i Sandvika, med nærhet til både kollektivtransport og mulighet for parkering.

Hvorfor denne rollen er spennende

  • Du får en sentral rolle i overgangen til en mer digital og fremtidsrettet lønnsfunksjon

  • Du får påvirke hvordan lønn og HR-leveranser utvikles i praksis

  • Du blir en viktig sparringspartner for HR og ledelsen

Dine hovedoppgaver vil være å

  • Lede og utvikle lønnsteamet i det daglige, sikre riktig kompetanse, kapasitet og prioriteringer

  • Sikre kvalitet og effektivitet i lønnskjøring fra A–Å, inkludert rapportering, refusjoner og avstemminger

  • Være en strategisk rådgiver innen lønnsområdet mot HR, linje og virksomheten

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle lønnsløsningen (SAP) og tilgrensende HR-systemer

  • Drive kontinuerlig forbedring av lønnsprosesser

  • Sikre compliance og etterlevelse av lover, regler og interne retningslinjer

Vi ser etter deg som har

  • Relevant erfaring fra lønn, gjerne i større virksomheter

  • Ledererfaring og evne til å utvikle team og kompetanse

  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med moderne lønnssystemer (gjerne SAP)

  • Solid kunnskap om regelverk (arbeidsrett, ferieloven, folketrygdloven og gjerne tariff)

  • Erfaring med prosessforbedring og digitalisering

Personlige egenskaper som er fordelaktig i denne rollen

  • Strukturert og kvalitetsorientert

  • Endringsorientert og komfortabel med å drive utvikling

  • Rådgivende og trygg i dialog med ledere

  • Evne til å kombinere strategisk blikk med operativ gjennomføring

Hos oss får du:

  • Spennende kompetansehevings- og utviklingsmuligheter innen lønns- og HR-området

  • Et sterkt og kompetent HR-miljø med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og erfaringsdeling

  • Tett samarbeid med erfarne kolleger og god oppfølging i hverdagen

  • Sterk bedriftskultur med uformelle kommunikasjonslinjer på tvers av organisasjon og geografi

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Bonus knyttet til selskapets resultat

  • Aksjeprogram for eierskap i Norges største tverrfaglige rådgiverbedrift

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og ansettelsesbetingelser

  • Studieturer, interne fagsamlinger og ulike sosiale arrangementer

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det kun er elektroniske søknader som blir behandlet, og vi vurderer disse fortløpende.

Om Norconsult

Norconsult er et ledende nordisk rådgiverselskap. Vi kombinerer ingeniørfag med arkitektur og digital kompetanse, på tvers av små og store prosjekter i privat og offentlig sektor, innen infrastruktur, energi og industri, bygg, eiendom og arkitektur. Gjennom nyskaping og innovasjon, og med formålet «Hver dag forbedrer vi hverdagen», søker vi stadig etter mer bærekraftige, effektive og samfunnsnyttige løsninger. Med hovedkontor i Sandvika i Norge og om lag 7 200 medarbeidere fordelt på over 140 kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Island, Polen og Finland, kombinerer vi tverrfaglig kompetanse med lokal tilstedeværelse.

For Norconsult er det en grunnleggende forutsetning at alle mennesker er likeverdige. Målet er at våre medarbeidere skal ha de samme mulighetene til å nå sitt fulle potensial uavhengig av hvem de er eller hvordan de identifiserer seg. Et bredere spekter av perspektiver hjelper oss å forstå alle deler av samfunnet, utfordrer oss i våre oppdrag og fører til en høyere grad av innovasjon. Vi ønsker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

title: Project Manager - New Product Development
description:
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

Who Are We?

At Ditch Witch in Perry, Oklahoma we pride ourselves on being the leading manufacturer in the underground pipe and cable market. Our plant in Perry stands out because it's a place for people to learn and thrive. We enjoy coming to work because our plant is our community, we see our teammates not only as co-workers but as neighbors and family members. The Project Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional teams to: 1) develop and execute the project plan and maintain schedule, 2) track adherence to product cost target and project budget, and 3) ensure compliance to project scope. The overall goal is the optimization of individual projects within a complex multiple-project system, where velocity of the entire project portfolio is the priority.

  • Ensure project documentation is created, meets standards, and is properly maintained according to established procedures
  • Collaborate with other project managers to manage resources and project needs according to corporate priorities
  • Develop and review project requirements with key stakeholders to ensure project scope is accurately defined and managed so that cost and profitability goals are met
  • Track and report project budget
  • Drives key and timely decisions required to meet project objectives through cooperation with other team members
  • Address project-related conflicts and issues in a direct and effective manner

Note: The responsibilities and tasks outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the company .

  • Basic understanding of critical chain methodology
  • Fundamental understanding of TTC 1PDS for new product development
  • Above average competency to identify and resolve conflict
  • Ability to assess constraints and elevate when necessary
  • High level of emotional intelligence with a focus on teamwork and collaboration

What Do You Need?

  • In-depth understanding of the new product development process and two years’ experience in the project management department or related role in new product development
  • Successful completion of at least one new product project from project kickoff through production startup
  • Demonstrated success with problem solving within new product development
  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, business, project management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, working knowledge of Microsoft Project is a plus
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP system is beneficial

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Office most of the time, plant or outdoor environment as needed and in some instances could exceed eight hours per day. Plant and outdoor conditions include: temperature and humidity extremes, dirt and noise: physical hazards such as moving machinery, sharp objects, flying debris, and manufacturing equipment: hazardous materials such as gasoline, diesel fuel, solvents, oils, grease, and pressurized gases and fluids.
  • Regular, continuous use of a personal computer
  • Occasional travel
  • Onsite in Perry, OK with flexibility to work remotely on occasion

What Can We Give You?

At Ditch Witch, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical/dental/vision plan, 401k, and many other great benefits – Ditch Witch offers employees at our Perry, OK location a variety of perks, including:

  • Dress for your day - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, office-plant blended environment.
  • Wellness - In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health, financial health, and other types of resources to every full-time employee.
  • Growth Opportunities – TTC prides itself on giving our employees the chance to grow their careers. Tuition reimbursement, opportunities to move into new areas of interest, and promotion opportunities are a few examples.
  • Competitive Salary – The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. It is not common to be hired at or near the top of the range; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is between ​$78,600​ - ​$120,000​. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics. If you need to, you can access your pay early with the dailypay app.

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is seeking a dynamic Senior Tax Analyst to join our high-growth Global Tax team for a defined-term maternity leave cover. This isn’t just a backfill; it’s a high-impact opportunity to immerse yourself in the fast-paced SaaS industry.

Reporting to the Director, Global Tax, you will have a front-row seat to the complexities of a global social enterprise, gaining invaluable experience that only a market-leading AI-first platform organization can provide.

If you are detail and results-oriented, have strong reporting skills, and are motivated to make a positive impact with a passionate team, this role is ideal for you!

What you’ll do:

Tax Compliance:

  • Lead the preparation and execution of Canadian corporate tax filings, serving as the primary authority on compliance across Canada, the US, and Europe.

  • Manage the international compliance strategy by coordinating US and European corporate tax filings with precision and autonomy.

  • Take ownership of the transfer pricing lifecycle, from methodology execution to monthly reporting and calculations.

  • Serve as a technical advisor for charitable foundation groups, supporting tax compliance and providing technical guidance.

  • Manage the end-to-end indirect tax compliance cycle to ensure global accuracy:

    • Execute and finalize US sales tax filings utilizing Avalara;

    • Coordinate with the Procure-to-Pay team to assist with, review, and finalize Canadian sales tax filings;

    • Oversee the timely preparation and finalization of international VAT filings in partnership with external service providers.

Tax Reporting:

  • Architect the consolidated tax provision process in accordance with ASC 740 US GAAP, ensuring strategic alignment with global financial goals.

  • Lead high-level advisory with Treasury, Accounting, and Financial Reporting teams to safeguard the integrity of tax disclosures and deferred tax strategies.

  • Own corporate reporting outputs, providing actionable insights that inform Tax Leadership.

Tax Research:

  • Conduct research into complex tax issues to support compliance, reporting, and planning solutions within the SaaS ecosystem.

  • Design and deliver expert-led training programs that elevate the tax literacy and operational efficiency of key business units.

  • Proactively interpret and capitalize on new legislation in Canada and international jurisdictions to optimize Benevity’s tax position.

  • Act as the definitive subject matter expert for internal finance and operations teams, solving critical tax challenges autonomously.

Strategic Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Product teams to embed tax expertise into core business initiatives.

  • Drive special projects and high-impact tax initiatives that contribute to the rapid growth and scale of our global operations.

What you’ll bring:

  • An "AI-first" mindset with a strong drive to leverage emerging AI technologies and automation to streamline tax compliance, and reporting workflows.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a high degree of autonomy, thriving in the ambiguity of a high-growth SaaS environment.

  • Visionary problem solver who takes full end-to-end ownership of complex tax challenges.

  • Strategic influencer with the ability to build credibility and lead cross-functional teams.

  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex tax concepts to diverse audiences, from technical teams to executives.

  • Agile project manager capable of directing multiple high-priority workstreams simultaneously.

  • Expert proficiency in modern tax and ERP systems, including Netsuite, CCH iFirm, and Avalara.

  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.

  • CPA or equivalent professional designation.

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive corporate tax preparation and provisioning experience in a Canadian or multinational setting.

  • Experience in public accounting or with a multinational enterprise.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP.

  • Familiarity with sales taxes (an asset).

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a company where DEIB isn’t a buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

title: Traveling Superintendent
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Traveling Superintendent based in the United States.

This is a hands-on construction leadership role responsible for overseeing commercial projects from pre-construction through completion. You will direct daily field operations, coordinate subcontractors and trades, and ensure work is delivered safely, efficiently, and to a high standard. The role requires strong planning, scheduling, cost-control, and communication skills across a variety of commercial construction environments. You will serve as a key point of coordination between project teams, owners, building representatives, design professionals, and field personnel. Success means keeping projects on schedule, identifying issues early, and maintaining quality while protecting safety and client expectations. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced construction professional who enjoys a dynamic field environment and is willing to travel as project needs require.

Accountabilities:

  • Review construction drawings, specifications, and subcontractor scopes during pre-construction to identify requirements, risks, and coordination needs.
  • Lead project start-up activities and develop comprehensive execution plans covering construction activities, sequencing, scheduling, and coordination through completion.
  • Supervise daily field construction activities and coordinate all trades, subcontractors, foremen, and construction personnel.
  • Monitor job progress, schedule performance, and project costs in collaboration with the Project Manager, including tracking Time and Material work.
  • Provide accurate daily job-site reporting, including progress logs, documentation, and photographs.
  • Verify drawing dimensions and field measurements for floors, walls, ceilings, and other project elements, identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrective actions.
  • Communicate significant schedule impacts and project issues to the Project Manager and broader project team.
  • Establish productive working relationships with owners, owner representatives, building managers and engineers, subcontractors, foremen, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
  • Lead weekly construction meetings to review progress, upcoming work plans, coordination requirements, and project priorities.
  • Meet regularly with subcontractors to ensure alignment on schedules, responsibilities, sequencing, and daily tasks.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe job site while enforcing applicable safety policies, procedures, and PPE requirements.
  • Enforce building requirements related to noise, elevator use, security, tenant protection, and other site-specific regulations.
  • Maintain appropriate construction barriers and controls for security, dust, access, and overall site safety.
  • Proactively identify construction challenges and coordinate timely solutions to maintain quality, schedule, safety, and client satisfaction.

    • Requirements:

    • High school diploma or GED required.
    • Minimum of 5 years of project supervision experience, with 10 years preferred, particularly within commercial, restaurant, retail, healthcare, and/or industrial construction.
    • Extensive knowledge of construction scheduling, cost control, field coordination, and safety procedures.
    • Demonstrated ability to supervise multiple trades and subcontractors while maintaining strong project organization and accountability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, owners, consultants, project teams, and field personnel.
    • Ability to identify discrepancies, anticipate project risks, and take proactive corrective action.
    • Strong understanding of commercial construction processes from pre-construction through project completion.
    • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced field environment while maintaining attention to quality, safety, and schedule.
    • Willingness and ability to travel as required by project assignments.
    • OSHA 30-Hour Certification is preferred.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Procore is preferred.
    • Strong commitment to teamwork, communication, quality, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive salary ranging from $75,000 to $125,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.
      • Consistent opportunities for pay increases and performance-based bonuses.
      • Medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance.
      • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions.
      • 401(k) plan with company matching.
      • Profit-sharing opportunities.
      • Competitive paid time off (PTO), with enhanced benefits after three years.
      • Ability to roll over up to 40 hours of PTO.
      • Collaborative, relationship-driven team environment with an emphasis on teamwork and employee development.
      • Opportunity to work on diverse commercial construction projects and take on meaningful field leadership responsibilities.

Whether you're looking for a flexible, part-time job or the pathway to a lasting career, you'll find it here at MBK Senior Living–and a whole lot more! When you join the MBK Senior Living team, you'll enjoy:

-Impacting lives and building lasting relationships

success

Director in Training Programs

Full-time benefits include:

-Childcare and eldercare assistance

-Flexible spending accounts

If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact, find purpose and joy, and receive the training, tools, and support to reach your career goals – look no further, apply today!

Job Description

Schedule- Sunday- Monday 2:00PM-10:00PM Opportunity for additional hours!
Hourly Wage: $20-$21

Job Summary:

The Medication Technician is responsible for providing the highest level of compassionate, quality resident care and services by assisting residents with medication administration and activities of daily living, in accordance with their personalized service plans. This includes documenting, delivering, and administering or assisting with treatments and medications as prescribed by physicians, in a safe, organized manner and in accordance with all policies, procedures, government regulations, and guidelines.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assist residents with their daily medications, treatments, and resident care as assigned and within the scope of and in strict adherence with practice, policy, procedures, and government regulations.
  • Notify Supervisor if prescribed medication is not administered according to directions and document the reason(s) why.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, complete, and confidential records on resident medication and care in accordance with established procedures and governing requirements.
  • Track all orders for medication changes and/or refills, notify the pharmacy of new orders, and report any missing medications to the Supervisor.
  • Assist caregivers in the performance of their job duties by fulfilling the responsibilities of the Caregiver job description.
  • Document appropriate information, including incident reports, and communicate any observed or suspected resident change of condition to a supervisor immediately.
  • Respond promptly to emergencies and resident alerts or requests as needed.
  • Maintain a safe and secure environment for staff, residents, and guests following established safety standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Understand and comply with Federal, State, and local regulations, and company policies and procedures concerning the department.
  • Promote and lead with a spirit of teamwork and open communication through consistent mentoring, coaching, and recognition program utilization, in alignment with MBK principles and core values.
  • Perform other duties or special projects as assigned by the Director of Health Services and/or Executive Director, or designee.

Education Requirements:

  • High School diploma or equivalent (GED), required.
  • Certification or education as required by state regulations.
  • Must have or be able to obtain a valid CPR & First Aid certification.

Experience Requirements (in years):

  • 1+ years of prior related work experience functioning in a similar healthcare role, within a similar industry/work environment is essential.
  • 1+ years of experience handling medications preferred; on-the-job training is available for candidates with the appropriate focus and desire.

Required Competencies/Licenses/Certifications:

  • Willingness and ability to effectively manage and respond to resident behaviors, including a wide variety of verbal and physical expressions, while maintaining a safe environment.
  • Must be age 18 or over.
  • Must complete required Background, health screening, and provide negative TB test results within 7 days of employment (must be within the last 6 months).
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to read, write, and speak English and effectively follow both spoken and written directions.
  • Must be comfortable with technology for documentation of medication passes, incidents, and notes.
  • Must meet and maintain all state-specific regulatory requirements, always including medication certification and HIPAA compliance.
  • Must possess the ability to interact effectively, deal tactfully and professionally with personnel, residents, family members, and guests of diverse backgrounds always.
  • Must possess strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Must possess the ability to make sound, independent decisions when circumstances are warranted, remain calm, and effectively manage stressful or emergency situations.
  • Ability and willingness to work independently without day-to-day oversight and supervision.
  • Must display a positive and professional image in accordance with the MBK values.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:

  • Must be mobile and able to perform the physical requirements of the job, including walking, bending, kneeling, squatting, pulling, reaching overhead, and repetitive motion.
  • Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and push up to 250 pounds, as necessary.
  • Ability to move throughout the workday, in the community, and between neighborhoods.

description:

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

title: Software Engineer - AI & Internal Systems
description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER, INTERNAL SYSTEMS & AI

About the Role

Quindar is building The Grid: an AI-native system that connects how the entire company thinks, communicates, and executes.

We’re looking for an engineer to operate like a Forward Deployed Engineer — except your customer is Quindar. You’ll embed across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Programs, and Operations to understand how work gets done and then use software, AI agents, integrations, and automation to make it dramatically better.

This is a unique engineering role for someone who doesn’t just want to receive tickets. You’ll sit within Operations / Business Operations but work across the entire company. You’ll learn how every part of a technology company operates, identify problems yourself, and build the systems that solve them.

What You’ll Build

The Grid should make information flow through Quindar automatically. A Product Manager writes a specification. From there:

· Engineering requirements and tickets are generated with the context needed for coding agents to begin implementation.

· Engineers review, test, and approve agent-generated software.

· Customer and administrator documentation stays synchronized with the product.

· Marketing can generate accurate blogs, release materials, and technical collateral.

· Sales and Capture teams can access approved product capabilities, architectures, and past performance when building proposals.

· Sensitive information — including CUI and other controlled data — stays within the appropriate security boundaries.

Your job is to build the connective tissue that makes this possible.

What You’ll Do

· Embed with teams across Quindar to understand how they actually work.

· Identify repetitive, manual, or fragmented workflows that should become software.

· Connect SaaS tools, APIs, databases, internal systems, LLMs, and AI agents.

· Build custom software when an integration or off-the-shelf product isn’t enough.

· Create workflows that turn Product specifications into structured engineering work.

· Give coding agents reliable context from which they can generate software for engineers to review.

· Build systems that keep internal, customer, and administrator documentation continuously current.

· Connect Product knowledge to Marketing, Sales, Capture, and Programs.

· Create secure AI-assisted workflows for government proposals and other controlled information.

· Help establish how humans and agents work together across Quindar.

· Measure what’s working, kill what isn’t, and continuously improve The Grid.

What We’re Looking For

We care more about agency, curiosity, technical judgment, and speed than title or tenure.

· Write production software and is comfortable learning unfamiliar systems quickly.

· Uses AI coding tools naturally and is excited about agentic software development.

· Likes talking to users and understanding the problem before building.

· Can work across APIs, data, automation, backend systems, and lightweight interfaces.

· Comfortable deploying software and writing backend/frontend code

· Is comfortable being handed an outcome rather than a detailed specification.

· Has strong curiosity about how businesses operate.

· Moves quickly and prefers shipping something useful over debating the perfect architecture.

· Can communicate effectively with engineers and non-engineers.

· Has unusually high ownership and isn’t afraid to question an existing process.

Experience with enterprise integrations, developer tooling, LLMs, agents, knowledge systems, security, or government environments is helpful but not required.

Why This Role Is Different

Most engineers spend their careers going deeper into one part of the stack. In this role, you’ll go across the company.

You’ll see how Product decisions become software, how software becomes customer value, how Marketing explains it, how Sales sells it, how government proposals are built, how security affects architecture, and how a growing company actually operates.

If you eventually want to start a company, become an engineering or product leader, or simply understand how technology businesses work end-to-end, there are few engineering seats with this much surface area.

What Success Looks Like

· Product requirements move into Engineering with minimal manual translation.

· Coding agents can perform meaningful implementation work using structured company context.

· Documentation changes alongside the product instead of becoming stale.

· Employees can find authoritative information without knowing who to ask.

· Marketing and Growth can create accurate materials without repeatedly pulling engineers into the process.

· Capture teams can assemble compliant proposal content dramatically faster.

· Manual coordination is increasingly replaced by software and agents.

· Every new workflow makes The Grid more capable than it was before.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Why you'll love working at Quindar

  • We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

  • We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

  • Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

  • Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

  • We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

  • Annually we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

  • Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

title: Data Center Infrastructure Architect
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Industrial Compute team is building and productizing infrastructure capabilities that help organizations deploy and operate advanced AI systems at scale. The team works across AI hardware, systems engineering, physical infrastructure, and customer delivery to turn emerging technologies into reliable, repeatable infrastructure solutions.

Our work sits at the intersection of technical strategy, product development, engineering, and deployment. We partner closely with customers and internal engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure challenges spanning compute, power, cooling, controls, and facility efficiency.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior, hands-on Data Center Infrastructure Architect to develop and optimize the physical infrastructure required for large-scale AI deployments.

This is a broad technical role spanning data center architecture, electrical and mechanical systems, high-density compute, controls, telemetry, and digital modeling. You will use simulation, operational data, and digital-twin approaches to evaluate infrastructure designs, identify system-level constraints, and improve efficiency, reliability, cost, and speed of deployment.

The ideal candidate can move fluidly between first-principles analysis, facility and equipment design, computational modeling, engineering review, and real-world implementation. You should be comfortable working across disciplines rather than operating solely within electrical, mechanical, or software boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define system-level architectures for high-density AI data centers across power, cooling, IT equipment, controls, and facility infrastructure.

  • Develop digital twins and other computational models that represent the behavior of data center systems under changing workloads, environmental conditions, equipment configurations, and failure scenarios.

  • Use design and operational data to identify constraints, improve PUE and related efficiency metrics, and optimize capacity, reliability, water consumption, cost, and deployment schedules.

  • Evaluate tradeoffs across electrical topology, cooling architecture, rack density, redundancy, controls, maintainability, constructability, and operational complexity.

  • Translate evolving AI hardware requirements into practical facility, rack, power, and thermal architectures.

  • Establish reference architectures, modeling standards, design assumptions, performance requirements, and validation methodologies that can be reused across customer deployments.

  • Partner with software, data, controls, hardware, mechanical, electrical, construction, commissioning, and operations teams to connect digital models with real infrastructure behavior.

  • Integrate telemetry from systems such as BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, equipment controllers, and IT hardware into modeling and optimization workflows.

  • Lead technical reviews of customer and partner designs, identify material risks, and recommend changes grounded in quantitative analysis.

  • Work with customers and delivery teams to adapt reference solutions to site-specific constraints while preserving performance, reliability, and efficiency objectives.

  • Support pilots, commissioning, performance testing, and post-deployment analysis to validate models and continuously improve infrastructure designs.

  • Help shape the technical roadmap for Industrial Compute’s physical-infrastructure products and engineering services.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience designing or optimizing hyperscale data centers, large mission-critical facilities, or comparable infrastructure systems.

  • Broad knowledge of data center electrical and mechanical systems, including power distribution, backup power, thermal management, liquid cooling, heat rejection, controls, and monitoring.

  • Experience making system-level design decisions across multiple engineering disciplines.

  • Experience developing or applying simulation, optimization, digital-twin, or physics-based modeling techniques to physical infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of data center efficiency and performance metrics, including PUE, WUE, utilization, capacity, reliability, and total cost of ownership.

  • Experience working with operational telemetry and translating real-world system behavior into design improvements.

  • Ability to evaluate complex tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, sustainability, and maintainability.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical work in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex engineering decisions to customers, executives, and cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, applied physics, or a related technical discipline.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with high-density GPU clusters and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

  • Experience connecting facility models with workload, rack, server, or chip-level power and thermal behavior.

  • Familiarity with modeling or engineering tools such as Modelica, MATLAB/Simulink, Python, EnergyPlus, computational fluid dynamics tools, or equivalent platforms.

  • Experience with BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, PLCs, data historians, or industrial controls.

  • Experience developing reference designs or new infrastructure architectures within a hyperscaler, data center operator, advanced engineering organization, or major design consultancy.

  • Experience taking an infrastructure concept from modeling and prototype validation through deployment and operational feedback.

  • Advanced degree in an engineering or scientific discipline.

Success in the First Year

  • Establish a credible system-level model of power, cooling, compute, and facility behavior for priority Industrial Compute use cases.

  • Identify and validate meaningful opportunities to improve efficiency, capacity, reliability, or deployment cost.

  • Deliver reusable reference architectures and engineering methodologies for customer deployments.

  • Create a repeatable feedback loop connecting modeling, operational telemetry, commissioning results, and future design decisions.

  • Become a trusted technical partner to internal engineering teams, customers, and infrastructure delivery partners.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Front-End Software Engineer
description:
About Us

At Union, we are solving one of the hardest challenges in AI infrastructure today: enabling high-velocity iteration while maintaining seamless production-readiness for AI workloads at scale.

Flyte, the open-source project we steward, has emerged as the modern standard for data and AI orchestration, and is trusted by leading technology organizations including LinkedIn, Stripe, and Wayve to run millions of mission-critical workflows on the platform. These workflows comprise data preparation, model training, and scaled inference spanning thousands of GPUs, all major clouds, and on-premise infrastructure.

We have a technical founding team who created Flyte while at Lyft, a deep bench of infrastructure experts from top companies, and have raised from top investors like NEA and Nava Ventures.

About the Role

Union is building the orchestration layer for modern AI and ML workloads. We're hiring a Front-End Software Engineer to build intuitive, high-performance experiences on top of complex distributed systems.

The surface you own is data-dense and live. Workflow runs stream state as they execute, task lists run long, logs and timelines update in real time, and a customer debugging a failed run needs the console to stay fast and legible while thousands of rows move underneath them. This is closer to building a monitoring or observability console than a marketing site or a CRUD app.

You'll work across the Flyte v2 experience, from launching workflows to monitoring runs, debugging failures, managing applications, and onboarding new organizations, in close partnership with product, design, backend, infrastructure, and customer teams.

This role is hybrid, based out of our Seattle office.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain a modern React and Next.js application in TypeScript.

  • Develop features across Run Details, Actions, Apps, Settings, workflows, and onboarding.

  • Implement complex UI patterns including infinite scrolling, virtualization, real-time updates, streaming, and timelines.

  • Build interactive data tables with sorting, filtering, pagination, and efficient rendering at volume.

  • Create reusable, responsive components using Tailwind CSS, Headless UI, and our design system.

  • Work with gRPC and Connect APIs and protobuf for type-safe data communication.

  • Use TanStack Query and Zustand for server and client state management.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to influence API design and deliver cohesive features.

  • Contribute to front-end architecture, technical decisions, testing, and performance improvements.

  • Work directly with customers to understand problems, debug issues, and improve the product.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience building modern web applications.

  • Strong experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

  • Hands-on work with real-time data, infinite scrolling, virtualization, complex state, or high-volume datasets. This is the part of the job that's hard to fake.

  • A real understanding of front-end architecture and performance optimization.

  • Experience with modern build tooling such as Vite or Webpack.

  • A bias toward simple, reliable, maintainable code and thoughtful user experiences.

  • Clear communication and effective collaboration across teams.

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Workflow orchestration, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Kubernetes, containers, gRPC, protobuf, or data visualization.

  • Flyte, Ray, Spark, SageMaker, or similar AI and ML platforms.

  • Working directly with enterprise customers.

Our Stack

  • Core. React, Next.js, TypeScript.

  • Styling. Tailwind CSS, Headless UI, internal design system.

  • State and data. TanStack Query, Zustand, gRPC and Connect, protobuf.

  • Tooling. Vite, Webpack.

title: Senior Product Designer aa
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in Germany.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
  • Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
  • Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
  • Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
  • Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
  • Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
  • Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
  • Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
    • Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
    • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
    • Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
    • Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
    • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
    • Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
    • Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
    • Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
    • Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible working hours focused on results and impact rather than time spent at a desk.
      • Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
      • 21 days of annual leave plus applicable local bank holidays.
      • Equipment provided to help you perform effectively in your role.
      • Premium access to the product and its features.
      • Opportunity to work on a large-scale consumer product with global reach.
      • Chance to work at the intersection of AI, behavioral science, gamification, and mobile product design.
      • Collaborative environment with significant opportunities to experiment, innovate, and influence the direction of the product.
      • Full-time position within an international and distributed team.

Job Description

Basic Purpose

Positions in this job family are responsible for overseeing the construction of highways, roads, and related structures, ensuring construction conforms with the construction contract documents, plans and specifications.

Typical Functions

The functions performed in this job family will vary by level, unit and organization, but may include the following:

  • Performs sampling and field testing of materials used during construction projects, ensuring compliance with the Oklahoma Department of Transportation (ODOT) testing guidelines.

  • Submits accurate test records and samples to the residency lab.

  • Maintains current records in the Construction Management System and updates the system data.

  • Inspects contractor’s work to ensure compliance with project plans and specifications.

  • Communicates with stakeholders, such as businesses and landowners affected by the project.

  • Maintains required documentation of project progress, including measurements, calculations, and documentation of all work events and conditions.

  • Submits progressive estimates and time and diary reports.

  • Operates agency-issued vehicles and other equipment safely.

  • Conducts safety reviews.

  • Resolves contract disputes and specification interpretation with contractors.

  • Uses agency-provided software to accurately and completely document progress and required reports such as: Daily Work Reports (DWR), Diaries, Material Testing, Estimates

  • Trains new employees

Level Descriptor

Levels are distinguished based on the complexity of assigned duties, the level of expertise required for completion of work assignments, and the responsibility assigned for the supervision of others.

This is the basic level of the job family where incumbents learn techniques and methodologies for performing highway construction inspections, materials sampling and testing. Supervisors and higher-level Highway Construction Inspectors will provide training and instruction for assigned tasks. Supervision and monitoring of the work product will range from close supervision of the incumbent at the learning stage of a task or function to normal and routine supervision and monitoring of the work product as the incumbent becomes proficient in and independently performs assigned tasks and functions.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Competencies

In addition to the knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies identified in lower level(s),

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of basic construction materials and their typical uses; of occupational safety practices; of basic mathematics, including basic geometry and algebra, used in routine job-related calculations.

Ability required is the ability to collect, maintain, and record field data; to communicate effectively with internal staff, contractors, and other external partners in both oral and written form, and includes the preparation of inspection reports and recommendation; to use computer and standard office software; and to work in the following conditions: of moderate to considerable amount of handling light or medium weight objects/materials and use of medium weight tools, of climbing and working from ladders or while in an awkward position (physical effort); of unfavorable to considerable exposure to unfavorable conditions such as weather, being confined, noisy or dirty locations as a regular part of the work day (environmental); of dangerous to considerable conditions which are unpredictable/uncertain and which result in risk of personal injury (hazards); and of considerable periods, on a regular basis, of concentration and focused sensory attention (which includes seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, and touching) of medium intensity and longer duration (sensory attention).

Education and Experience

High school diploma or General Educational Development (GED).

Special Requirements

Positions with the Oklahoma Department of Transportation require certification in materials sampling and testing from an accredited state or national sampling and inspection program within 12 months of hire. This is level specific training.

Some positions may require working long hours, nights, and on weekends.

Possession of a valid driver's license at the time of employment.

Applicants must take a drug test prior to employment.


Applicants must be willing and able to perform all job-related travel normally associated with this position.

While performing job duties, the employee may be required to sit, stand, walk, reach, talk, and hear. Routinely, employees are required to sit, manipulate or feel objects, tools, or controls; climb and balance; stoop; kneel; crouch or crawl.

Employees must be able to regularly lift 50 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

Able to work in a wide variety of environmental conditions, ranging from extreme heat to extreme cold.

Some positions in this job family are safety sensitive as defined by 63 O.S. § 427.8.

title: Member Experience Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Member Experience Lead based in Canada.

This is a founding-level opportunity to shape the experience of an exclusive network of accomplished agency founders and business leaders.
You will become a trusted point of contact for members, learning their businesses, priorities, challenges, and goals.
Your work will turn those insights into meaningful introductions, thoughtful group placements, and proactive engagement.
You will also build the systems and processes that make a high-touch member experience consistent as the network grows.
The role combines relationship building, community operations, communication, data tracking, and business judgment.
You will work closely with senior leadership and the facilitation team in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where your ideas can directly influence how the community operates.
This is a fully remote role for someone who enjoys both exceptional conversations and building the systems that make them scalable.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead welcome and onboarding calls for every new member, learning about their business, goals, challenges, and priorities while creating a strong first impression.
  • Build thoughtful member-to-member introductions based on genuine needs, interests, and opportunities rather than surface-level similarities.
  • Own the forum group matching process, including member intake, preference gathering, bios, written placement recommendations, coordination, and rematches when required.
  • Build and maintain the engagement system, including tracking, follow-up sequences, check-in cadences, member history, and next actions.
  • Monitor member engagement and identify signs of disengagement or "drift," proactively reaching out before issues become larger concerns.
  • Manage recurring member communications, including weekly updates, announcements, community prompts, digests, and member spotlights.
  • Promote virtual events and sessions by identifying members who would benefit most, personally inviting them, and following up after events.
  • Track and report on member sentiment, engagement patterns, and emerging trends, providing leadership with actionable recommendations.
  • Partner closely with facilitation and leadership teams to continuously improve member journeys, community rituals, matching processes, and overall member value.
  • Help establish the standards, processes, and systems that will define a scalable and high-quality member experience as the network grows.

    • Requirements

    • Strong experience in customer success, member experience, community management, client services, hospitality, account management, or another high-touch relationship-focused environment.
    • Excellent interpersonal skills and a genuine interest in getting to know people, understanding their businesses, and building meaningful professional connections.
    • Strong matchmaking instincts, with the ability to quickly understand people and recognize which individuals, groups, or opportunities could create mutual value.
    • Strong business acumen and curiosity, with the confidence to engage in substantive conversations with successful founders and senior business leaders.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally.
    • Comfortable hosting virtual meetings and facilitating meaningful conversations with senior-level participants.
    • Highly organized and comfortable using spreadsheets, CRMs, community platforms, and tracking systems to manage detailed member information and follow-ups.
    • Proactive mindset with strong situational awareness; able to recognize when a member is disengaging and take action without waiting for instructions.
    • Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to build processes and systems rather than relying on an established playbook.
    • Ability to balance relationship-building with operational discipline, using data and structured follow-up to improve the member experience.
    • Experience with hospitality, concierge services, peer groups, masterminds, or membership communities is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Circle or similar community platforms is advantageous.
    • Experience in agencies, digital marketing, media, growth companies, startups, or small teams is a bonus.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive base salary.
      • Quarterly performance bonus tied to member engagement, onboarding activation, and meaningful member connections.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Direct exposure to successful agency founders and business leaders.
      • Opportunity to build a member experience function and its processes from the ground up.
      • High level of ownership and autonomy in an early-stage, growing environment.
      • Close collaboration with senior leadership and the facilitation team.
      • Opportunity to shape community rituals, matching processes, engagement systems, and member experience standards.
      • Meaningful impact on member retention, engagement, and the overall value of the network.
