title: Architecte de Solutions / Global Solution Architect
description:
Description du poste et responsabilités

DASSAULT SYSTÈMES, l’entreprise 3DEXPERIENCE, offre aux entreprises et aux particuliers des univers virtuels pour imaginer des innovations durables. Avec plus de 250 000 clients dans 11 secteurs d’activité, allant des hautes technologies aux sciences de la vie, de la mode aux transports, nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers du monde entier à créer des innovations durables, pour aujourd’hui et pour demain.

La mission de l'Architecte de Solutions Global (GSA) est d'agir en tant qu'architecte en chef pour les activités de conseil stratégique au sein de la région Amérique du Nord (NAM) de Dassault Systèmes (DS). Cela implique une collaboration avec les équipes des clients ainsi qu'avec l'écosystème interne de DS pour développer des feuilles de route stratégiques basées sur les solutions et processus de DS (plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE). Ces solutions permettent aux clients d'atteindre leurs objectifs d’affaires. En collaboration avec des consultants métiers, le GSA élaborera, validera et proposera des architectures de solutions pour les clients, en alignant et en articulant la valeur métier pour les clients stratégiques de DS.

L'organisation Industries et Services Conseil (I&CS) d'Amérique du Nord au sein de DS recherche un GSA pour son équipe de conseil stratégique. Ce rôle vise à soutenir et représenter les besoins des clients de notre région géographique en définissant, alignant et validant les processus et solutions proposés. Ces processus et solutions doivent démontrer et livrer de la valeur grâce aux processus d'engagement de valeur (VE) de DS.

Pour accomplir cette mission, l'équipe de conseil stratégique a besoin d'un leader collaboratif capable d'utiliser ses relations avec les clients stratégiques et les partenaires industriels. Ce leader devra articuler les solutions métiers nécessaires pour les clients et expliquer comment elles pourraient évoluer pour soutenir les activités commerciales actuelles dans l'environnement d'aujourd'hui.

Le GSA sera également responsable de :

  • Former les équipes commerciales de DS sur les nouvelles stratégies et technologies.
  • Soutenir le développement de feuilles de route stratégiques.
  • Fournir des communications clés permettant aux équipes de planifier stratégiquement la croissance de nos activités et l'évolution de nos interactions clients.

Un GSA efficace doit avoir une connaissance approfondie des tendances actuelles et émergentes dans les industries cibles des solutions DS. Il devra collaborer avec le reste des organisations internes pour assurer la continuité du processus d'engagement de valeur, de la stratégie à la livraison.

  • Définir une solution globale intégrée permettant au client d'exécuter sa stratégie d’affaires en fournissant :
    • Une couverture de l'ensemble de ses processus métiers avec la valeur attendue, tout en maintenant la faisabilité et la pertinence de la solution finale.
    • Une contribution à la réalisation des objectifs d’affaires du client en exploitant la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE, selon les défis métiers spécifiques à l'industrie du client.
    • Une ingénierie de solution en promouvant d'abord les solutions SaaS Cloud de Dassault Systèmes, en tenant compte des tendances du marché.
    • Une expertise sur le processus VE pour opérer et orchestrer l'ingénierie de solution, de la vision à la livraison.
    • Construire un pont entre les processus métiers du client et les solutions/technologies de Dassault Systèmes en utilisant le processus VE.
    • Implication directe avec nos clients pour développer une vision architecturale TO-BE (incluant les capacités et processus métiers, cas d'usage, storyboards, architecture des applications d'entreprise, etc.) et des feuilles de route et les faire évoluer en dossiers d'architecture complets pour la phase d’adoption.
    • Implication directe avec nos clients pour définir, collaborer et gérer l’architecture d’entreprise et le modèle de données pour livrer une solution d'entreprise.
    • Évaluation des opportunités clients en termes de faisabilité, valeur et risques.
    • Aide aux consultants métiers pour identifier et capturer les valeurs des processus des clients.
    • Remise en question des processus métiers des clients en termes de création de valeur et de transformation commerciale.
    • Gestion des communications avec les organisations étendues de DS (R&D, Services, etc.) dans le contexte des relations stratégiques avec les clients.
    • Définition ou révision de l'architecture globale des solutions en exploitant le savoir-faire de 3DS pour soutenir les objectifs métiers des clients, en mettant en avant la valeur engagée et en prenant soin de s’assurer de la faisabilité et des efforts de livraison.

    • Définition des meilleures pratiques en matière d'architecture de solution pour capitalisation.

Role Description & Responsibilities

DASSAULT SYSTEMES, the 3DEXPERIENCE Company, provides businesses and people with virtual universes to imagine sustainable innovations. Serving over 250,000 clients in 11 industries, from high-tech to life sciences, fashion to transportation, we help businesses and people around the world to create sustainable innovations for today and tomorrow.

The mission for the Global Solution Architect (GSA) is to act as chief architect for the strategic consulting efforts within the North American (NAM) GEO by collaborating with Customer accounts as well as Dassault Systemes’ (DS) internal eco system to develop strategic roadmaps of DS solution and process experiences (3DEXPERIENCE platform) enabling Customers to achieve their business objectives. Working with expert Business Consultants, the GSA will draft, validate and propose account solution architectures and align and articulate the business value to DS’s strategic customers.


The North America Industry and Consulting Services (I&CS) organization within DS is searching for a GSA for their strategic consulting team to support and represent our GEOs customers’ needs through defining, aligning and validating proposed system processes and solutions that demonstrate and deliver value through DS’ Value Engagement (VE) processes. To accomplish this mission the strategic consulting team have a need for a collaborative leader that can utilize relationships with strategic Customers and Industry partners to articulate what Customer business solutions are needed and how they might evolve to support current business in today’s environment. The GSA will also be responsible to educate the DS sales teams on new strategies and technologies, support strategic roadmap development and provide key communications enabling them to strategize with information that supports the growth of our business and evolves our customer interaction. A successful GSA should have in-depth knowledge of the current and up-and-coming trends in the target business industries with DS solutions, while collaborating with rest of the DS organizations to ensure continuity through the Value Engagement process from strategy to delivery.

  • Define integrated Global Solution enabling the customer to execute its business strategy by providing:

  • Coverage of its whole business processes with the expected business value while maintaining the final workability and relevancy of the solution

  • Contribution to the customer’s Business Objectives achievement leveraging 3DEXPERIENCE platform according the Industry Business Challenge of the customer.

  • The solution engineering by promoting SaaS Cloud solution first from Dassault Systèmes, considering the market trends.

  • Expertise on the VE process to operate and orchestrate the solution engineering from the solution vision to the solution delivery

  • Build the bridge between Customer’s business processes and Dassault Systemes’ solution/technology using the VE process

  • Direct involvement with our Customers to develop a TO-BE architectural vision (including business capabilities and processes, use cases, storyboards, enterprise application landscape etc.) and roadmaps and evolve them into a complete architecture dossiers for adoption

  • Direct involvement with our Customers to define, collaborate, and manage the architectural model and data model for an enterprise solution

  • Assess Customer opportunity in regards of feasibility, value and risks

  • Assist Business Consultant to identify and capture customer business values

  • Challenge customer’s business processes in regard of value creation and business transformation

  • Manage the relationship with extended DS’ organizations (R&D, Services etc.) in the context of strategic Customer relationship

  • Define or review global solution architecture leveraging 3DS know-how to support customer business objectives, highlighting committed value, and taking extra care of feasibility and delivery effort

  • Define best practices in context of solution architecture for re-use across multiple customers engagements

Qualifications
  • Diplôme en ingénierie (ou équivalent) avec 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en architecture de solutions globales pour le PLM ou des solutions d'entreprise similaires, avec une emphase sur l'architecture système et la conception système.
  • Expérience dans le déploiement de solutions d'entreprise, les services et le conseil.
  • Connaissance et expérience avec la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE ou de tout logiciel PLM d'entreprise de grande envergure.
  • Connaissance de l'ingénierie des systèmes basée sur des modèles. (MBSE)
  • Expérience dans les modèles d'architecture d'entreprise populaires (comme TOGAF) et les outils de capture d'architecture comme CAMEO ou Rhapsody.
  • Expérience dans les transformations d’affaires.
  • Connaissance des processus métiers dans plusieurs domaines : ingénierie système, conception/ingénierie, fabrication, assurance qualité, gestion de programme, après-vente, etc.
  • Connaissance approfondie des normes industrielles et des processus métiers dans plusieurs secteurs (automobile, haute technologie, sciences de la vie, aérospatial, etc.).
  • Expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vie de livraison de projets logiciels, incluant les solutions sur site et SaaS Cloud.
  • Excellentes compétences en leadership, communication et présentation.
  • Esprit stratégique et analytique avec des compétences consultatives et de résolution de problèmes élevées.
  • Capacité à adopter rapidement de nouvelles connaissances, pratiques, outils et processus.
  • Disponibilité pour voyager jusqu'à 50 % du temps.
  • Capacité à produire des livrables en anglais et en français.
  • Capacité à converser en français et en anglais.
  • Connaissance de 3DExperience, CATIA et DELMIA.

Qualifications
  • Engineering Degree (or equivalent) with 5+ years’ experience of global solution architecture for PLM or similar enterprise solutions with emphasis on system architecture and system design
  • Enterprise solution deployment, Services & consulting experience preferred.
  • Knowledge and experience of 3DEXPERIENCE platform or any large enterprise PLM software
  • Knowledge of Model Based Systems Engineering
  • Experience in popular Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (like TOGAF) and architecture capture tools like CAMEO, Rhapsody.
  • Business transformation engagement experience with Customers
  • Business Process knowledge in multiple domains like system engineering, design/engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, program management, after market etc.
  • Deep knowledge in Industry standards & Business processes across multiple industry sectors (e.g. automotive, high-tech, life sciences, aerospace etc.)
  • Experience working within a software project delivery lifecycle, including both on premise and SaaS Cloud solutions
  • Outstanding leadership, communication and presentation skills.
  • Strategic and analytical mindset with high consultative and problem-solving skills.
  • Rapid adoption of new knowledge, practices, tools and processes
  • Able and available to travel up to 50%
  • Capable of producing deliverables in English and French
  • Able to converse in French and English
  • Knowledge of 3DExperience, CATIA and DELMIA

title: Director, Media Automation & Operations
description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


Join Our Mission

Risepoint is an education technology company that provides world-class support and trusted expertise to more than 100 universities and colleges. We primarily work with regional universities, helping them develop and grow their high-ROI, workforce-focused online degree programs in critical areas such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. Risepoint is dedicated to increasing access to affordable education so that more students, especially working adults, can improve their careers and meet employer and community needs.

The Impact You Will Make

Streamline and automate media operations and buying to achieve a 20% improvement in process efficiency, while building scalable, resilient operations that effectively support both today’s execution needs and future business transformation.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

AI & Automation

  • Develop and own the AI and automation roadmap for media operations and buying, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities to improve process efficiency, scalability, and media effectiveness.
  • Lead the implementation of cost-effective automation solutions, determining the optimal mix of internal resources, external partners, and technology investments in partnership with BT.
  • Build AI capability and adoption across the team, establishing practical use cases, training, and ways of working that embed AI into day-to-day media operations.
  • Establish AI and automation governance, including standards for responsible use, quality control, documentation, measurement, and ongoing optimization.
  • Build a scalable automation foundation that enables greater media in-housing, reducing manual work and creating repeatable, sustainable processes.
  • Establish measurement and reporting for AI and automation initiatives, quantifying efficiency gains, business impact, adoption, and return on investment.

Media Operations

  • Lead the media operations and billing roadmap, managing direct reports, priorities, capacity, and workflows to ensure accuracy, quality, efficiency, and timely execution.
  • Anticipate evolving operational requirements resulting from business transformation and proactively develop solutions, processes, and resource plans to support future needs.
  • Strengthen account security, operational controls, and governance, establishing clear SOPs, SLAs, ownership, escalation paths, and quality standards across core media processes.
  • Identify and eliminate operational friction, using data and process analysis to simplify workflows, reduce errors, improve handoffs, and increase team productivity.
  • Partner cross-functionally with media, technology, finance, analytics, and business leaders to ensure operational capabilities and automation priorities align with broader business objectives.
  • Build scalable operating models that can support both current business requirements and future growth and transformation.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver measurable operational impact: Achieve a 20%+ improvement in process efficiency through AI, automation, and process optimization while maintaining or improving quality, accuracy, and media effectiveness.
  • Build scalable operations for the future: Establish the automation, governance, SOPs, and operating models needed to seamlessly support today’s media execution while enabling future business transformation and increased media in-housing.
  • Embed AI into how the team works: Build strong AI capability and adoption across the organization, with teams consistently applying AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve decision-making, and increase overall effectiveness.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Process efficiency – 20% efficiency improvement created through targeted process streamlining & automation
  • Operational excellence & scalability – Improve quality, accuracy, SLA performance and operational controls that can support business complexity and media in-housing
  • AI & automation adoption – increase the adoption and effective use of AI and automation across the team and workflow as measured by capacity created and business outcomes

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

  • Media process & operations expertise with strong understanding of workflows for search & social
  • Applied AI and automation experience
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and influence

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Experience managing external technology partners and development plans
  • Data-driven business orientation to define KPIs, build business cases and quantify value of projects

Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Maltings Plant Process Artisan
description:
Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

The key purpose of the Process Artisan is operation of the process area according to work instructions, the execution of non- destructive quality checks and carrying out of routine maintenance.
The process artisan has a primary focus on the asset care activities of the team.

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Operating and Process Control
  • Operating the process area according to the work instructions and adhering to usage standards
  • Carrying out the required quality checks as described in the quality control and analysis work practice
  • Recording waste on the appropriate documentation or information systems, and reviewing waste trends to identify problems or opportunities timeously
  • Constantly reviewing process performance against target, and completing all short interval control documentation
  • Responding rapidly to upstream or downstream triggers that result in stoppages
  • Appropriate problem-solving approaches, as detailed in the problem-solving work practice must be followed
  • Performing housekeeping tasks, applying 5s principles and following safe work practices
  • Unsafe work practices must be identified and corrected
  • Assisting fellow team members in the execution of their tasks


Maintenance of Plant and Equipment

  • Carry out in-depth cleaning, lubrication and inspection of machines according to the work instructions, and following the schedules supplied by the maintenance planner
  • Carrying out routine maintenance activities according to the maintenance schedule. Where routine maintenance reveals larger problems, and the process artisan is unable to resolve these, it must be escalated to the team leader
  • Taking part in maintenance and cleaning days
  • This work must be executed in support of the maintenance support team and in accordance with the schedule issued by the maintenance planner
  • Taking part in maintenance postmortems
  • This must be done in support of maintenance specialist support
  • Monitoring trends when conducting routine maintenance
  • Where trends indicate the existence of underlying problems, corrective action must be Quality Control and Analyses taken
  • This corrective action may involve the SBU, the maintenance controller or maintenance support
  • When operating, the process artisan must carry out the non-destructive quality checks and analyses
  • The list of checks to be carried out are contained in the work instructions
  • Recording the results of quality checks on the relevant documentation or information system
  • Where production does not meet quality standards the process artisan must try to identify and resolve problems using the appropriate techniques
  • If they are unable to resolve the problem themselves, it must be escalated to the team leader for further direction


Key Attributes and Competencies:

  • Communication
  • Actively participating in shift meetings, asking questions to test understanding and contributing suggestions
  • Making use of the gap list to record issues, problems and improvement opportunities
  • Fully understanding the team goals and participating in team goal review sessions
  • Where FFA’s have been initiated, the process artisan may be asked to participate
  • Making use of relevant communication media (e.g. shift logbook) to stay informed and inform others of issues


Problem Solving

  • When problems occur, applying the appropriate techniques (e.g. 5Why, quick fix routines etc.) the identify and correct the problem
  • Where the process artisan is unable to resolve the problem, involve fellow team members or escalate to the team leader if necessary
  • Where problems have been resolved, verify that the problems have been eliminated
  • Continuous Improvement Using run/control charts and trend analysis, to identify sources of waste and variation in the process
  • Using short stop analysis, Pareto charts and other tools seek to identify opportunities to simplify activities
  • Where improvement opportunities have been identified, these must be recorded on the team gap list
  • The process artisan should involve other team members in evaluating opportunities and call-in specialist resources to assist if required


Minimum Requirements:

  • Mechanical Engineering Diploma
  • Minimum 2 years in manufacturing
  • Ability to communicate well
  • Ability to adhere to instructions
  • Work in shifts with minimum supervision and action oriented

description:

Job Description

Here’s a Glimpse of the Job

Texas A&M’s Anthropology Department is seeking a Research Assistant to support the Principal Investigator and conservation team in the stabilization and preservation of the Revolutionary War Gunboat Philadelphia. This position is located in Washington, D.C. and is grant-funded expected to conclude at the end of March 2027. The Research Assistant will assist with conservation efforts, documentation, and related project activities aimed at protecting and maintaining this historically significant artifact while supporting research, educational, and public outreach objectives.

Opportunities to Contribute

  • Repairs and stabilizes wooden and iron artifacts to ensure their long-term preservation.

  • Documents conservation activities to industry standards and communicates project work and findings to visitors and the public.

  • Trains and supervises volunteer assistants while assisting the Principal Investigator with preparing and maintaining the worksite for visitors.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Physically able to lift and move objects up to 50 pounds.

A well-qualified candidate for this position will also possess:

  • Hold a Class C motor vehicle license and the willingness to drive/operate a Class-C motor vehicle to and from the work site or to pick up supplies.

  • Minimum of six months experience working with maritime archaeological artifacts comprised of wood, iron, and composite materials.

  • Experience working with archaeological ship structures or disassociated ship timbers.

  • A thorough understanding of degradation processes involved with artifacts recovered from a submerged environment.

  • Ability to documentation watercraft and component parts to industry standards.

  • DSLR artifact photography and UV reflective photography.

  • A strong understanding of 18th and 19th-century ship construction.

  • Familiarity with Rhino 7 (CAD) software.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to analyze and characterize object components that have been recovered from freshwater or seawater environments.

  • Basic understanding of the use of XRF, FTIR and other analytical methods.

  • A thorough understanding of ship construction methods from the historic period with emphasis on the second half of the 18th century.

  • Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others.

  • Strong writing skills.

Salary: Compensation will be commensurate based on the selected candidate's education and experience.

Please note: This position is grant funded; future employment may be contingent upon future funding.

What you need to do

Apply! Submit a cover letter, CV/Resume to assist us with the review process. You may upload these documents on the application under CV/Resume.

Why Texas A&M University?

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.

Anthropology, in the College of Arts and Sciences, is the study of what it means to be human in the broadest sense, through an examination of culture and society (sociocultural and linguistic anthropology), the biology and evolution of humans and our closest relatives (biological anthropology) and the study of past human communities and material culture (archaeology). Students develop an appreciation of the value of physical and cultural differences at the local, national, and global levels, and learn critical thinking skills that support them in their careers.

We are a prestigious university with strong traditions, Core Values, and a community of caring and collaboration. Amenities associated with a major university, such as sporting and cultural events, state-of-the-art recreation facilities, the Bush Library and Museum, and much more await you. Experience all that a big city has to offer but with a reasonable cost-of-living and no long commutes.

  • Medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life and AD&D, flexible spending accounts, and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M contributing to employee health and basic life premiums

title: Portfolio Manager, Total Portfolio Design & Targets (12-month contract)
description:
Purpose. Performance. People.


Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.


The Role


The Total Fund Management (“TFM”) department is responsible for the successful implementation of the Fund’s investment framework. These activities are focused primarily on the Strategic Portfolio, our long term vision for the intended investment portfolio composition five or more years into the future. TFM also works on the Total Fund daily investment cycle, including all the processes, systems, and data needed to structure the investment portfolio in response to the ongoing flow of cash and exposures into and out of the Fund. TFM consists of five groups: Portfolio Design, Research & Engineering; Beta, Collateral & Liquidity Management; Dynamic Portfolio Management; Trading; and Strategy & Business Management.

The Portfolio Design, Research & and Engineering (“PDRE”) group defines the strategic portfolios which enshrine key decisions including exposure, leverage, liquidity, currency targets and size of the Active Portfolio. The group develops and maintains the research, methodologies, quantitative models, analytical tools, and engineering capabilities that support strategic allocation, portfolio management, tactical asset allocation, implementation research, trading and the Office of the CIO where applicable.

We are recruiting for a 12-month contract at the Portfolio Manager level for our Total Portfolio Design & Targets (TPDT) team within PDRE. The Portfolio Manager will work closely with teams across TFM to design, evaluate, and implement robust frameworks for Total Fund exposure management. While activities are underpinned by systematic, model-driven approaches, the role also involves the application of investment judgement in the management of exposures, including the assessment and execution of adjustments and overrides where appropriate. The role will also contribute to efforts to assess complementarities across strategic and tactical horizons.



The Team


Accountabilities

  • Contribute to providing recommendations to the senior management team on total portfolio targets and asset allocation.

  • Maintain and enhance existing models used for portfolio construction and analysis.

  • Perform ad-hoc quantitative analysis and effectively communicate findings and recommendations

  • Apply programming expertise, optimization, linear algebra or numerical analysis techniques to prototype portfolio analytics and quantitative models used in top-down portfolio management. Convey new information requirements through written specifications.

  • Mentor and develop experienced team members by providing guidance on advanced technical problem-solving, portfolio construction, and investment decision-making.

Qualifications

  • At least 7-10 years of relevant experience in portfolio management and/or asset allocation research. Expertise across multiple asset classes, including equity, fixed income and currency, and a strong understanding of macro drivers of returns and cross-asset linkages are considered assets.

  • Experience applying empirical statistical and quantitative techniques to financial and macroeconomic data. Experience with AI-assisted coding tools and the ability to leverage them effectively to enhance modeling and portfolio analysis are assets.

  • Strong programming and quantitative skills; demonstrable proficiency using Python.

  • Ability to quickly grasp new concepts and work in a high-performing culture, under pressure and with time-sensitive deadlines.

  • Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.

  • Effective communication skills across a broad range of stakeholders.

  • Self‑motivated, organized, flexible, and adaptable to changing priorities and new challenges.

  • Successful candidates must consistently exemplify CPP Investments’ guiding principles of high performance, integrity, and partnership.


You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.


We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.


CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

As a Financial Solutions Advisor within the centralized segment of the Advisor Development Program, your journey begins by obtaining your Securities Industry licenses, where you receive dedicated and personalized classes for your Securities Industry Essentials [SIE], Series 7 and Series 66 Exams. Once you obtain your licenses, you will be taught the foundational skills needed to be an advisor – from acquiring, building and managing client relationships to considering a client’s complex financial picture and guiding them with advice and solutions to help them live their best financial lives, all while humanizing financial interactions. You will then join the centralized team as a Financial Solutions Advisor.

The Financial Solutions Advisors in the centralized segment are phone-based licensed advisors (obtaining series 7 and 66 required) that provide clients with holistic financial advice and guidance by identifying broader product and service solutions that meet their investment, savings and liability management solutions. FSA’s demonstrate knowledge of investments and financial markets and apply key principles appropriate to the individual client's investment needs. Additionally, they align Merrill and Bank of America products and services where appropriate. We will equip you with everything you need, as you move through the stages of development and move into the Merrill Financial Advisor role.

During this stage of your journey, you will receive the necessary training and guidance through a defined path to become the financial advisor you want to be. You will have the opportunity to work with both affluent and high net worth clients, identifying needs, developing relationships, reviewing investment goals, and preparing investment recommendations that align with the goals of both existing and prospective clients. title: Expert Technician - Production
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Position Overview:

The Manufacturing team handles the aseptic production of radiopharmaceutical drug products and radioisotopes at our GMP facility, working within established batch records and strict cGMP requirements. Because these materials have short half-lives, the team operates under tight timelines and coordinates closely with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and Engineering to keep production running and to release product on schedule. It is highly regulated work where product quality, radiation safety, and on-time delivery all have to be managed at once.

The Expert Technician, Manufacturing is a mid-senior individual-contributor role on that team. Reporting to the Supervisor/Manager of Manufacturing, this person runs aseptic production, but strong technical documentation skill is central to the role. They investigate and resolve deviations, non-conformances, and OOS events, and they author and maintain the GMP records: deviations, CAPAs, change controls, investigations, and SOP revisions. The role pairs hands-on aseptic production with the technical writing rigor that keeps the facility operational and inspection-ready.

Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Supervisor/Manager of Manufacturing, the Expert Technician, Production will have responsibility for:

  • Aseptic production of radiopharmaceutical drug product and radioisotopes in accordance with established manufacturing batch records.
  • Support the technical transfer, development, and validation of production methods associated with finished dosage form (FDF) drug products and radioisotope products.
  • Investigate, resolve, and mitigate deviations, non-conformances, and OOS (Out of Specification) events associated with product manufacturing at the GMP facility.
  • Monitor production-related equipment to ensure proper function and compliance with the established calibration / PM equipment schedule.
  • Continuous process improvement of existing manufacturing methods via Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).
  • Maintain cross-functional production communications and operational planning tools to support on-time task execution.
  • Produce radioisotopes and drug products following cGMP guidelines and resolve all production-related quality events in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate production activities with Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and Plant Maintenance to facilitate on-time release of drug product and radioisotopes.
  • Participate in technical transfer and process validation activities in collaboration with other departments.
  • Safely work with radioactive materials following ALARA principles and NRC guidelines.
  • Utilize and monitor all manufacturing-related equipment.
  • Conduct and appropriately document aseptic production of radiopharmaceutical drug product and radioisotopes via strict adherence to manufacturing batch records and affiliated SOPs.
  • Safely handle and participate in the transfer of radioactive materials throughout the facility.
  • Monitor manufacturing equipment to ensure performance and safety standards are met.
  • Collaborate with maintenance technicians, equipment manufacturers, and quality assurance to ensure that all production equipment is in good working order and is validated for use.
  • Provide verbal and written reports to supervisors in a clear and concise manner.
  • Maintain accurate and complete lab data notebooks as per cGLP and/or cGMP, as appropriate.
  • Adhere to all applicable procedures, cGLP, cGMPs, company policies and any other quality or regulatory requirements.
  • Embody and promote a quality culture and due diligence approach as part of all activities.
  • Author, review, and maintain GMP documentation and technical writing deliverables, including deviations, non-conformances, CAPAs (Corrective and Preventive Actions), change controls (CCs), investigations, and SOP revisions, ensuring clear, accurate, and audit-ready records.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Earned college/Associate level diploma/degree in a related scientific field of study
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment or similar field of work.
  • Aseptic and/or cGMP manufacturing experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated GMP documentation exposure and technical writing ability, including hands-on experience authoring or supporting deviations, CAPAs, change controls (CCs), investigations, and other quality records.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, while working with a sense of urgency.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow repetitive processes without error.
  • Maintain clear, consistent, and constant verbal communication with one or more team members during performance of duties.
  • Full range of motion and ability to use both hands mandated by machinery. High degree of manual dexterity. Regular lifting of 10 lb weights, occasional lifting of up to 50 lbs.
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills with the desire and ability to work in a team centered environment.
  • Availability to work variable shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required to support manufacturing operations.

Additional Preferences:

  • Earned Bachelor's degree in a related scientific field of study
  • Experience working with radiopharmaceuticals is an asset.
  • Comfortable handling radioactivity and follow proper ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) technique.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Working knowledge of production scheduling, document control workflows, and operational tracking tools.
  • Demonstrated initiative in identifying and implementing process improvements and innovation ideas.
  • Support production documentation and radiation-safety activities (ledgers, swipe testing, area monitoring) across manufacturing and research spaces, while mentoring fellow technicians on procedures, documentation, and equipment.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, innovation, and new-product readiness initiatives.

title: Senior Content and Marketing Designer
description:
Searchable is building the analytics and agentic platform for AI Search.

The way people discover products and information is changing. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews are becoming a new layer between brands and their customers.

Searchable helps companies understand their visibility across these platforms, identify opportunities and take action through AI-powered workflows spanning SEO, AEO and GEO.

We are backed by leading angels and VCs and are building the team that will define this category. We are looking for a Senior Content and Marketing Designer to set a high bar for how Searchable shows up in the world.

This is a senior, hands-on visual design role. You will lead work across brand, advertising, social media, our website and sales and marketing materials. You will turn strategy into strong creative ideas, take those ideas through to polished execution and build the systems that help the whole company move faster.

This is an individual contributor role, not a design management position. You will lead through the quality of your ideas, craft, judgement and influence.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead creative concepts from early direction through final production across brand and marketing

  • Create high-quality advertising and social media work that earns attention and communicates a clear idea

  • Design website graphics, landing page visuals, product illustrations and launch campaigns

  • Produce sales decks, one-pagers, case studies, reports and other materials that help teams tell a consistent story

  • Partner closely with founders, design, product and marketing to shape briefs and decide what the work needs to achieve

  • Set visual direction for campaigns and important company moments, then deliver the work yourself in Figma

  • Build reusable templates and visual systems that improve consistency without making the brand feel repetitive

  • Turn product insights, customer stories and data into clear, compelling visual narratives

  • Manage several priorities without losing attention to production details, formats or channel requirements

  • Raise the creative bar through direct feedback, clear rationale and excellent execution

Who You Are

  • You have a strong portfolio of brand and marketing design work for digital products or technology companies

  • You have owned meaningful campaigns or visual systems as a senior individual contributor

  • You are highly skilled in Figma and use it confidently from concept through final production

  • You have excellent judgement in typography, layout, composition, colour and visual hierarchy

  • You are as comfortable finding the idea as you are producing the final asset

  • You can create excellent work across advertising, social media, websites and sales materials

  • You turn loose briefs and business goals into clear creative direction without waiting for perfect information

  • You can explain your decisions, give constructive feedback and influence work beyond your own output

  • You balance speed, quality and consistency in a fast-moving team

  • You care about the message and audience, not just how the work looks

  • You enjoy working in person and collaborating closely with the people around you

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for B2B, analytics, AI or other technical products

  • Experience building or evolving a visual identity across multiple channels

  • Comfort using for creative exploration and production

  • Experience using Midjourney or similar tools to create and refine original visual directions

  • An interest in AI Search, SEO, AEO or GEO

A Note From Sam, Co-founder

Building a new category means we cannot rely on familiar visual shortcuts. The work needs to explain something new, earn attention and still feel unmistakably Searchable.

I work across design and product at Searchable, and you will work closely with me, our founders and the rest of the team every day. We will shape briefs together, share feedback quickly and stay close to the work until it is right.

I want to work with someone who can find the strongest idea, make the work themselves and raise the standard around them. You will have real ownership over how Searchable looks and feels across every important marketing touchpoint.

Sam Hogan
Co-founder

Location

This is an in-person role based at our office near London Bridge.

We work together five days a week because a small team benefits from fast feedback, shared context and being able to solve creative problems side by side.

Compensation and Benefits

  • £85,000 to £105,000 salary, depending on experience

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays

  • Leading parental and childcare policies

  • Daily Uber Eats or Deliveroo meal allowance

  • Late-night Uber home when work runs late

  • Monthly fitness and wellbeing reimbursement

  • Flexibility to manage your own schedule, with a focus on the quality of your work

title: Solution Researcher
description:
We’re an award-winning global outsourcer providing contact center and back office services on behalf of our global clients. Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

SOLUTIONS RESEARCHER

Eastwood, Quezon City

Night Shift | Onsite | Full-Time

Do you have a sharp eye for detail and the patience to dig until you find the real answer? Join our team as a Solutions Researcher and put your research skills to work on cases that directly affect people's access to healthcare.

ABOUT ACQUIRE INTELLIGENCE

At Acquire Intelligence, our mission is to help business work smarter.

We bring together the best people, efficient processes, and automation to help companies grow faster and operate with confidence. Our purpose is to simplify how businesses work, improve performance, and lead meaningful change across the globe. If you're passionate about making a real impact through innovation and collaboration, Acquire Intelligence is the place to grow your career.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR ROLE

As a Solutions Researcher, you'll be the back-office detective behind U.S. Affordable Care Act (ACA) individual health insurance plans. You'll dig into provider networks, hospitals, prescription drug formularies, and plan details, then back up every finding with solid evidence: screenshots, source documents, links, and clear written summaries.

This is not a sales role. You won't be recommending plans or giving legal or medical advice. You'll report to a Senior Solutions Researcher who assigns your cases, reviews your work, and helps you work through anything unclear.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

ACA Health Plan Research

  • Research U.S. ACA individual health insurance plans using approved carrier websites, provider directories, plan documents, and government resources
  • Identify plans available within an applicant's state, county, ZIP code, and coverage year
  • Review plan summaries, evidence-of-coverage documents, provider directories, and formulary documents, cross-checking multiple sources when required
  • Follow research checklists and instructions in the required order, without substituting assumptions for plan-specific verification

Provider Network Verification

  • Confirm whether specific physicians, specialists, hospitals, clinics, laboratories, and pharmacies appear in a particular plan's network
  • Verify each provider's name, specialty, practice, address, and location against the exact plan and network (not just the carrier in general)
  • Call carriers and provider offices when needed, using approved scripts, and document every call in detail
  • Flag inconsistent or incomplete information to your Senior Solutions Researcher rather than guessing

Prescription Drug Formulary Research

  • Determine whether requested medications appear on a plan's current formulary, matching name, dosage, and formulation
  • Identify drug tier and any restrictions, such as prior authorization, step therapy, or quantity limits
  • Distinguish between brand-name and generic versions, and capture supporting evidence for every result
  • Escalate unclear or conflicting information instead of guessing

Documentation and Case Records

  • Enter research results accurately into company-approved templates and systems
  • Capture clear screenshots and source documents, saved and named according to company standards
  • Write summaries that a teammate can understand and verify, clearly distinguishing confirmed, not found, conflicting, and unresolved results
  • Maintain confidentiality and follow all company privacy and data-security requirements

A BIT ABOUT YOU

Must-Haves

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in research, healthcare administration, insurance operations, customer support, data processing, quality assurance, or another detail-intensive role
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct careful, methodical online research
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to understand U.S. accents and communicate professionally by phone
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and documentation standards, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines
  • Comfortable recognizing uncertainty, asking questions, and correcting work based on feedback
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, web browsers, PDFs, screenshots, email, and shared files
  • Willingness to work a U.S. Central Time-aligned night shift, currently Monday to Friday, 9:30 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time (shifting to 10:30 PM to 7:00 AM when the U.S. moves to Central Standard Time), with possible overtime in Q4

Good-to-Haves

  • Experience with U.S. healthcare or health insurance, particularly ACA individual health plans
  • Background researching provider networks or prescription drug formularies
  • Familiarity with insurance terms such as deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, prior authorization, and step therapy
  • Experience handling confidential medical, financial, or personally identifiable information
  • Experience making professional calls to U.S. organizations

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Consistently accurate research, backed by complete and well-organized supporting evidence
  • Full compliance with instructions, checklists, and documentation standards
  • Timely escalation of conflicting or missing information instead of guesswork
  • Reliable turnaround on deadlines, paired with clear, professional written and verbal communication

WHY JOIN THE A-TEAM?

Come for a career, stay for the fun!

Here's what's waiting for you:

  • HMO coverage for you and your family
  • Epic Yearly Kick-Off Parties with major giveaways
  • Recognition through our Value Awards — we celebrate your wins
  • Real career growth with opportunities for internal promotions
  • Meaningful work with talented and supportive teams

Your future matters:

  • 900+ internal promotions every year
  • Access to 2,700+ leadership training courses

Extra rewards along the way:

  • 14th Month Pay after 5 years of continuous service
  • Employee Referral Program — earn up to ₱42,000 per successful hire

Enjoy work-life balance:

  • 24 Paid Time-Off Credits annually, with leave credits convertible to cash
  • Paid Birthday Leave — celebrate your day your way

WHAT WE VALUE

We're proud of our diverse global team, all working in a collaborative environment and happy to share these common values:

Curious and Clever: Smart questions spark smart solutions.

Entrepreneurial Energy: Think like an owner. Solve like a founder.

Fast with Intent: We move fast and deliver real results.

Laugh and Learn: We don't take ourselves too seriously, just our results.

What are you waiting for? Come for a career, stay for the fun!

title: Software Engineer - AI
description:
At Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Nebraska, we are a mission-driven organization dedicated to championing the health and well-being of our members and the communities we serve.

Our team is the power behind that promise. And, as the industry rapidly evolves and we seek ways to optimize business processes and customer experiences, there’s no greater time for forward-thinking professionals like you to join us in delivering on it! As a member of Team Blue, you’ll find purpose, opportunities and the support you need to build a meaningful career and make a powerful impact in our community.

The Software Engineer position will be responsible for working with cross-functional business teams to research, design, test, and maintain various systems and applications. This role is responsible for providing engineering knowledge and experience, as needed, to deliver solutions to the business both on new builds, as well as support on modifications and maintenance for existing programs.

The ideal candidate will live within driving distance of the Omaha, Nebraska office. This position allows remote flexibility but will have 1 day per week in the office.

If living in one of our approved states (Florida, Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Texas) – this person may travel to our headquarters based on business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Multi-agent orchestration layer. Design and build the LangGraph-based system that classifies member intent and routes to the right agent. Stateful, context-preserving, failure-tolerant. Handles commercial agents and internally built capabilities through the same interface.
  • Agent integration contract. The standardized pattern that makes any agent pluggable: input schema, output schema, confidence signaling, latency SLA, fallback behavior. When the team integrates a new agent, they follow a pattern you designed.
  • Context management across turns. Multi-turn conversations that maintain full member context across agent handoffs. The member asks a follow-up two turns later; the platform knows what was said, which agent handled it, and what was retrieved.
  • Guardrail and safety layer. Clinical safety boundaries, PHI handling at the LLM layer, and response normalization ensuring every agent response arrives in a consistent tone and within compliance constraints regardless of which agent generated it.
  • RAG pipeline architecture. Benefits documents, formularies, and policy content retrieval via Azure AI Search. You define the ingestion strategy, chunking approach, hybrid search configuration, and retrieval quality standards.
  • Prompt architecture. Versioned prompt registry, structured output contracts, few-shot pattern design. Every prompt is testable, rollback-able, and understandable by the team.

To be considered for this position you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2-4 years of experience in software development.

Experience with agentic AI in production—not LLM wrappers, not single-agent chatbot demos, not RAG tutorials. Systems with multiple agents, explicit state management, and real users depending on the answers being correct.

  • 1-2 years building and operating production LLM or agentic AI systems
  • You can describe specific decisions you made in a multi-agent system: state management approach, how you handled agent failures mid-conversation, how you kept the system governable as agents were added
  • LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom graph-based orchestration used in production, not just evaluated. You know where it breaks down and how you worked around it
  • Debugged retrieval quality problems, iterated on chunking strategies, dealt with stale knowledge bases in a live system with real users
  • Built evaluation systems from scratch: golden datasets, automated regression, domain-appropriate accuracy metrics. Your eval suite caught a production regression before users reported it
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, fintech, or legal domains—AI systems where a wrong answer has consequences, and you designed the safeguards that make accuracy non-negotiable
  • Strong knowledge of Python. Work in an existing codebase and extend it with the AI layer
  • Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Container Apps are the target stack

The strongest candidates will also have:

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Desire to think in a creative, lateral way both conceptually and in practical application.
  • You must be obsessed with addressing customer needs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience creating Single Sign On (SSO) experiences.
  • Possess emotional intelligence.
  • Preferred qualifications include experience with .NET development, API design and integration, and UI/UX principles to support the delivery of intuitive, customer-focused applications.

title: Clinical Assistant
description:

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. Reports changes and/or abnormalities in vital signs; findings that are outside of defined parameters; and changes in patient’s conditions to the nursing/medical staff in a timely manner.

title: Security Alarm Dispatcher-8pm-4:30am - Training Provided!
description:
Overview

As a Level 3 iSOC Coordinator, you will take on advanced responsibilities, managing real-time interactions and interventions during critical security events. Building on your expertise from previous levels, you will handle live audio communication with individuals at monitored sites, using two-way systems to prevent security breaches, manage incidents such as trespassing, and de-escalate potential threats. Your ability to think quickly and communicate with authority will be key to resolving incidents in real time.

This role demands a high level of skill in alarm verification, video monitoring, and rapid decision-making, all while maintaining clear and direct communication with customers and emergency personnel. As a Level 3 Coordinator, you will not only respond to alarms but also provide solutions by directly addressing security violations. This position allows for greater responsibility and impact in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment, as you continue to grow within the iSOC team.

What's in it for you?

  • Shift Hours: Position requires availability between 8pm-4:30am, based on labor demands

  • Flexible Schedule: We offer 8–10 hour shifts which provides more flexible options on the number of days worked per week. (Your work hours will be scheduled between this time range. Could be 8 or 10 hour shifts.)

  • Full benefits on Day 1 of employment to support you from the start

  • 3 weeks paid vacation time and 10 days paid sick time

  • Uncapped employee referral bonuses

  • Customer focused, energetic and engaging work culture working as one team

  • Training is provided!

Starting Pay Rate: $22.00 Per Hour (not including shift differential)

Location: On-site in office

New iSOC Hire Bonus
All newly hired St. Louis iSOC employees will be eligible for a $500 hiring bonus.
The bonus will be paid in two installments:

  • $250 after successfully completing 90 days of employment.

  • $250 after successfully completing 6 months of employment.

To receive each payment, employees must be actively employed on the applicable payout date.

Shift Differential:

Interface’s Interactive Security Operations Center is a 24/7 environment supporting our customers throughout the U.S. Interface recognizes the commitment of our employees working various days and hours to support our 24/7 operations, and is pleased to offer a shift differential for hours worked outside of standard business hours:

  • Standard Pay Rate: Applies to hours worked during the core daytime period (6:01am – 4:59pm) on regularly scheduled business days.

  • Evening Differential: +$0.50 per hour for hours worked between 5:00pm and 9:00pm.

  • Overnight Differential: +$1.00 per hour for hours worked between 9:01pm and 6:00am.

  • Weekend Differential: +$1.00 per hour for any hours worked on Saturdays or Sundays (12:00am – 11:59pm).

Monthly Performance Bonus:

Interface’s Interactive Security Operations Center Coordinators are eligible for our Performance Monthly Bonus Award Program after 90 days of successful active employment. Interface awards its highest performing employees based on specific metrics and eligibility criteria, where employees can earn up to $1,000.00 bonus awards each month.

Monthly Attendance Bonus:

Interface’s Interactive Security Operations Center Coordinators are eligible for a Monthly Attendance Bonus Award after 90 days of successful active employment. Full time employees can earn up to $250.00 per month, based on attendance eligibility criteria, for up to $3,000.00 per year.

Start dates Available:

Start your training program with our Day 1 Orientation Class which occurs bi-weekly.
*September 14, 2026

*September 28, 2026

* Please note favorable results on a pre-employment drug screening and background check are required.

Responsibilities

The iSOC Coordinator position is designed to ensure comprehensive security and life safety monitoring through three defined levels of responsibility: Level 1 - Security, Level 2 – Life Safety & Level 3 - Interactive. Each level builds upon the previous, offering increasing complexity and authority in managing customer safety, alarm verification, and live interaction with monitored sites.

  • Perform remote security checks/ virtual tours of customer locations, carefully observing all areas for potential security vulnerabilities, criminal and/ or unusual activities.

  • Conduct virtual security escorts to safeguard customers during business opening, closing and/ or upon customer a request.

  • Communicate with customer locations using state-of-the-art two-way audio/ video surveillance technology.

  • Take appropriate action based on the severity or instruction provided, including customer contact and/ or requesting emergency services such as police, fire, or medial services.

  • Answer inbound phone calls to assist with resolving, escalating, or supporting security and system-related inquiries from customers, employees, and vendors.

  • Maintaining accurate records and documentation with the system of record (automation system)

  • Monitor, verify and respond to alarm signals, placing outgoing telephone calls to verify validity of alarm signals.

  • Perform video verification of alarms to confirm security breaches or emergency incidents.

  • Notifies specified individuals via telephone of an alarm or event according to customer-specific instructions.

  • Provide critical life safety support by ensuring clear, timely and accurate dispatch and alarm communication to emergency personnel.

  • Provide basic alarm support such as arming, disarming, and assisting in resetting alarms/ signals.

  • Manage live audio interactions in response to alarm events or customer requests, utilizing two-way audio systems to communicate directly with individuals at monitored sites.

  • Use two-way audio to intervene during real-time incidents, projecting authority and maintaining clear communication.

  • Handle situations such as loitering, trespassing, or other security violations, often requiring de-escalation or rapid decision-making.

  • Document all interactions and ensure proper follow-up to ensure the resolution of incidents.

  • Generate detailed reports on alarm responses and life safety interventions.

*Interface offered learning courses may be necessary when pursuing further certification(s) All iSOC employees must comply with policies as stated in the Interface Employee Handbook and Employee Safety Manual.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.

  • Two years of experience in customer service, call center, dispatch, or security roles is preferred.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills ensuring all interactions are handled with professionalism and care.

  • Strong active listening skills to understand customer needs and provide timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

  • Ability to maintain a calm and positive demeanor in high pressure situations, demonstrating professionalism while working through urgent or critical situations.

Work Environment

iSOC Coordinators work in a state-of-the-art security monitoring operations center, equipped with the latest technology in video surveillance, two-way audio communication systems, and intuitive alarm monitoring software. Operators are trained to handle multiple security events simultaneously, making use of advanced monitoring tools, such as customized automation solutions, proprietary software integrations, and workstations designed for video monitoring efficiencies.

NiSource is currently seeking a Summer Communications Intern. Successful applicants will become integral members of the department while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with team members and leaders on important projects. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.

This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Merrillville, IN. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.

Summary

As a Brand & Channels Communications Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting storytelling, content creation, platform management, and emergency outages across internal and external channels. You’ll help shape how we connect with customers and communities while learning how communications drive business strategy and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Social Media & Platform Management

  • Draft, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and Nextdoor.
  • Monitor engagement and assist with community management.
  • Help maintain editorial calendars and content checklists.

Content Creation

  • Assist in writing captions, articles, and scripts for internal and external use.
  • Support video and photo production, including storyboarding and on-site shoots.
  • Create materials such as short and long-format videos, graphics, and web materials.
  • Support intake and execution of requests via the Communications Channels & Branding Request Form.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Emergency Outages & Crisis Communications
  • Support the Communications team in delivering timely and accurate messaging during emergency outages and service disruptions.

  • A self-starter, able manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

title: IT Operations & Delivery Excellence Lead
description:
Job Description

About Zendesk & The Role

At Zendesk, we build software designed to improve customer relationships, helping businesses create meaningful, engaging, and seamless interactions. To support this mission internally, our Office of the CIO team is looking for an IT Operations & Delivery Excellence Lead to drive operational efficiency and delivery velocity across our IT organization.

Embedded within the Strategy & Operations team, this is a strategic leadership role focused on driving the adoption of modern Agile mindsets and practices. In this role, you will partner with senior executives, engineering leaders, and cross-functional teams to champion our "How We Work" (HWW) framework, scale delivery practices, and integrate modern AI capabilities into our daily workflows. If you are an experienced change agent who excels at driving framework adoption, optimizing modern tooling, and fostering team empowerment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Strategy: Drive the overarching strategy for cross-functional delivery alignment, bridging traditional project management approaches and Agile delivery through a cohesive enterprise framework.
  • AI Integration & Delivery Evolution: Drive the integration of AI into our agile delivery practices, leveraging Atlassian Rovo and internal enterprise AI tools to automate routine workflows, optimize knowledge discovery, and accelerate cycle time to value.
  • Framework Maturity: Implement and guide teams in scaling Agile frameworks, with a specific focus on establishing and maturing a robust Kanban framework alongside existing Scrum and SAFe practices.
  • HWW Framework & Knowledge Management: Support the adoption of our operating model framework by measuring Agile adoption and expanding the reach of "how we work" (HWW) more broadly across the organization; own and maintain the master Confluence site as the single source of truth.
  • Training Ownership: Own, maintain, and evolve the end-to-end "how we work" training program and content, in addition to directly delivering tailored training sessions and workshops.

  • Executive & Stakeholder Engagement: Engage directly with senior executives and functional leaders to align transformation goals with organizational strategy, fostering shared ownership, transparency, and cultural adaptability.

What You Bring to the Role

  • 8+ years of experience leading Agile transformations, with a strong background in Agile coaching, delivery leadership, and organizational change.

  • Exceptional communication, coaching, and facilitation skills, with a proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders — including executives.

title: Supervisor, Digital Health Program
location: Fifth Avenue Administration - San Diego, CA
description:
For more than 55 years, Family Health Centers of San Diego’s (FHCSD) mission has been to provide caring, affordable, high-quality health care and supportive services to everyone, with a special commitment to uninsured, low-income and medically underserved persons.

FHCSD is one of the top 10 largest federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) in the country. We operate more than 90 sites across San Diego County, including 29 primary care clinics, 23 behavioral health facilities, 10 physical rehabilitation clinics, nine dental clinics, five vision clinics, four outpatient substance use treatment programs, three mobile medical units, two mobile counseling centers, two urgent care centers, and a pharmacy.

Our staff provides care to over 227,000 patients each year, of whom 91% are low-income and 29% are uninsured. FHCSD provides care to all. Services include, but are not limited to adult care, chronic disease management, pediatrics, comprehensive women’s care including obstetrics, dental, vision, case management, physical rehabilitation, speech therapy for children, vaccinations, infectious diseases, behavioral health, substance use counseling and a host of specialty services including cardiology, podiatry, endocrinology, dermatology, among others. FHCSD also offers supportive services to those who are unsheltered and in need of intensive case management.

The breadth of our clinic locations, services and programs has grown over the last five decades, making us the largest community clinic provider of health care to the uninsured in the county and one of the top 10 largest community clinic organizations in the nation. We are also the largest health care safety-net provider, largest school-based health care provider and the largest mental health provider in the San Diego region.

Family Health Centers of San Diego is looking for a Supervisor, Digital Health Program who supervises employees and day-to-day processes associated with Family Health Centers of San Diego’s digital health programs. Ensures efficient delivery of health education topics, supervises digital health technology orientation, technical assistance, and deployment for our patients across multiple projects and quality improvement and innovation initiatives. Supervises provision of complementary patient navigation of FHCSD resources and services to enhance access to care, utilization of the patient portal, and uptake of educational resources. Supports the mission of FHCSD by driving the development and offering of culturally and linguistically appropriate education, navigation, and technical guidance for the utilization of digital health technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Builds positive relationships, inspires others to perform at a higher level, prepares career development plans and retains an accountable workforce.
  • Coaches and counsels’ staff and administers appropriate disciplinary action in a timely manner.
  • Creates and implements systems and processes to ensure company goals and strategic plans are met, including evaluation, recommendation of changes, implementation, training, and evaluation of effectiveness.
  • Collects and disseminates training materials, conducts trainings, and provides on-going supervision for digital health specialist team.
  • Ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements: HEDIS, Meaningful Use, Joint Commission, State Licensing, NCQA-PCMH, and other entities governing care delivery and quality.
  • Participates in continuous improvement activities and ensures appropriate Lean tools (i.e., 5S, A3) are deployed and results are evaluated and/or measured.
  • Provides/ensures staff receive all new hire and annual trainings on time.
  • Supervises assigned team, including hiring, providing performance management, training, scheduling, and corrective discipline (including termination) as needed.
  • Works closely with interdisciplinary teams to develop and implement digital patient navigation and education programs to improve patient knowledge and compliance.
  • Supervises Digital Health Specialists activities, which include assessing potential barriers to care and identification of supportive steps to overcome these barriers, assisted and unassisted referrals, and providing resources and follow-up. As needed, may provide direct support to patients in support of team.
  • Tracks expected and projected deliverables on a regular basis and ensure compliance with all regulatory and departmental requirements. Oversees the development of and ensures correct material is delivered in culturally appropriate and relevant ways.
  • May engage patients in ongoing support for digital health technology utilization and provides guidance to patients in need of technical assistance.
  • Leads assigned projects by developing project plans.
  • Audits project plans on an ongoing basis and provides reports to the manager.
  • Ensures adherence to master plans and schedules and generates solutions to program problems.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in Health Education, Health Science, Nutritional Science, Public Health, Communications, or closely related field preferred.
  • 3 years of experience delivering health education/healthcare, preferably in a community health setting.
  • Specific Certifications may be required or preferred depending on assignment (i.e., CA HIV Test Counselor, limited CPT certification for waived testing, lactation certification, etc.)
  • Ability and means to travel as needed in a timely manner within San Diego County. DRIVER REQUIREMENTS: Requires an active Class C California driver's license, proof of liability insurance at $100,000, on vehicle used. No more than 2 points in past 12 months; No suspensions in last 2 years for moving violations; No DUI, reckless or felony Driving within 5 years. No license revocation in 7 years.

Experience/Specialized skills (including Language)

  • Ability to conduct research and investigate latest trends and best practices on health education topics.
  • Ability to work effectively with patients and community members from diverse social, cultural, and economic groups.
  • Ability to work well in both a team-based environment and independently.
  • Intermediate to advanced computer literacy ability to comply with department needs and expectations (i.e., digital health device familiarity, electronic medical record documentation, obtaining background information and reports on patients, following up on appts, etc.).
  • Bilingual in Spanish/English or other language may be required depending on assignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to be culturally sensitive and respect diversity.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of adult and child education techniques, practices, and tools.
